AI.title_translation: 开源大语言模型在招聘应用中性别与种族偏见的语言触发因素
AI.tldr: 本研究揭示并量化了开源大语言模型在招聘中由特定语言触发的性别与种族偏见，并提出了应对合规要求的审计协议。
AI.motivation: 开源大型语言模型正快速进入招聘流程，但其在欧盟AI法案和美国EEOC不利影响分析下的歧视性失败模式及其引发的监管风险尚不明确，因此需要系统审计。
AI.method: 对六种开源LLM进行了四个对照实验，涵盖招聘者模拟和求职者模拟任务，采用词嵌入关联测试（WEAT）并在表示层进行验证，同时提出了一套预部署审计协议。
AI.result: 代理性招聘语言会降低女性候选人的推荐得分，而共有性语言可部分消除惩罚；隐性排他语言会以极大的效应量压低非白人候选人的得分，并对非白人画像产生寒蝉效应，词嵌入关联测试也证实了这一点。
AI.conclusion: 研究证实了开源LLM在招聘任务中存在由特定语言触发的显著性别和种族偏见，并通过提出的审计协议为合规应对欧盟AI法案和美国EEOC标准提供了可行方案。
AI.translation: 开源大型语言模型正迅速进入招聘流程，然而它们在欧盟人工智能法案高风险分类（附件III）和美国EEOC不利影响分析下产生的歧视性失败模式，以及由此带来的监管风险仍然知之甚少。我们对开源LLM进行了首次系统性、多模型的审计，将职位发布语言作为主要的实验变量，在四个受控实验中评估了六个模型（Llama 3.2、Mistral、Gemma 3、Qwen 3、Phi 3、DeepSeek-R1），共同探讨了招聘者模拟和求职者模拟任务。我们发现：（1）代理性发布语言会降低女性候选人的招聘者推荐得分（r_rb = 0.309，p_Bonf = 7x10^-5；模型固定效应 r_rb = 0.448），而共有性语言部分逆转了这种惩罚；（2）隐性排他语言以大效应量（r_rb = 0.646-0.758）抑制了非白人招聘者的得分，并且在求职者侧，选择性地阻止了非白人画像表达兴趣——在大规模上运作了一种寒蝉效应机制。标签消融实验将显式的人口统计画像标签分离为主要因果驱动因素，词嵌入关联测试在表征层面印证了这些发现（在Caliskan等人的多词性别属性列表下，d = 1.01-1.45）。我们将这些结果转化为一个具体的预部署审计协议——职位发布词汇评分、画像条件化LLM探测，以及针对五分之四阈值的不利影响标记——这使得附件III对招聘中高风险AI施加的文档和风险管理义务得以落实。
AI.summary: 该论文通过系统性地多模型审计，揭示了开源LLM在招聘应用中由于职位发布语言触发的性别与种族偏见，并提出了相应的预部署审计与风险管理协议。
AI.keywords: 大型语言模型, 招聘偏见, 性别歧视, 种族歧视, 模型审计
AI.comments: 该论文首次系统性地对开源大语言模型在招聘中的性别与种族偏见进行了多模型审计，揭示了特定语言触发器（如代理性语言和隐性排他语言）对不同群体评分和意愿的显著影响，具有极高的实践价值与合规指导意义。

title: FoundAna: A GNN-assisted Foundation Model for Graph Anomaly Detection
summary: Graph anomaly detection aims to identify graph structures (e.g., nodes, edges, or subgraphs) that deviate significantly from expected patterns, which supports critical applications in fraud detection, spam identification, network intrusion, etc. Despite the growing methods in the field, existing approaches follow a one-model-per-dataset paradigm, limiting their transferability across diverse real-world scenarios due to task heterogeneity, label scarcity, and domain variability. In this work, we introduce FoundAna, a GNN-assisted Foundation Model for Graph Anomaly Detection - the first foundation model framework designated for generalizable, cross-graph anomaly detection by combining GNNs and transformers. FoundAna integrates an anomaly detection-specific GNN component with a standard transformer encoder augmented by four complementary positional encodings, which enable the model to capture both local and global structural information. Specifically, the positional encoding enriched node representations are passed through attribute and adjacency decoders, and the reconstruction errors serve as the anomaly score. Extensive experiments on nine benchmark datasets spanning financial, social, and citation network domains demonstrate that FoundAna consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines. The code implementation and Supplementary materials are here: https://github.com/FoundAna331/FoundAna.

AI.title_translation: FoundAna：一个用于图异常检测的GNN辅助基础模型
AI.tldr: FoundAna是首个用于图异常检测的基础模型，它通过融合GNN和带有位置编码的Transformer，克服了传统模型泛化能力差的问题，在多领域图异常检测任务中取得了领先性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的图异常检测方法多采用“一数据集一模型”的范式，由于任务异质性、标签稀缺性和领域可变性，限制了它们在不同真实世界场景中的迁移能力。为此，需要开发一个能够跨图进行通用异常检测的基础模型。
AI.method: 提出了FoundAna框架，结合了针对异常检测的图神经网络（GNN）组件、带有四种互补位置编码的标准Transformer编码器，以及用于计算异常得分的属性和邻接解码器（通过重构误差）。
AI.result: 在跨金融、社交和引用网络等领域的九个基准数据集上进行的广泛实验表明，FoundAna的性能始终优于当前的先进基线模型。
AI.conclusion: FoundAna作为首个专用于图异常检测的基础模型框架，通过结合GNN与Transformer以及属性和邻接重构，成功实现了跨图、跨领域的通用异常检测，显著提升了泛化性能。
AI.translation: 图异常检测旨在识别明显偏离预期模式的图结构（如节点、边或子图），从而支持欺诈检测、垃圾信息识别和网络入侵等关键应用。尽管该领域的方兴未艾，但现有方法多遵循“一数据集一模型”的范式，由于任务异质性、标签稀缺性和领域可变性，限制了它们在多样化现实场景中的迁移能力。在这项工作中，我们推出了FoundAna，这是一个用于图异常检测的GNN辅助基础模型——它是首个通过结合GNN和Transformer来实现可泛化的、跨图异常检测的基础模型框架。FoundAna将一个特定的异常检测GNN组件与一个由四种互补位置编码增强的标准Transformer编码器相结合，使模型能够捕获局部和全局结构信息。具体而言，经过位置编码丰富后的节点表示通过属性解码器和邻接解码器，重构误差作为异常得分。在跨越金融、社交和引用网络域的九个基准数据集上的广泛实验表明，FoundAna始终优于最先进的基线模型。代码实现与补充材料见：https://github.com/FoundAna331/FoundAna。
AI.summary: 本文提出了FoundAna，这是首个用于图异常检测的GNN辅助基础模型。它通过结合GNN、配备四种互补位置编码的Transformer编码器以及属性与邻接解码器，实现了跨图和跨领域的通用异常检测，并在多个基准测试中取得了优于现有SOTA的效果。
AI.keywords: Graph Anomaly Detection, Foundation Model, Graph Neural Networks, Transformer, Cross-graph Generalization
AI.comments: FoundAna开创性地将大模型范式引入图异常检测领域，通过融合GNN与Transformer以及重构机制，有效克服了传统方法跨数据集泛化能力差的顽疾，在多领域基准测试中展现出卓越性能。

title: Technical Report: One-Step Drifting Action Heads for GR00T N1.7
comments: For code and test result, see https://github.com/RealManShao/lerobot/tree/feat/drif-ov. For trained checkpoint, see https://huggingface.co/Xihe666/models
summary: One-step action generation can substantially reduce the inference cost of vision-language-action (VLA) policies, but its effect on closed-loop task success remains an open question. This technical report studies a GR00T N1.7 variant in which the iterative diffusion-transformer action head is replaced by a one-step drifting action head, together with an overlap-conditioned extension for asynchronous chunk replacement. All multi-seed drifting runs were trained on two NVIDIA A800 GPUs. On LIBERO, the action head reduces the mean model-forward time of the action head from approximately $45.3\,\mathrm{ms}$ to $5.0\,\mathrm{ms}$, while the measured backbone-plus-head time falls from approximately $70.0\,\mathrm{ms}$ to $30.6\,\mathrm{ms}$. However, this speedup is accompanied by a systematic reduction in task success. Across three drifting seeds, success is $64.0\pm4.0\%$ on LIBERO-Spatial, $52.0\pm1.0\%$ on LIBERO-Goal, and $26.0\pm2.6\%$ on LIBERO-Long. The low seed variance indicates that the degradation is not explained by random initialization alone. We report the result as a speed--success trade-off rather than an overall improvement, and discuss likely contributing factors including deterministic one-step mode averaging, batch-dependent geometry estimation, long open-loop chunk execution, and the fact that synchronous LIBERO evaluation does not exercise the asynchronous overlap path.
comment: For code and test result, see https://github.com/RealManShao/lerobot/tree/feat/drif-ov. For trained checkpoint, see https://huggingface.co/Xihe666/models

AI.title_translation: 技术报告：针对 GR00T N1.7 的一步式漂移动作头
AI.tldr: 一步式漂移动作头大幅提升了 VLA 策略的推理速度，但代价是任务成功率的系统性下降。
AI.motivation: 一步式动作生成虽然可以显著降低视觉语言动作（VLA）策略的推理成本，但其对闭环任务成功率的具体影响仍然未知，因此本技术报告旨在研究这一问题。
AI.method: 将 GR00T N1.7 中的迭代扩散Transformer动作头替换为一步式漂移动作头，结合用于异步分块替换的重叠条件扩展，并在 LIBERO 基准测试上进行多随机种子训练与评估。
AI.result: 动作头的平均前向传播时间从约 45.3 毫秒降至 5.0 毫秒，整体骨干加头部时间从约 70.0 毫秒降至 30.6 毫秒；但在 LIBERO 上的任务成功率系统性下降（LIBERO-Spatial 为 64.0%，LIBERO-Goal 为 52.0%，LIBERO-Long 为 26.0%）。
AI.conclusion: 一步式漂移动作头虽然能大幅降低计算时间，但会导致系统性的任务成功率下降，表现出典型的速度与成功率权衡关系。
AI.translation: 一步式动作生成可以大幅降低视觉语言动作（VLA）策略的推理成本，但其对闭环任务成功率的影响仍然是一个未知问题。本技术报告研究了 GR00T N1.7 的一个变体，其中迭代扩散变压器动作头被一步式漂移动作头所取代，并辅以用于异步分块替换的重叠条件扩展。所有多种子漂移运行均在两个 NVIDIA A800 GPU 上进行训练。在 LIBERO 上，该动作头将动作头的平均模型前向时间从约 $45.3\,\mathrm{ms}$ 降低到 $5.0\,\mathrm{ms}$，而测得的骨干加头部时间从约 $70.0\,\mathrm{ms}$ 下降到 $30.6\,\mathrm{ms}$。然而，这种加速伴随着任务成功率的系统性下降。在三个漂移随机种子中，LIBERO-Spatial 上的成功率为 $64.0\pm4.0\%$，LIBERO-Goal 上为 $52.0\pm1.0\%$，LIBERO-Long 上为 $26.0\pm2.6\%$。较低的随机种子方差表明，性能下降不能仅用随机初始化来解释。我们将该结果报告为速度与成功率之间的权衡，而非整体性能的提升，并讨论了可能的影响因素，包括确定性的一步式模式平均、依赖批次的几何估计、长时间的开环分块执行，以及同步 LIBERO 评估未测试异步重叠路径的事实。
AI.summary: 本技术报告研究了将 GR00T N1.7 的迭代扩散动作头替换为一步式漂移动作头的效果。研究发现，虽然推理速度大幅提升，但会导致任务成功率系统性下降，并对其中的速度-成功率权衡及可能的影响因素进行了深入讨论。
AI.keywords: 视觉语言动作策略, 一步式动作生成, 扩散Transformer, 推理成本, 任务成功率
AI.comments: 该技术报告探讨了视觉语言动作（VLA）策略中一步式动作生成与迭代扩散Transformer动作头的性能权衡，揭示了极高推理速度背后的任务成功率系统性下降现象，对VLA策略的设计具有重要的启发意义。

title: SSD-LLaMA: SSD-Native Inference for Trillion-Parameter MoE at 1+ Token/s on a Consumer PC
summary: Frontier open-weight language models increasingly use Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures to expand model capacity while activating only a small subset of experts per token. Local inference must nevertheless keep the complete expert pool available, which remains far beyond consumer-grade RAM and VRAM capacity even after quantization. SSDs provide practical capacity at this scale, but turning that capacity into executable model memory requires efficient expert delivery, coordinated management of SSD, RAM, and VRAM, and CPU--GPU hybrid execution under bounded bandwidth. We present \textit{SSD-LLaMA}, an SSD-native local MoE inference system that addresses these challenges with an SSD I/O pipeline optimized for expert delivery, a native three-tier storage hierarchy that delivers and retains experts dynamically, and balanced CPU--GPU hybrid execution. \textit{SSD-LLaMA} executes every selected expert without pruning or substitution. Across three frontier MoE model families, \textit{SSD-LLaMA} improves prefill token rate by 1.52$\times$--4.19$\times$ and decode token rate by 2.10$\times$--15.58$\times$ over the evaluated baselines. We also achieve higher than 1 token/s for running trillion-parameter model with a single RTX 5090 and no more than 32GB RAM.

AI.tldr: SSD-LLaMA是一个创新的本地MoE推理系统，能在单张消费级显卡和32GB内存的普通PC上，以超过1 token/s的速度运行万亿参数的MoE模型。
AI.motivation: 前沿开源大语言模型越来越多地采用混合专家（MoE）架构来扩展容量，但完整的专家池超出了消费级RAM和VRAM的容量，需要在有限带宽下利用SSD容量实现高效的本地推理。

title: A Comprehensive Review of Generative Physical Artificial Intelligence
summary: The integration of large-scale foundation models with physical embodiments has led to significant advancements in robotics known as Generative Physical Artificial Intelligence (GPAI). These agentic AI systems autonomously perceive, reason, and act in complex real-world situations. This survey comprehensively analyzes GPAI systems, focusing on their architectural foundations, current applications, and key limitations. We introduce a taxonomy of five distinct approaches: Robot Foundation Models (RFMs) for cross-platform skill transfer; Vision-Language Action (VLA) models for end-to-end multi-modal perception and control; Large Behavior Models (LBMs) for human-like movement generation; Diffusion Policy Models (DPMs) for diffusion model-based temporally coherent action generation; and World Foundation Models (WFMs) for physics-compliant simulation and data generation. We examine how these approaches complement each other: WFMs generate training data for VLAs and DPMs, RFMs enable cross-platform deployment of learned policies, while LBMs provide motion priors for natural behavior. Through examples across autonomous vehicles, industrial automation, healthcare robotics, and humanoid systems, we identify significant performance improvements and summarize promising research directions in data-efficient learning, sim-to-real transfer, edge-compatible architectures, and safety frameworks. These insights advance embodied AI for IoT-connected environments where intelligent agents interact with networked sensors, actuators, and edge devices.

AI.title_translation: 生成式物理人工智能综合综述
AI.tldr: 本文对结合大模型与物理实体的生成式物理人工智能（GPAI）进行了全面综述，提出了五大核心方法分类，并探讨了其应用、局限与未来研究方向。
AI.motivation: 大规模基础模型与物理实体的结合推动了机器人技术的重大进步，即生成式物理人工智能（GPAI），本文旨在对这一领域进行全面综述，分析其架构基础、当前应用和关键局限性。
AI.method: 本文对GPAI系统进行了全面分析，提出了包含机器人基础模型（RFMs）、视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型、大规模行为模型（LBMs）、扩散策略模型（DPMs）和世界基础模型（WFMs）的五种方法分类法，并探讨了它们的互补关系及在多个领域的应用。
AI.result: 通过对自动驾驶、工业自动化、医疗机器人和人形系统等应用实例的分析，发现GPAI带来了显著的性能提升，并总结了数据高效学习、仿真到真实迁移、边缘兼容架构及安全框架等有前景的研究方向。
AI.conclusion: GPAI通过结合大模型与物理实体展示了巨大的应用潜力，未来的研究方向将集中在数据高效学习、仿真到真实世界的迁移、边缘计算架构以及安全框架等方面。
AI.translation: 大规模基础模型与物理实体的结合推动了机器人技术的重大进步，这被称为生成式物理人工智能（GPAI）。这些智能代理系统能够在复杂的现实世界中自主感知、推理和行动。本综述全面分析了GPAI系统，重点关注其架构基础、当前应用和关键局限性。我们引入了五种不同方法的分类法：用于跨平台技能迁移的机器人基础模型（RFMs）；用于端到端多模态感知和控制的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型；用于类人运动生成的大规模行为模型（LBMs）；用于基于扩散模型的时间相干动作生成的扩散策略模型（DPMs）；以及用于符合物理规律的仿真和数据生成的世界基础模型（WFMs）。我们研究了这些方法如何相辅相成：WFMs为VLAs和DPMs生成训练数据，RFMs实现学习策略的跨平台部署，而LBMs为自然行为提供运动先验。通过在自动驾驶、工业自动化、医疗机器人和人形系统中的实例，我们确定了显著的性能提升，并总结了在数据高效学习、仿真到真实迁移、边缘兼容架构以及安全框架方面的有前景的研究方向。这些见解推动了物联网连接环境中的具身智能，使智能代理能够与网络化的传感器、执行器和边缘设备进行交互。
AI.summary: 本文全面综述了生成式物理人工智能（GPAI），提出了五种核心方法的分类体系，探讨了它们的协同作用及在自动驾驶、工业、医疗和人形机器人等领域的应用，并展望了未来的研究方向。
AI.keywords: 生成式物理人工智能, 具身智能, 机器人基础模型, 视觉-语言-动作模型, 世界基础模型
AI.comments: 该综述全面梳理了生成式物理人工智能（GPAI）这一具身智能的前沿方向，提出了清晰的五种分类方法，并探讨了它们之间的互补性与应用前景，具有很高的学术参考价值。

title: Token Latency Fairness: Performance Isolation for Multi-Tenant LLM Serving
summary:
LLM serving is typically offered as a shared, multi-tenant service, where high-demand workloads from one client can cause latency SLO violations for others. Existing solutions for performance isolation equalize client throughput in the long run, for example through queueing and batching fairness. However, these approaches do not provide latency isolation guarantees; as a result, well-behaved clients can still experience significant degradation to their token-level latencies.
  In this paper, we present FairInference, which provides the novel δ-token fairness guarantee: for a well-behaved client, if a token is generated in d time units in isolation, it will be generated within d + δ time units in multi-tenant execution, providing strong latency isolation guarantees for LLM serving. To achieve this, FairInference addresses a key challenge of LLM serving: bounding delays from sharing GPU resources without support for fine-grained scheduling or resource allocation. In FairInference, the scheduler enforces per-token deadlines, while bounding the delays from GPU compute sharing and accounting for the additional delays introduced by the shared KV caching in GPU memory. We show that FairInference effectively bounds token-level latency spikes for well-behaved clients and improves overall throughput compared to state-of-the-art LLM serving systems.

title: Sliding Mode Control of Cardiac Rhythms in the Sinoatrial Node using Gaussian Process Regression
summary: The Sinoatrial node (SA), also called natural pacemaker, is responsible to initiate the heart electrical activity, usually represented by electrocardiograms (ECGs). Abnormalities at the SA node can produce disordered heart rhythms or, in other words, cardiac arrhythmia that are visualized in the ECGs. The development of control strategies to stabilize the cardiac rhythm at the natural pacemaker can provide efficient ways to deal with and avoid some heart pathology. This paper investigates the use of a robust controller based on sliding modes for cardiac rhythms at the SA node in order to induce normal rhythms from pathological responses. Embedded into this controller, a Gaussian process regressor is utilized to predict and compensate modeling uncertainties and disturbances. A mathematical model that presents close agreement with experimental measurements is employed to represent the heart functioning. The adopted model comprises a network of oscillators formed by sinoatrial node, atrioventricular node (AV) and His-Purkinje complex (HP). Three nonlinear oscillators are employed to represent each one of the nodes that are connected by delayed couplings. The boudedness and convergence properties are investigated with a Lyapunov-like stability analysis. In order to evaluate the ability of the control law to deal with interpatient variability, the heart model is assumed to be not available to the controller designer, being used only in the simulator to assess the control performance. The results show that, by applying the proposed control scheme, abnormal rhythms can be avoided, turning the ECG closer to the expected normal behavior and preventing critical cardiac responses.

title: OpenDexGrasp: Open-vocabulary Task-Oriented Dexterous Grasping
summary: Dexterous grasp synthesis has advanced rapidly in generating stable and physically plausible hand poses, but real-world manipulation requires grasps that preserve the function implied by the task. We study open-vocabulary task-oriented dexterous grasp generation, where a robot must infer functional intent from free-form language, ground it in multi-view visual observations and object geometry, and generate an executable high-degree-of-freedom grasp. We present OpenDexGrasp, a unified data and generative modeling framework for this setting. OpenDexVerse provides dual-source supervision organized by the Coverage-to-Alignment (C2A) Recipe: OpenDex-Scale offers large-scale semantic and geometric coverage through automatic grasp synthesis and vision-language annotation, while OpenDex-Align supplies high-quality embodied alignment through human teleoperation and category-level transfer. OpenDexGrasp learns a shared perception-action latent representation that couples open-vocabulary vision-language context with dexterous action generation. Affordance grounding and grasp generation provide complementary supervision over this latent space, enabling direct generation of task-consistent dexterous grasps without a separate affordance-to-pose inference stage. Extensive simulation and real-robot experiments demonstrate improved functional alignment, physical feasibility, generalization to unseen categories, and real-world execution success. Additional details and videos are available at https://opendexgrasp.github.io/.

title: Fetch My Beer: Synthetic-to-real Hierarchical Policy for Smooth Pick-and-place
comments: 8 pages, 4 figures. Accepted by IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L)
summary: Many real-world robotic applications require dynamically sensitive manipulation, where success depends not only on reaching a target state but on maintaining stable object dynamics throughout execution. We study the stable transport of liquid-filled containers, where a robot must move objects to target locations while suppressing sloshing and preventing spillage. Unlike conventional pick-and-place, this task imposes stringent requirements on motion smoothness and trajectory-level stability, exposing clear limitations in existing systems. Specifically, fluid simulation remains too costly for online reinforcement learning; human teleoperation introduces unintended accelerations that induce sloshing during imitation learning; and current policy pipelines optimize for task completion rather than dynamic stability. We propose a synthetic-to-real framework coupling physically validated data generation with a hierarchical, diffusion-based controller. The scalable data pipeline synthesizes grasps, filters unstable poses via a vision-language model, and validates transport trajectories through fluid simulation. The policy is organized with a high-level module that translates language and visual observations into SE(3) control targets, and a latent diffusion controller that first plans efficiently in a compact latent space and then decodes dense action chunks, enabling the high control frequency needed for smooth and stable motion. Extensive experiments show our system outperforms state-of-the-art manipulation policies in transport smoothness and dynamic stability. Our project page: https://fetch-my-beer.github.io/

title: PentestChain: A Cost-Aware, MCP-Orchestrated Framework for Automated Penetration Testing with Free-Tier LLMs
summary: AI-driven penetration testing has been demonstrated with premium frontier models such as GPT-4, but the per-engagement token cost makes continuous, automated testing unaffordable for the smaller organisations that need it most. This paper presents PentestChain, a ten-phase automated penetration testing framework that couples a curated, deterministic exploit map with a cost-aware AI cascade-a local Ollama model (qwen2.5-7b) first, then free-tier OpenRouter and Cerebras, with a rule-based fallback that always produces output-and exposes the full pipeline through a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server with eleven tools. We make three contributions. First, we treat US-dollar cost per engagement as a measured, first-class evaluation metric and show that a 7B-parameter local model, kept off the critical path by a deterministic backbone, sustains end-to-end operation at zero measured paid-API cost. Second, we analyse the attack surface that an MCP-exposed offensive engine introduces, grounding a four-position threat model in the 2025 MCP incident record (the CVE-2025-6514 remote-code-execution flaw in mcp-remote, the postmark-mcp supply-chain backdoor, and the tool-poisoning-rug-pull-line-jumping class), and contribute four mitigations. title: "Your Robot Was Trained on a Lie": Collision Mesh Poisoning Attacks on Robotic Manipulation
summary: Learning-enabled robotic manipulation increasingly relies on robot simulators for policy training and evaluation before real-world deployment. Inside a simulator, a 3D asset contains two separate geometries: a visual mesh used for rendering and a collision mesh used for physical interaction. For computational efficiency, the collision mesh is deliberately a coarse approximation that need not have the same geometry as the visual mesh, a legitimate and pervasive discrepancy we call the Visual--Collision Gap (V--C Gap). We show that the V--C Gap opens a new and practical attack surface, and propose Collision Mesh Poisoning (CMP), the first poisoning attack against robotic manipulation delivered through the 3D asset supply chain. An attacker modifies only the collision mesh of a 3D asset, leaving the visual mesh and all other components unchanged. A policy trained and evaluated with the poisoned asset behaves normally throughout simulation, yet degrades, fails, or creates physical safety risks once deployed in the real world. Since current asset review practices cover malware, copyright, and format compliance, but not visual--collision consistency, poisoned assets can be distributed through legitimate supply chain channels. We evaluate several defenses and our results show that they are insufficient to defend against CMP, highlighting the need for new defenses.

title: AutoTuneBench: Trustworthy Measurement for Agent Auto-Tuning of LLM Serving Engines
comments: 15 pages, 7 tables, 6 figures. Code and measurement corpus: https://github.com/li-ch/autotunebench (tag v1.0.0)
summary: Large language model agents tune GPU kernels and serving engines through a closed loop of propose, measure, and keep, but the measurements behind this loop are not trustworthy. We characterize four failure modes from a four-day pilot corpus of 619 model calls: strawman baselines manufacture speedups, absolute times do not transfer across machines, saturated tasks nullify comparisons, and infrastructure defects impersonate science. We present AutoTuneBench, a benchmark and measurement protocol that makes trust architectural. The protocol is frozen as code with test-enforced provenance; a database-level validator rejects out-of-protocol results; anti-cheat checks run outside the agent's modification surface; comparisons follow pre-registered readouts; and measurements anchor to externally published results, grounded in paired-seed statistics with a 5\% cross-run coefficient-of-variation cap. Honest measurement rewrites the headlines: our best kernel reads 10.6x against a naive baseline but 2.03x against the honest one; one configuration delivers 1.174x on one machine and 1.0049x on another; a pre-registered on/off comparison nulls at a shared wall (2.4840 vs 2.4957\,ms); and the KernelBench Level-1 suite admits 51\% of tasks with median speedup 1.0001x over PyTorch eager. The protocol, the two-engine corpus (vLLM and SGLang), and its audit trail are released as open artifacts.

title: Aligned Consensus Teaching for Label-Efficient Oriented Object Detection in Weakly-Aligned Visible-Infrared Imagery
summary: Visible-infrared object detection (VIOD) detects objects with oriented bounding boxes from paired visible and infrared images. Existing methods depend on costly dual-modality annotations. Semi-supervised learning can reduce this burden, but extending it from single-modal detection to VIOD is challenging. In the practical image-pair-level setting considered here, only a few pairs are labeled in both modalities, while the rest are completely unlabeled. This limited supervision creates three challenges: (i) too few labeled boxes for robust cross-modal alignment; (ii) pseudo-label errors caused by branch-wise misses accumulate during self-training; and (iii) tail-class annotations become critically scarce as the labeling budget decreases. We propose Aligned Consensus Teacher (ACT) for label-efficient VIOD in this setting. Its Cycle-Consistent Region Alignment (CRA) combines cycle consistency and sparse anchors with reliability-weighted regional matching. Cross-Modal Consensus Mean-Teacher (CMC-MT) forms consensus pseudo labels under pair-preserving views to recover branch-wise misses and supervise unlabeled pairs. Text-Guided Cross-Modal Instance Augmentation (TG-CMIA) uses a vision-language scene prior to compose tail-class instance pairs while preserving RGB--IR offsets. To the best of our knowledge, ACT is the first framework to study semi-supervised VIOD under this image-pair-level setting. Experiments on DroneVehicle and VEDAI show consistent gains across annotation ratios. With 10\% labeled pairs on DroneVehicle, ACT reaches 94.3\% of the mAP obtained by the same detector under full supervision. Code and models will be available on GitHub to facilitate future work.

title: PRISM: Predictive Representation of Interaction Style and Motion for Social Robot Navigation
comments: ECCV 2026 Workshop on Agent in World
summary: Humans often observe others before interacting and adjust their behavior accordingly. Robot navigation in crowds, however, often represents pedestrians mainly by observed geometric states, leaving individual differences in interaction tendencies implicit. We propose PRISM (Predictive Representation of Interaction Style and Motion), a framework that infers interaction traits from passive observations of human-human interactions. PRISM encodes human trajectories into a continuous ordinal latent space with a transformer encoder trained by Rank-N-Contrast loss, and pairs each inferred trait with a temporal-stability score supplied to the navigation policy. In randomized crowd simulations, PRISM reduces collision rates over the geometry-only baseline and yields small improvements in navigation-time and path-length metrics. These results suggest the utility of passive latent-trait inference for social navigation in dynamic crowds.

title: Designing Agentic AI Workflow Portfolios under Imperfect Selection and Compute Cost
summary: Agentic AI systems often approach the same task through multiple workflows that differ in reasoning strategy, verification structure, and compute cost. A natural deployment policy is to use the workflow with the highest average performance, but this can be suboptimal because different workflows may succeed on different instances. We study a portfolio-and-selector paradigm in which a firm runs multiple workflow executions and selects the final answer after observing their outputs. Additional executions may uncover correct answers that the best standalone workflow misses, but they consume compute and introduce plausible distractors that complicate final selection. We formulate this as a workflow portfolio problem in which the firm jointly chooses run size and allocation across workflow types. We summarize selector quality through an odds-lift index and derive sharp bounds on the value of workflow variety. For finite workflow pools, we develop exact formulations, linear programming relaxations, randomized rounding procedures, and computable performance certificates. For large implicit workflow classes, we derive a finite-dimensional dual and an ellipsoid method using a pricing oracle to identify workflows with high weighted accuracy net of recurring compute cost. Under a weak condition, the method obtains a near-optimal solution to the relaxation with polynomially many oracle calls. We evaluate the framework on three datasets: ABCD, Schema-Guided Dialogue, and HotpotQA. Relative to the best standalone workflow, portfolio optimization improves held-out selector accuracy by 3.1, 7.5, and 0.9 percentage points, respectively. Dual-guided workflow generation adds 3.5 points on ABCD and 24.1 on HotpotQA, with no additional gain on Schema-Guided Dialogue.

title: Learning Fractional-Order Dynamics from a Single Trajectory
summary: Many real-world processes exhibit long-range dependence, where the current state depends on a slowly decaying trace of past states rather than on the most recent state alone. This paper studies system identification for discrete-time fractional-order linear time-invariant systems from a single observed trajectory of length $t$, a setting that captures such non-Markovian dynamics through the Grünwald--Letnikov difference operator. Unlike Markovian systems, fractional-order systems couple estimation across the entire history, making both statistical analysis and practical identification more challenging. We propose \emph{Fractional-Order Ordinary-Least-Squares Grid-Search (FO-GS)}, a simple two-stage estimator that exploits the diagonal structure of the fractional-difference operator to decouple the identification problem row-wise. Under the stability assumption, we establish high-probability, non-asymptotic error bounds for estimating both the fractional order and the system matrix in the heterogeneous setting, with both estimation errors scaling as \(\mathcal{O}(t^{-1/2})\). Through experiments, we show that \emph{FO-GS} outperforms existing baselines in recovering both the fractional order and the underlying system dynamics.

title: Symbolic Temporal Supervision of LLM Agents Using Contracts
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents augmented by tools can automate complex, multi-step tasks, such as web navigation, code generation, and workflow orchestration, by acting on external systems through tool calls. However, hallucinations, distributional instability, and adversarial manipulations in LLMs, and the irreversible consequences of certain tool calls can lead to harmful outcomes. Existing safeguards either grade recorded trajectories post hoc with stochastic LLM judges or block unsafe actions one call at a time, and no single deterministic artifact supports both roles. We present ContrAgent, a contract-based framework for symbolic temporal supervision of LLM agents. ContrAgent captures an agent's behavior as a sequence of tool calls and formalizes it as a trace over a fixed set of checkable predicates. It then specifies required behaviors using assume-guarantee contracts in linear temporal logic over finite traces (LTLf). Each contract is compiled to a deterministic finite automaton (DFA) that serves two roles: gating agent actions online and evaluating recorded traces offline. A contract library, acting as a reusable knowledge base, is maintained independently of the agent's model and can be applied across different agents within the same task domain. We show the effectiveness of our approach on four benchmarks spanning both roles, where ContrAgent matches state-of-the-art LLM-judge and rule-based guardrail baselines while producing deterministic, reproducible verdicts and, in the online mode, orders-of-magnitude lower per-call latency.

title: MCLC-NET: Multimodal Continual Learning for Leaf Counting
summary: Leaf counting is an important task in plant phenotyping for monitoring plant growth and estimating crop yield. Most existing methods rely on RGB images, but their performance is often affected by occlusion, lighting variations, and other real-world challenges. Additional modalities, such as depth and thermal images, can provide useful complementary information. However, multimodal leaf counting remains underexplored. Also, many existing methods assume that all training data are available simultaneously, which is impractical in real agricultural settings, where data is collected over time from multiple sources. To address these challenges, we propose MCLC-NET, a multimodal continual learning framework for leaf counting. It learns tasks sequentially using a memory-based strategy with a memory buffer to retain important samples from previous tasks. We also introduce MMLC, a real-world multimodal leaf-counting dataset designed for a domain incremental scenario (DIS) in CL. It contains RGB, depth, and thermal images collected across different crop types under varying environmental conditions, arranged in three orderings: crop-wise, time-wise, and mixed. Experimental results, averaged over three random seeds, demonstrate that MCLC-NET consistently outperforms existing methods across all three task orderings, achieving the lowest AMSE of 0.675$\pm$0.027, 0.542$\pm$0.069, and 0.745$\pm$0.057, respectively.

title: Benchmarking Tabular Foundation Models as Surrogates in Expensive Evolutionary Optimization
summary: Surrogate-assisted evolutionary algorithms (SAEAs) are effective methods for solving expensive optimization problems (EOPs), where surrogate models replace most expensive evaluations and critically influence the final optimization results. In recent years, tabular foundation models have advanced rapidly, and the Tabular Prior-data Fitted Network (TabPFN) has been adopted as a surrogate model for EOPs due to its strong predictive capability, demonstrating promising performance. Motivated by its potential as a surrogate model in SAEAs, this work conducts a comprehensive study that combines extensive experiments with in-depth theoretical analysis to investigate the effectiveness of TabPFN. Specifically, we perform experiments across both offline and online SAEA settings, covering diverse problem scenarios such as single-objective, multi-objective, constrained, combinatorial, mixed-variable, and engineering optimization problems. In addition, we further analyze the advantages and limitations of TabPFN within SAEAs and provide practical guidelines for its application in different optimization settings. Results show that the effectiveness of TabPFN is highly problem dependent, and it cannot replace conventional surrogates universally. Overall, TabPFN should be adopted selectively according to data availability, landscape complexity, search space characteristics, and its role within the algorithm. Customized model management strategies and role-specific algorithm design are necessary to fully exploit its advantages and avoid its pitfalls.

title: Colla-Q: Toward Collaborative Experts in MoE Quantization via Minimax Precision Balancing
comments: Accepted by the Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (EMNLP) 2026
summary: In this paper, we present a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) quantization method based on activation entropy. Although quantization reduces memory and computational costs, it can substantially degrade performance. In particular, performance decline is pronounced in quantized MoE models, where individual experts have a small number of parameters that are sensitive to low-bit representation. Considering that MoE operates as an ensemble model with collaborative contributions from routed experts, a significant performance decline of a particular expert due to quantization can harm model performance. Therefore, we propose Colla-Q, a bit-allocation framework to maintain balanced performance across experts through an activation-entropy-based bit-width allocation algorithm. This approach encourages each expert to operate collaboratively in the quantized model, thereby 1) improving the overall MoE performance and 2) reducing the dependence on the calibration dataset. Since uniformly adjusting each expert's performance facilitates robustness and stability of the MoE model, the proposed MoE quantization method can generalize more consistently across different calibration datasets. Our code is available at: https://github.com/mmai-laboratory/Colla_Q

title: Hidden Circuits and Exact Counting in Ordered Graphs
summary: We prove that counting perfect matchings is $\#P$-complete under polynomial-time Turing reductions on each of three classes of simple, unweighted graphs: monotone graphs, unit interval graphs, and chordal permutation graphs. The monotone result settles the exact-counting complexity left open by Dyer, Jerrum, and Müller (JACM 2017), complementing their rapid-mixing theorem. Inspired by quantum circuits, our reductions implement a circuit simulation using globally coupled matching-transfer operators. The key construction is an exact projection, implemented by a polynomial-length sequence of normalized transfers, that restores tensor-product locality and makes encoded gates composable. Interpolation-based cancellation then reduces circuit evaluation to unweighted perfect-matching counts in all three classes. We also place Dyer and Müller's class QChains within the distance-hereditary graphs and give an $O(n^2)$-arithmetic-operation counting algorithm for the latter, improving the $O(n^4)$ bound obtainable from Curticapean and Marx (SODA 2016). Together with prior results, these advances complete the exact-counting classification of the graph classes in Dyer and Müller's diagram (SIDMA 2019).

title: Stealthy in Semantics, Antagonistic in Space: Attacking Visible-Infrared Object Detectors via Object-Level Misalignment
summary: Visible-infrared object detectors are used for robust perception under challenging illumination and weather conditions. Current physical attacks apply conspicuous patches to spatially aligned target regions, which are noticeable to human observers. Meanwhile, most of these methods only perturb the appearance within the aligned region, without explicitly targeting the correspondence between modalities or the fusion process. In this paper, we propose CamoShift, an adversarial framework for visible-infrared object detection. By combining visual camouflage with object-level infrared shifting, CamoShift breaks cross-modal spatial alignment and disrupts fusion. Specifically, the Semantic Camouflage Module (SCM) generates a stealthy camouflaged patch that can be attached to the host object and maintains its effectiveness in the infrared branch through an RGB-IR adapter. The Object-level Spatial Decoupling Module (OSDM) shifts the infrared target evidence in a scale-aware manner, so as to break object-level correspondence and disrupt cross-modal fusion. Then, the Harmonic Adversarial loss (HarAdv loss) further balances attack strength and visual stealth during optimization. To the best of our knowledge, we are the first to target both visual stealthiness and attack success in visible-infrared object detection. Extensive experimental results show that CamoShift achieves a superior balance between attack effectiveness and visual stealth. Code and models will be available on GitHub.

title: Rethinking How We Evaluate Methodological Progress in Health AI
summary: Methodological progress in artificial intelligence (AI) for electronic health records (EHRs) depends on our ability to determine which algorithms work better, and under which conditions. However, such progress is thought to be hindered by difficulties in reproducibility and in defining clinically meaningful evaluation tasks. We empirically study these barriers by re-implementing 12 historical and recent algorithms within a shared evaluation framework and evaluating them on two clinical datasets, MIMIC-IV and NWICU. We compare two complementary task families: expert-authored clinically meaningful tasks and generated tasks defined from randomly sampled event codes and prediction horizons. We ask whether relative algorithms comparisons transfer across task families and datasets, whether residual task heterogeneity contains useful methodological structure, and what a controlled comparison reveals about progress over the last decade. We find that aggregate pairwise comparisons transfer strongly across evaluation settings, including from randomly generated tasks to clinically meaningful tasks and across datasets. At the same time, clinically meaningful tasks exhibit greater task-method interaction, providing preliminary evidence that task properties can help explain when particular modeling choices are advantageous. Finally, newer algorithms do not consistently outperform earlier approaches: gradient-boosted trees remain highly competitive when paired with a modern, wide and sparse representation of the EHR. Together, these results suggest that useful methodological knowledge may require less task engineering than commonly assumed, while highlighting the importance of understanding the structured heterogeneity that remains across tasks and methods.

title: DualSQL: Text-to-SQL with Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
summary: State-of-the-art Text-to-SQL systems are typically multi-agent pipelines centered around two fundamental tasks: schema linking and SQL generation. However, existing work trains separate models for each task, failing to leverage the synergy between these interrelated tasks. In this work, we propose DualSQL, a new Text-to-SQL system consisting of two agents powered by a single model backbone. The agents share the same model weights and agentic scaffold, enabling joint optimization through a robust multi-agent reinforcement learning (RL) framework. We design three database access tools to facilitate effective multi-step reasoning grounded to interactions with the databases. To improve training and avoid model collapse, we introduce a set of rollout guardrail mechanisms that stabilizes multi-agent RL training, supporting DualSQL to keep improving during training. We also introduce a new SQL correctness metric, robust execution match (REX), to more accurately judge SQL correctness and assign reward signals. Being trained on only 3755 examples, DualSQL-4B achieves an impressive 68.0% execution accuracy on the BIRD development set, matching previous 7B models. DualSQL-8B further improves to 71.1%, outperforming previous state-of-the-art single-model solutions with 32B parameters. These results demonstrate the strength of joint multi-agent reinforcement learning for building high performance Text-to-SQL pipelines.

title: Multi-View Mixture-of-Experts with Vision-Language Reranking for Cross-View Object Geo-Localization
summary: Cross-view object geo-localization (CVOGL) locates a target in satellite imagery using drone or street-view queries. Existing methods train separate detectors for each viewpoint, leading to parameter redundancy and impeding cross-view knowledge sharing. Moreover, top-ranked satellite candidates are often visually similar, so visual appearance and categorical labels alone are insufficient to resolve such ambiguity. To address these, we propose MVLGeo, an efficient framework designed to unify multiple viewpoints and reduce model redundancy. First, we introduce environmental contextual text from the query view as cues to distinguish visually similar candidates via Vision-Language Reranking (VL-Rerank). Second, we design a multi-view Mixture-of-Experts architecture (MV-MoE) with a shared encoder and view-specific experts to reduce redundancy and promote knowledge sharing, while cross-view contrastive learning aligns their representations for consistency. Third, we introduce an adaptive elliptical prior (ESAM-Prior) as auxiliary positional encoding for anisotropic geometric perception. Extensive experiments on the CVOGL benchmarks confirm that MVLGeo, as a unified model for multiple query viewpoints, achieves state-of-the-art performance, demonstrating robustness to input degradation and generalization across viewpoints. Code and models will be available on GitHub to facilitate future work.

AI.title_translation: 基于多视角混合专家与视觉-语言重排序的跨视角目标地理定位
AI.tldr: MVLGeo通过多视角混合专家（MV-MoE）、视觉-语言重排序（VL-Rerank）及自适应椭圆先验，构建了一个能够统一处理多视角查询并达到SOTA的跨视角目标地理定位模型。
AI.motivation: 现有的跨视角目标地理定位方法需为无人机或街景等不同视角单独训练检测器，导致参数冗余且阻碍了视角间知识共享；同时卫星图像候选目标外观相似度高，仅凭视觉外观和类别标签难以消除歧义。

AI.result: 在CVOGL基准测试上的大量实验表明，统一的MVLGeo模型取得了最先进（SOTA）性能，展现出对输入退化的鲁棒性以及强大的跨视角泛化能力。

AI.keywords: 跨视角目标地理定位, 混合专家模型, 视觉-语言重排序, 对比学习, 椭圆先验
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于打破了传统为每个视角单独训练模型的低效做法，利用MoE结构实现了无人机和街景查询视角的参数统一与知识共享；同时引入视觉-语言重排序机制，利用文本上下文信息弥补纯视觉检索在相似目标上的判别力不足。局限性在于，摘要中未明确说明环境上下文文本的获取方式（例如是人工标注还是依靠大语言/多模态模型生成），文本质量可能会直接影响重排序效果。

title: Reaching Every Position Without Searching: Rotating Sparse Wiring on the Hypercube as a Substitute for Attention
summary: Attention pays, at every layer and for every input, the cost of searching for whom to connect. We ask how far one can get with wiring that is fixed, sparse, and simply rotated from layer to layer. Treating the $n$ positions of a sequence as the vertices of a $\log_2 n$-dimensional hypercube and connecting each position, at layer $\ell$, to its neighbour along dimension $\ell \bmod \log_2 n$, information from every position reaches every other in $\log_2 n$ layers with $2n$ links per layer instead of $n^2$. On a synthetic task that is unsolvable unless all positions are reached, this rotation matches all-to-all wiring at $1/32$ of the links, while the same sparse pattern held fixed across layers fails; what matters is that every dimension is touched, not the order. On character-level language modelling of a public corpus (the first $12$M characters of enwik8), a hybrid that keeps two attention layers among sixteen sparse ones reaches $0.06$ bits-per-character lower held-out loss than a fully attentive model of the same width at the same step budget (three seeds each, no overlap), with $1/7$ of the links, $42\%$ fewer parameters, and $2.4\times$ less wall-clock time; the purely rotated schedule is level with the hybrid. The same ordering holds on a second corpus of mixed Japanese, English and code, where the gap widens to $0.16$. The usable learning-rate window is four to eight times wider than attention's on both. We also report what did not work - learned coordinates, and a "dynamics" variant whose apparent gains turned out to be an artefact of a saturated kernel - and the measurement discipline (frozen corpus, full-coverage evaluation, seed spread as the bar for ranking) that we found necessary to say anything at all at this scale.

AI.title_translation: 无需搜索即可触达每个位置：超立方体旋转稀疏布线作为注意力的替代方案
AI.tldr: 提出利用超立方体维度逐层旋转的固定稀疏连接替代全注意力机制，以1/7连接数和2.4倍加速在语言建模上超越标准注意力。
AI.motivation: 传统注意力机制在每一层和每一个输入上都需要付出搜索全连接关系的二次方计算代价（n^2），本研究探索能否通过每层轮换的固定稀疏布线来替代昂贵的动态注意力搜索。
AI.method: 将长度为n的序列位置视为log_2 n维超立方体的顶点；在第l层中，每个位置仅与其在第(l mod log_2 n)维上的邻居建立连接，使得每层仅需2n条连接，并在log_2 n层内实现任意两位置间的信息可达。
AI.result: 在合成任务中以1/32的连接数达到全连接效果；在enwik8字符级建模中，混合模型在连接数仅为1/7、参数减少42%、耗时减少2.4倍的情况下，留出损失比全注意力模型降低0.06 bpc（纯旋转方案与混合方案持平）；在混合日文、英文与代码的语料上性能优势扩大到0.16 bpc；两项任务中可用学习率窗口均比注意力机制宽4至8倍。
AI.conclusion: 无需通过注意力机制动态搜索连接对象，仅依靠基于超立方体维度的分层旋转静态稀疏布线，就能以极低的连接数和参数量实现全位置信息交互，并取得优于全注意力模型的性能与计算效率。
AI.translation: 注意力机制在每一层并针对每个输入都需要承担搜索连接对象的计算代价。我们探讨了如果采用在各层之间简单轮换的固定稀疏布线，能够达到怎样的效果。将序列的n个位置视作log_2 n维超立方体的顶点，并在第l层将每个位置与其在维度(l mod log_2 n)上的邻居相连，来自每个位置的信息仅需log_2 n层即可到达任意其他位置，且每层仅需2n条连接，而非n^2条。在一项只有触达所有位置才可解的合成任务上，这种旋转连接以1/32的连接数达到了全连接布线的效果，而在层间保持固定不变的稀疏模式则以失败告终；其关键在于触达了每个维度，而与顺序无关。在公开语料（enwik8的前1200万字符）的字符级语言建模任务中，在16层中保留2层注意力层的混合模型在相同步数预算下（各3个随机种子，无重叠），比同宽度的全注意力模型留出损失降低了0.06 bpc，同时连接数仅为1/7，参数量减少42%，物理耗时缩短2.4倍；纯旋转布线方案与混合方案表现相当。在第二个包含日文、英文和代码的混合语料库中，该优势进一步扩大至0.16 bpc。在这两项任务中，该方案的可用学习率窗口均比注意力机制宽4到8倍。我们还报告了未取得预期效果的尝试——可学习坐标，以及一个表观增益实为核函数饱和伪影的“动态”变体——以及我们发现在此规模下得出有效结论所必须的严谨测量准则（冻结语料库、全覆盖评估、以种子离散度作为排序基准）。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种基于超立方体维度的逐层旋转稀疏布线机制作为注意力的替代方案。该方法每层仅使用2n条连接并在log_2 n层内实现全序列信息传递，在合成任务和字符级语言建模实验中均以大幅减少的参数量、更快的运行速度和更宽的学习率容忍度超越了传统全注意力模型。
AI.keywords: 稀疏注意力, 超立方体拓扑, 序列建模, 计算效率, 语言模型
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地将超立方体拓扑结构引入序列建模，提出了一种无需学习或搜索相关性的旋转稀疏连接机制。其最大亮点在于证明了通过极其简单的几何拓扑轮换（每层仅2n条连接），即可在log_2 n层内实现全位置信息互通，并在语言建模任务上超越全注意力基线，同时大幅降低计算与参数成本，显著放宽学习率敏感度。局限性在于其主要在字符级语言建模与较小规模语料（12M字符）上进行了验证，在更大规模预训练模型（如LLM）和长上下文任务中的扩展性与有效性仍待进一步检验。

title: LIGE-GR: A Smooth Leap from Ranking to Generative Recommendation in the LLM Era
summary:
The remarkable success of large language models (LLMs) has provided important inspiration for the next generation of recommender systems. Structurally, recommendation and language generation share a similarity: both aim to produce an ordered sequence that optimizes the user's experience. However, how to precisely absorb the essence of the LLM paradigm into mature industrial recommender systems remains an open problem.
  There are two challenges. First, it is unclear how to incorporate sequence-level generation and optimization from the LLM paradigm into recommendation. Second, real-world recommender systems are mature systems that have been iteratively customized for years around specific products, business constraints, serving infrastructure, and organizational ownership. Replacing such systems wholesale is often technically risky and organizationally disruptive.
  In this paper, we propose LIGE-GR, a listwise generation and evaluation recommendation framework that upgrades from a traditional ranking system based on itemwise recommendation toward a generative recommendation paradigm. Instead of rebuilding the entire recommendation stack from scratch, LIGE-GR generalizes the existing pointwise recommendation system into a listwise generation system. This allows mature recommender systems to benefit from listwise optimization while preserving compatibility with existing models, value functions, and serving infrastructure.
  We validate LIGE-GR in short-video recommendation on Instagram Reels and Facebook Video. On these recommendation surfaces, LIGE-GR improves time spent by 1.14 percent on Instagram Reels and 0.72 percent on Facebook Video, while requiring only modest additional inference resources.

AI.title_translation: LIGE-GR：LLM时代从排序向生成式推荐的平滑跨越
AI.tldr: LIGE-GR提出了一种列表级生成与评估推荐框架，可在兼容现有工业推荐基础设施的前提下平滑升级为生成式推荐，并在Instagram Reels和Facebook Video上显著提升了用户时长。
AI.motivation: 尽管大语言模型为下一代推荐系统提供了灵感，但将序列级生成与优化融入推荐系统的方式尚不明确；此外，成熟的工业推荐系统经过多年深度定制，直接全面替换存在巨大的技术风险与组织阻力。
AI.method: 提出LIGE-GR（列表级生成与评估推荐框架），将现有的逐点（pointwise）推荐系统泛化为列表级生成系统，在无需从头重建推荐架构的前提下引入序列级优化，并保持与现有模型、价值函数以及服务基础设施的兼容性。
AI.result: 在Instagram Reels和Facebook Video短视频推荐业务中验证，LIGE-GR仅需少量的额外推理资源，使Instagram Reels的用户使用时长提升了1.14%，使Facebook Video的使用时长提升了0.72%。
AI.conclusion: LIGE-GR成功提供了一种从传统排序向生成式推荐平滑过渡的有效范式，在保障工业系统兼容性的同时显著提升了推荐效果。
AI.translation: 大语言模型（LLM）的巨大成功为下一代推荐系统提供了重要启示。在结构上，推荐与语言生成具有相似性：两者都旨在生成一个能够优化用户体验的有序序列。然而，如何将LLM范式的核心精髓精准地融入成熟的工业推荐系统，仍然是一个悬而未决的难题。这一过程存在两大挑战：首先，如何将LLM范式中的序列级生成与优化引入推荐系统尚不明确；其次，现实世界中的推荐系统非常成熟，经过多年针对特定产品、业务约束、服务基础设施及组织权属的迭代定制，全面替换此类系统通常具有很高的技术风险并会造成组织动荡。在本文中，我们提出了LIGE-GR，一种列表级生成与评估推荐框架，它从基于单项推荐的传统排序系统向生成式推荐范式升级。LIGE-GR没有从头重建整个推荐技术栈，而是将现有的逐点推荐系统泛化为列表级生成系统。这使得成熟的推荐系统能够受益于列表级优化，同时保持与现有模型、价值函数和服务基础设施的兼容性。我们在Instagram Reels和Facebook Video的短视频推荐场景中验证了LIGE-GR。在这些推荐场景上，LIGE-GR仅需要少量的额外推理资源，就使Instagram Reels的用户使用时长提升了1.14%，Facebook Video的使用时长提升了0.72%。
AI.summary: 本文针对工业界推荐系统难以直接全面替换为大模型生成式架构的挑战，提出了LIGE-GR框架。该方案将传统逐项排序系统平滑升级为列表级生成与评估系统，兼容原有基础设施与模型体系。在Instagram Reels和Facebook Video的大规模线上验证中，该方法以适度的额外推理开销分别获得了1.14%和0.72%的用户时长增长。
AI.keywords: 生成式推荐, 列表级生成, 大语言模型, 推荐系统, 排序系统
AI.comments: 该论文针对工业界大模型落地推荐系统的一大核心痛点——全盘推翻现有成熟架构风险高、成本大，提出了一种兼具创新性与工程实用性的平滑过渡方案（LIGE-GR）。其核心价值在于在保留原有模型、价值函数和底层服务设施的同时实现了列表级生成与优化，并在Meta的大规模业务（Instagram Reels和Facebook Video）上取得了显著的用户时长提升，展示了极强的落地可行性与商业价值。

title: Research on the Price Prediction Algorithms of Major Cryptocurrencies and a Basic Transaction Framework
comments: Models capable of generating consistent, stable profits in the real world are far simpler than those described in my article. The conclusions drawn therein apply not only to cryptocurrency markets but to all financial markets. If you do not even know who your opponent is, you will fail to profit in financial markets, and indeed, your life as a whole will likely be just as disastrous
summary: Through long-term observation and time series analysis of Bitcoin and Ethereum, we found the similarity in long-term consistent price trends, especially in the weekly K-line. We denoised and smoothed the historical data of their prices, and further derived the periodicity of their price change trends and the timing of buying and selling. We have for the first time proposed that the full application of central bank digital currencies (CBDC) is a key signal for investors to reduce their holdings of cryptocurrencies or even exit the market. In addition, we proposed momentum opening/closing prices to replace the traditional nominal opening/closing prices to accurately describe the price trends of the 24/7 financial trading market. We found that the cryptocurrency market can be regarded as a relatively independent financial market, thereby designing a safer and more efficient arbitrage strategy.
comment: Models capable of generating consistent, stable profits in the real world are far simpler than those described in my article. The conclusions drawn therein apply not only to cryptocurrency markets but to all financial markets. If you do not even know who your opponent is, you will fail to profit in financial markets, and indeed, your life as a whole will likely be just as disastrous

AI.title_translation: 主流加密货币价格预测算法与基础交易框架研究
AI.tldr: 本文分析了BTC和ETH的长期价格周期与规律，提出动量开闭盘价和基于CBDC的市场信号，并构建了加密货币套利交易框架。
AI.motivation: 针对24/7不间断交易的加密货币市场特性，探索比特币和以太坊长期价格走势规律，克服传统开闭盘价在全天候交易中的局限性，并设计更高效安全的交易与套利框架。
AI.method: 采用长期观察与时间序列分析方法，对比特币和以太坊的历史价格数据进行降噪与平滑处理；提出动量开闭盘价替代传统名义价格，并引入CBDC作为市场决策信号。
AI.result: 发现了比特币和以太坊在周K线等长期趋势上的高度相似性与价格变动周期性，确定了买卖时机；提出了动量开闭盘价并成功设计出更安全高效的套利策略；确立了CBDC全面应用作为减仓或退市的关键信号。
AI.conclusion: 加密货币市场可视为相对独立的金融市场；基于周期性、动量开闭盘价以及CBDC影响信号，能够构建更安全高效的交易与套利策略。
AI.translation: 通过对比特币和以太坊的长期观察和时间序列分析，我们发现它们在长期一致的价格走势上具有相似性，尤其是在周K线上表现明显。我们对它们价格的历史数据进行了降噪和平滑处理，并进一步推导出了其价格变化趋势的周期性以及买卖时机。我们首次提出，央行数字货币（CBDC）的全面应用是投资者减少加密货币持仓甚至退出市场的关键信号。此外，我们提出了动量开盘价/收盘价来替代传统的名义开盘价/收盘价，以准确描述24/7金融交易市场的价格趋势。我们发现加密货币市场可被视为一个相对独立的金融市场，从而设计出了一种更安全、更高效的套利策略。
AI.summary: 本文通过对BTC和ETH的时间序列分析与数据降噪，揭示了其价格长期趋势的相似性与周期性，并提出了动量开闭盘价以适应24/7交易市场。研究首次将CBDC的全面应用定义为投资者减仓或离场的关键信号，并基于加密市场的相对独立性设计了高效安全的套利策略与交易框架。
AI.keywords: 加密货币, 价格预测, 动量开闭盘价, 央行数字货币 (CBDC), 套利策略
AI.comments: 该论文针对全天候交易的加密货币市场提出了动量开闭盘价的概念，具有一定的理论与实践创新性。同时，将央行数字货币（CBDC）视作市场退出信号，并构建相对独立市场下的套利策略，为加密资产投资提供了新的视角。不过，摘要中未提供具体的实证量化收益数据和模型回测细节，其实际稳健性有待进一步验证。

title: The Exact Approximation Ratio of Uniformly Rotated Coordinate-wise Median in the Euclidean Plane
summary: Uniformly rotated coordinate-wise median chooses a random orthonormal coordinate system, takes a median in each coordinate, and maps the resulting point back to the Euclidean plane. We determine its exact worst-case expected approximation ratio when social cost is the $L_p$ norm of the agents' Euclidean distances and $1<p<2$. The ratio is \(\frac{2^{2-1/p}}π\int_0^{π/2}(\cos^pθ+\sin^pθ)^{1/p}\ddθ\). This expression was previously established as a lower bound by Chan, Lin, and Wang; our contribution is the matching upper bound. The proof establishes a strengthened coordinate-wise median inequality relative to an arbitrary reference point. Its right-hand side is linear in a sum of direction-dependent norms, which permits direct averaging over rotations without the loss incurred by passing through a $p$th-moment bound. We give all auxiliary inequalities and a self-contained proof of tightness using the established two-cluster-and-outlier construction. The upper bound holds for every finite profile and every measurable choice within the coordinate median intervals, while odd-size profiles suffice for the matching lower bound. The result characterizes this fixed mechanism, rather than the optimal approximation ratio among all randomized strategyproof mechanisms.

AI.title_translation: 欧几里得平面中均匀旋转坐标中位数的精确近似比
AI.tldr: 本文确定了欧几里得平面中均匀旋转坐标中位数在社会成本为 $L_p$ 范数时（$1<p<2$）的精确最坏情况预期近似比，通过提供匹配的上界来与先前建立的下界吻合。
AI.motivation: 旨在确定欧几里得平面中，当社会成本为代理欧几里得距离的 $L_p$ 范数（$1<p<2$）时，特定机制（均匀旋转坐标中位数）的精确最坏情况预期近似比。具体贡献是为先前已知的下界提供匹配的上界。
AI.method: 通过建立一个相对于任意参考点的强化坐标中位数不等式来确定精确的最坏情况预期近似比。该不等式的右侧在一个方向相关范数之和中是线性的，这允许在旋转上直接平均，而不会因通过 $p$ 阶矩界限而产生损失。论文提供了所有辅助不等式，并使用已建立的两簇-离群点构造给出了一个自洽的紧性证明。
AI.result:
精确的最坏情况预期近似比被确定为 
\(\frac{2^{2-1/p}}π\int_0^{π/2}(\cos^pθ+\sin^pθ)^{1/p}\ddθ\)。
该表达式与Chan、Lin和Wang先前建立的下界相匹配，本文的贡献是匹配的上界。上界适用于每个有限配置文件和坐标中位数区间内的每个可测量选择，而奇数大小的配置文件足以满足匹配的下界。
AI.conclusion: 本文表征了均匀旋转坐标中位数这一固定机制的近似比，而不是寻找所有随机策略证明机制中的最优近似比。
AI.translation: 均匀旋转坐标中位数选择一个随机的正交坐标系，在每个坐标中取一个中位数，然后将结果点映射回欧几里得平面。我们确定了当社会成本是代理欧几里得距离的 $L_p$ 范数且 $1<p<2$ 时，其精确的最坏情况预期近似比。该比率为 \(\frac{2^{2-1/p}}π\int_0^{π/2}(\cos^pθ+\sin^pθ)^{1/p}\ddθ\)。这个表达式之前由Chan、Lin和Wang确立为下界；我们的贡献是匹配的上界。该证明建立了一个相对于任意参考点的强化坐标中位数不等式。其右侧在一个方向相关范数之和中是线性的，这允许在旋转上直接平均，而不会因通过 $p$ 阶矩界限而产生损失。我们给出了所有辅助不等式，并使用已建立的两簇-离群点构造给出了一个自洽的紧性证明。上界适用于每个有限配置文件和坐标中位数区间内的每个可测量选择，而奇数大小的配置文件足以满足匹配的下界。该结果表征了这种固定机制，而不是所有随机策略证明机制中的最优近似比。
AI.summary: 本文精确地确定了欧几里得平面中均匀旋转坐标中位数机制在基于 $L_p$ 范数（$1<p<2$）的社会成本下的最坏情况预期近似比。通过提供一个匹配先前已知下界的新上界，论文建立了精确的近似比。证明涉及一个强化的坐标中位数不等式和一种直接在旋转上平均的方法。
AI.keywords: 均匀旋转坐标中位数, 近似比, 欧几里得平面, $L_p$ 范数, 社会成本
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于，它为一种特定的机制（均匀旋转坐标中位数）建立了精确的近似比，为已知的下界提供了匹配的上界。这对于理解固定随机机制在社会选择理论中的性能和局限性具有重要意义。

title: Prior Evolution and Task Alignment for Aerial Grasping
summary: Aerial grasping is a remarkable capability exhibited by predatory birds, allowing them to capture prey through highly coordinated maneuvers in flight. Inspired by this capability, researchers have developed various formulations to reproduce such maneuvers through trajectory optimization. However, two limitations remain in practice. First, the resulting optimization problem is highly nonconvex and sensitive to initialization, making high-quality solutions difficult to obtain under a limited computational budget. Second, prescribed numerical objectives are human-designed abstractions that describe successful grasping through a limited set of mathematically tractable quantities and may not fully capture what determines task success. We investigate how learning can address these limitations within an analytical planner. Accordingly, a trajectory prior is first learned from optimized motions and then evolved through a CEM-based process that evaluates sampled initializations with the deployed optimizer and retains favorable ones as new supervision. An Execution-Aware Critic learns from contact, lift, and completion outcomes to assess whether the optimized trajectories are likely to succeed in physical execution. Its frozen energy can further serve as a differentiable grasping cost, allowing execution data to directly shape trajectory generation. Simulation and real-world experiments demonstrate improved optimization reliability, trajectory consistency, and grasping performance.

AI.title_translation: 空中抓取中的先验演化与任务对齐
AI.tldr: 本文针对空中抓取轨迹优化中存在的非凸性和人类设计目标不足的问题，提出了一种学习方法。该方法通过学习轨迹先验并利用基于CEM的过程进行演化，同时引入执行感知评论器来评估并指导轨迹生成，从而提高了优化可靠性和抓取性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的空中抓取轨迹优化方法存在两个主要局限性：1) 优化问题高度非凸且对初始化敏感，导致在有限计算预算下难以获得高质量解决方案；2) 人类设计的数值目标可能无法完全捕捉决定任务成功的关键因素。
AI.method: 本文提出在分析规划器中融入学习方法：首先从优化运动中学习轨迹先验，然后通过一个基于CEM（交叉熵法）的过程对其进行演化，该过程评估采样的初始化并保留有利的作为新的监督。此外，一个执行感知评论器（Execution-Aware Critic）从接触、提升和完成结果中学习，以评估优化轨迹在物理执行中成功的可能性。其固定的能量可作为可微分的抓取成本，使执行数据能够直接影响轨迹生成。
AI.result: 仿真和真实世界实验表明，该方法显著提高了优化可靠性、轨迹一致性和抓取性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过将学习到的先验和执行感知评论器集成到分析规划器中，所提出的方法克服了传统轨迹优化的局限性，从而实现了更可靠和成功的空中抓取。
AI.translation: 空中抓取是掠食性鸟类展现出的一种卓越能力，它们通过高度协调的飞行机动来捕获猎物。受此能力的启发，研究人员开发了各种公式，通过轨迹优化来重现此类机动。然而，实践中仍存在两个局限性。首先，由此产生的优化问题是高度非凸的，并且对初始化敏感，使得在有限的计算预算下难以获得高质量的解决方案。其次，预设的数值目标是人类设计的抽象，它们通过一组有限的、数学上易于处理的量来描述成功的抓取，可能无法完全捕捉决定任务成功的因素。我们研究了学习如何在分析规划器中解决这些局限性。因此，首先从优化运动中学习轨迹先验，然后通过基于CEM的过程进行演化，该过程使用部署的优化器评估采样的初始化，并将有利的初始化保留为新的监督。一个执行感知评论器（Execution-Aware Critic）从接触、提升和完成结果中学习，以评估优化后的轨迹是否可能在物理执行中成功。其冻结能量可以进一步作为可微分的抓取成本，从而允许执行数据直接塑造轨迹生成。仿真和真实世界实验表明，优化可靠性、轨迹一致性和抓取性能均得到改善。
AI.summary: 本文旨在解决空中抓取轨迹优化中存在的两个主要问题：非凸性导致的高质量解获取困难，以及人类设计目标无法完全捕捉任务成功。作者提出一种结合学习的分析规划器方法：首先从优化运动中学习并演化轨迹先验，接着引入一个执行感知评论器，该评论器通过学习实际执行结果来评估轨迹成功率，并将其冻结能量作为可微分的抓取成本，直接指导轨迹生成。仿真和真实世界实验验证了该方法在提高优化可靠性、轨迹一致性和抓取性能方面的有效性。
AI.keywords: 空中抓取, 轨迹优化, 学习, 先验演化, 执行感知评论器
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于将学习方法（轨迹先验学习、CEM演化、执行感知评论器）集成到分析规划器中，以克服空中抓取中非凸轨迹优化固有的挑战。利用执行感知评论器通过真实世界反馈直接塑造轨迹生成，是弥合仿真与现实差距并提高鲁棒性的重要贡献。

title: PageRecall: Measuring Page Selection in Literature-Grounded Question Answering
comments: Accepted at the 1st Workshop on Grounding Language Models (GroundLM 2026), co-located with EMNLP 2026. 9 pages. System description for the LitTraceQA shared task (team Everest)
summary: We describe our system for LitTraceQA (GroundLM @ EMNLP 2026): given a research question, retrieve the relevant papers from a pool of 27,487, cite the page and the table or figure where the answer lives, and answer in a requested format. Our main finding is that evidence grounding is limited by retrieval, not by reading. The page selector put the annotator's page, which we call the gold page, in front of the model that locates evidence only about half the time (52.6% gold-page recall), while that model, given the page, cited the right one in 45 of the 48 locators it emitted (94%). When the page was missing it rarely said so: of 45 such cases it returned nothing 14 times, a wrong page 24 times, and a correct page 7 times, so the pipeline failed quietly almost twice as often as it failed visibly. Since the failure was that the right page was never shown, the fix is to stop choosing: each retrieved paper fits in the model's context, so we show it whole. Page ranking survives only as a fallback inside papers too long to fit, which no test-split paper was, and gold-page recall reaches 100% on the papers we can parse. Separately, questions that identify their target by position rather than content, such as "the first author of the 24th reference", are served by parsing rather than retrieval: we resolve the bibliography into an addressable list, which also supplies identifiers the evidence metric scores. The final system scores 0.762 paper $F_1$, 0.441 evidence $F_1$ and 0.920 multiple-choice accuracy on the held-out test split. Because the pipeline depends on a closed model without seed control, we release a harness that verifies the paper's central claims against committed artifacts.
comment: Accepted at the 1st Workshop on Grounding Language Models (GroundLM 2026), co-located with EMNLP 2026. 9 pages. System description for the LitTraceQA shared task (team Everest)

AI.title_translation: PageRecall：衡量文献溯源问答中的页面选择
AI.tldr: 本文发现文献问答的瓶颈在于检索而非大模型的阅读能力。通过放弃页面筛选直接输入全文，以及解析参考文献列表，大幅提升了系统的定位和问答准确率。
AI.motivation: 为了解决文献溯源问答（Literature-Grounded QA）中证据 grounding 受限的根本原因（是检索问题还是阅读问题），并优化系统在检索、定位和引用上的表现。
AI.method: 开发了名为LitTraceQA的系统，发现页面选择瓶颈后，对可解析的论文直接展示全文以达到100%的gold-page召回率；对于基于位置的问题，通过解析参考文献列表建立可寻址列表而非依赖检索。
AI.result: 页面选择的gold-page召回率为52.6%，而在给定正确页面时模型定位准确率高达94%；改进后，系统在保持测试集上的最终得分表现为：paper F1为0.762，evidence F1为0.441，多选准确率为0.920。
AI.conclusion: 通过放弃低效的页面选择并直接输入全文，以及针对基于位置问题的解析处理，该系统在测试集上取得了优异的性能（0.762 paper F1, 0.441 evidence F1, 0.920 多选准确率）。
AI.translation: 我们介绍了针对LitTraceQA（GroundLM @ EMNLP 2026）的系统：给定一个研究问题，从27,487篇论文中检索相关论文，引用答案所在的页面、表格或图表，并以请求的格式回答。我们的主要发现是，证据基础（grounding）受限于检索，而不是阅读。页面选择器将标注者的页面（我们称之为gold page）放在定位证据的模型前面的概率仅为大约一半（52.6%的gold-page召回率），而该模型在给定该页面的情况下，在其发出的48个定位器中，有45个引用了正确的页面（94%）。当页面缺失时，它很少说明：在45个此类案例中，它有14次返回空，24次返回错误的页面，7次返回正确的页面，因此流水线隐性失败的几率几乎是显性失败的两倍。由于失败的原因是没有展示正确的页面，所以解决方法是停止选择：每篇检索到的论文都适合模型的上下文，因此我们将其完整展示。页面排序仅作为无法容纳的过长论文内部的后备方案（测试集中的论文均不需要），在可解析的论文上，gold-page召回率达到了100%。另外，通过位置而非内容识别目标的问题（例如“第24篇参考文献的第一作者”），通过解析而不是检索来服务：我们将参考书目解析为可寻址的列表，这也提供了证据指标评分所需的标识符。最终系统在保留的测试集上获得了0.762的paper F1、0.441的evidence F1和0.920的多选准确率。由于流水线依赖于没有种子控制的闭源模型，我们发布了一个验证工具，用于对照提交的工件验证论文的核心主张。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了LitTraceQA系统，用于解决文献溯源问答任务。研究发现，证据定位的瓶颈在于检索而非阅读。通过改进策略——对符合长度的论文直接展示全文（达到100%的gold-page召回率），并用解析方法处理基于位置的问题，最终系统在测试集上取得了显著的成果。
AI.keywords: 文献问答, 证据定位, 检索增强生成, 页面召回, 大语言模型
AI.comments: 该论文通过深入分析文献溯源问答系统中的瓶颈，指出证据定位受限于检索而非阅读能力，并提出了直接利用模型上下文展示全篇的有效修复方案。这种直面系统痛点并用工程和架构简化解决思路的方法非常值得借鉴。

title: TeochewBench: A Human-Reviewed Benchmark for Teochew Hanzi Translation
summary:
Teochew has a substantial speaker community and exhibits distinctive lexical, syntactic, and pragmatic features, yet textual resources for evaluating large language models remain limited. We present TeochewBench, a human-reviewed benchmark comprising 300 Teochew Hanzi expressions for evaluating translation from Teochew Hanzi into Mandarin Chinese and English. The dataset covers five categories: basic vocabulary; everyday sentences; Teochew-specific expressions; tone, politeness, and context; and idiomatic, ambiguous, and culturally specific expressions. A primary Teochew-speaking reviewer examined all entries individually and revised them as needed, while two additional Teochew speakers verified selected items.
  Our main evaluation covers 11 official general-purpose post-trained models on the reviewed dataset in both translation directions, yielding 6,600 predictions. Two official base checkpoints provide 1,200 predictions for supplementary diagnostics, bringing the total to 13 models and 7,800 predictions. We additionally include a Hanzi-copy control, which returns the source input unchanged, to assess how shared Hanzi affect automatic scores for translation into Mandarin Chinese. Qwen3.5-27B achieved the highest overall chrF-style score among the evaluated checkpoints, at 60.63, followed by Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct at 56.61, Gemma-3-27B-IT at 56.36, and GLM-4-32B-0414 at 55.82. Across the 11 main-evaluation models, the mean chrF-style score decreased from 69.25 for low-specificity items to 27.52 for high-specificity items. High-specificity expressions received lower scores and exhibited smaller cross-model differences, suggesting that they constitute a shared low-scoring region across the model families evaluated here. The Hanzi-copy control further indicates that surface overlap in low-specificity items can substantially affect automatic scores for translation into Mandarin Chinese.

AI.title_translation: TeochewBench：一个潮州汉字翻译的人工审核基准
AI.tldr: 本文介绍了TeochewBench，一个用于评估潮州汉字到普通话/英语翻译的人工审核基准，发现大型语言模型在处理高特异性潮州表达时表现不佳。
AI.motivation: 潮州话拥有庞大的使用者群体，并具有独特的词汇、句法和语用特征，但用于评估大型语言模型的文本资源仍然有限。
AI.method: 研究团队创建了TeochewBench，一个包含300个潮州汉字表达的人工审核基准数据集，涵盖五类。一名主要潮州话审阅者和两名辅助审阅者对数据进行了审核。该基准用于评估11个官方通用型预训练模型和2个基础检查点（共13个模型，7,800个预测）从潮州汉字到普通话和英语的翻译表现。此外，还引入了汉字复制对照组来评估共享汉字对自动评分的影响。
AI.result: Qwen3.5-27B在所有评估模型中取得了最高的整体chrF风格分数（60.63），其次是Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct（56.61）、Gemma-3-27B-IT（56.36）和GLM-4-32B-0414（55.82）。低特异性项目的平均chrF风格分数（69.25）远高于高特异性项目（27.52）。高特异性表达的得分较低且模型间差异小，表明其是各模型家族的共享低分区域。汉字复制对照组显示，低特异性项目中的表面重叠会显著影响翻译成普通话的自动评分。
AI.conclusion: 大型语言模型在翻译高特异性潮州表达时面临显著挑战，这表明需要改进模型或训练数据以更好地处理此类细微的翻译。同时，低特异性项目中的表面重叠可能会人为地提高自动翻译评分。
AI.translation:
潮州话拥有庞大的使用者群体，并展现出独特的词汇、句法和语用特征，然而用于评估大型语言模型的文本资源仍然有限。我们提出了TeochewBench，这是一个经过人工审核的基准，包含300个潮州汉字表达，用于评估从潮州汉字到普通话和英语的翻译。该数据集涵盖五个类别：基本词汇；日常句子；潮州特有表达；声调、礼貌和语境；以及习语、歧义和文化特定表达。一名主要的潮州话审阅者单独检查了所有条目并根据需要进行了修订，另有两名潮州话使用者验证了选定的项目。
我们的主要评估涵盖了11个官方通用型预训练模型，在经过审核的数据集上进行两个翻译方向的评估，产生了6,600个预测。两个官方基础检查点提供了1,200个预测用于补充诊断，使总模型数达到13个，总预测数达到7,800个。我们还包括一个汉字复制对照组，该对照组返回未更改的源输入，以评估共享汉字如何影响自动评分在翻译成普通话时的表现。在评估的检查点中，Qwen3.5-27B获得了最高的整体chrF风格分数，为60.63，其次是Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct（56.61）、Gemma-3-27B-IT（56.36）和GLM-4-32B-0414（55.82）。在11个主要评估模型中，低特异性项目的平均chrF风格分数从69.25下降到高特异性项目的27.52。高特异性表达的得分较低，并且模型间的差异较小，这表明它们构成了此处评估的模型家族中共享的低分区域。汉字复制对照组进一步表明，低特异性项目中的表面重叠会显著影响翻译成普通话的自动评分。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了TeochewBench，一个新颖的、经过人工审核的基准，包含300个潮州汉字表达，分为五类，用于评估大型语言模型（LLMs）向普通话和英语的翻译能力。该研究评估了13个LLMs，产生了7,800个预测。结果表明，尽管Qwen3.5-27B表现最佳，但所有模型在处理高特异性潮州表达时都表现出显著的困难，chrF风格分数相较于低特异性项目有明显下降。研究还强调了共享汉字如何可能夸大普通话翻译的自动评分。
AI.keywords: 潮州话, 基准, 汉字翻译, 大型语言模型, 低资源语言
AI.comments: 该论文解决了潮州话等资源匮乏语言在自然语言处理资源方面的关键空白。经过人工审核的基准是一个有价值的贡献，确保了用于评估大型语言模型在具有挑战性方言上的数据质量。发现大型语言模型在高特异性表达上表现不佳，而基本词汇表现良好，对指导未来的模型开发和训练数据整理具有重要意义。汉字复制对照组的引入是一种巧妙的诊断方法，有助于理解真实性能与表面匹配之间的差异。

title: Bridging the Opacity: Evidence-Backed Cross-Chain Transaction Correspondence Reconstruction Across Heterogeneous Blockchains
summary: Cross-chain bridges enable interoperability, but they also break the transaction trails needed to trace illicit funds. Third-party investigators typically cannot access the source-to-destination mappings maintained by bridge backends, and our survey of 131 bridges finds that only 16.79% provide complete public tracking. Existing approaches depend on official APIs, EVM-specific assumptions, or fragile temporal heuristics, limiting their ability to trace transfers across heterogeneous ledgers. We present XSplicer, an evidence-driven system for reconstructing cross-chain transaction correspondence (xTCR) without privileged access to bridge backends. XSplicer derives unified semantic specifications from public protocol documentation and transaction examples, translates them into lightweight parsers and verifiers, and links source and destination transactions by prioritizing hard evidence and using soft clues only when necessary. We evaluate XSplicer on seven bridge protocols spanning EVM, Bitcoin, and Solana. XSplicer achieves 92.5% global recovery rate and up to 98.61% on individual protocols. Under adversarial noise, its hard-evidence verifier retains the correct match in 100% of tested cases, while soft-clue matching degrades as ambiguity increases. In two real-world case studies, XSplicer recovers more than 1,900 historical transaction pairs after Multichain ceased operations and identifies 754 illicit cross-chain transfers worth 105.6 million USD in the Bybit laundering incident. These results show that public protocol invariants can support practical cross-chain forensics without privileged bridge mappings.

AI.title_translation: 弥合不透明性：异构区块链上基于证据的跨链交易对应关系重建
AI.tldr: XSplicer是一个无需特权访问即可重建异构区块链上跨链交易对应关系的系统，实现了高恢复率，并在真实世界案例中成功追踪了非法资金，证明了公共协议不变量在跨链取证中的实用性。
AI.motivation: 跨链桥虽然实现了互操作性，但却破坏了追踪非法资金所需的交易路径。第三方调查员通常无法访问桥后端维护的源到目标映射，且现有方法依赖官方API、EVM特定假设或脆弱的时间启发式方法，限制了在异构账本间追踪转移的能力。
AI.method: XSplicer是一个证据驱动的系统，用于在没有特权访问桥后端的情况下重建跨链交易对应关系（xTCR）。它从公共协议文档和交易示例中推导出统一的语义规范，将其转化为轻量级解析器和验证器，并通过优先使用硬证据并在必要时使用软线索来链接源和目标交易。
AI.result: XSplicer在七个跨越EVM、比特币和Solana的桥协议上实现了92.5%的全球恢复率，在单个协议上高达98.61%。在对抗性噪声下，其硬证据验证器在100%的测试案例中保留了正确匹配。在两个真实世界案例研究中，XSplicer在Multichain停止运营后恢复了1,900多对历史交易，并在Bybit洗钱事件中识别出754笔价值1.056亿美元的非法跨链转移。
AI.conclusion: 公共协议不变量可以在没有特权桥映射的情况下支持实用的跨链取证。
AI.translation: 跨链桥实现了互操作性，但也破坏了追踪非法资金所需的交易路径。第三方调查员通常无法访问桥后端维护的源到目标映射，我们对131个桥的调查发现，只有16.79%提供了完整的公共追踪。现有方法依赖官方API、EVM特定假设或脆弱的时间启发式方法，限制了它们在异构账本间追踪转移的能力。我们提出了XSplicer，一个证据驱动的系统，用于在没有特权访问桥后端的情况下重建跨链交易对应关系（xTCR）。XSplicer从公共协议文档和交易示例中推导出统一的语义规范，将其转化为轻量级解析器和验证器，并通过优先使用硬证据并在必要时使用软线索来链接源和目标交易。我们在跨越EVM、比特币和Solana的七个桥协议上评估了XSplicer。XSplicer实现了92.5%的全球恢复率，在单个协议上高达98.61%。在对抗性噪声下，其硬证据验证器在100%的测试案例中保留了正确匹配，而软线索匹配则随着模糊性的增加而降低。在两个真实世界案例研究中，XSplicer在Multichain停止运营后恢复了1,900多对历史交易对，并在Bybit洗钱事件中识别出754笔价值1.056亿美元的非法跨链转移。这些结果表明，公共协议不变量可以在没有特权桥映射的情况下支持实用的跨链取证。
AI.summary: XSplicer是一个无需特权访问即可重建异构区块链上跨链交易对应关系（xTCR）的系统。针对现有跨链追踪方法依赖特权访问或特定假设的局限性，XSplicer通过分析公共协议文档和交易示例，构建语义规范、解析器和验证器，并结合硬证据和软线索进行交易匹配。实验结果表明，XSplicer在多协议上表现出高恢复率和鲁棒性，并在真实世界案例中成功追踪了大量历史和非法跨链交易，证明了公共协议不变量在跨链取证中的实用性。
AI.keywords: 跨链交易追踪, 区块链取证, 跨链桥, 异构区块链, XSplicer
AI.comments: 本文提出了一种创新的方法XSplicer，解决了跨链桥在实现互操作性的同时，对非法资金追踪造成的不透明性问题。其核心创新在于无需特权访问桥后端，仅依赖公共协议文档和交易示例即可重建跨链交易对应关系，这极大地降低了追踪门槛并提高了实用性。XSplicer在异构区块链上的泛化能力和在真实世界案例中的成功应用，特别是对Multichain和Bybit事件的分析，凸显了其在区块链取证和监管领域的重要价值和潜力。

title: Time-Aligned Evolving Concept Graphs for Scientific Relation Forecasting
summary: Forecasting scientific relations can guide discovery by identifying promising connections before they emerge. Existing approaches often model concept semantics and graph structure separately or summarize semantics over coarse historical snapshots, leaving semantic representations potentially misaligned with rapidly evolving graph evidence. We propose a time-aligned evolving concept graph framework that jointly models semantic and structural evolution. Its core idea is to treat dated papers as shared update events, reconstructing semantic and structural states from the same publication history through each prediction time. Pair-level fusion combines these states to forecast first co-occurrence, relation formation, and conditional relation type. Holding architecture and training fixed, refreshing context alongside graph updates improves mean relation AUPRC by 16.6% over frozen context. On a graph built from 187,848 papers with 270,687 concepts and 7.45 million co-occurrence links, the complete framework improves mean relation AUROC from 0.9290 for the strongest evaluated baseline to 0.9722, with mean population-weighted AUPRC 0.005778.

AI.title_translation: 科学关系预测的时间对齐演化概念图
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种时间对齐的演化概念图框架，通过联合建模科学概念的语义和结构演化，解决了现有科学关系预测方法中语义表示与快速演化图证据不一致的问题，显著提高了预测准确性。
AI.motivation: 预测科学关系能够通过在新连接出现前识别有前景的连接来指导发现。现有方法通常独立建模概念语义和图结构，或在粗略的历史快照上总结语义，导致语义表示可能与快速演化图证据不一致。
AI.method: 本文提出了一种时间对齐的演化概念图框架，该框架联合建模语义和结构演化。其核心思想是将有日期的论文视为共享的更新事件，通过每个预测时间点从相同的出版历史中重建语义和结构状态。对级别融合结合这些状态来预测首次共现、关系形成和条件关系类型。
AI.result: 在架构和训练不变的情况下，刷新上下文并伴随图更新，使平均关系AUPRC比冻结上下文提高了16.6%。在一个包含187,848篇论文、270,687个概念和745万共现链接的图上，完整框架将最强基线的平均关系AUROC从0.9290提高到0.9722，平均人口加权AUPRC为0.005778。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的时间对齐演化概念图框架通过联合建模语义和结构演化，有效解决了现有科学关系预测方法中语义表示与快速演化图证据不一致的问题，并在预测准确性上取得了显著提升，证明了其在指导科学发现方面的潜力。

AI.summary: 本文提出了一种时间对齐的演化概念图框架，用于科学关系预测。该框架通过将带日期的论文视为共享更新事件，联合建模概念语义和图结构的演化，解决了现有方法中语义表示与快速演化图证据不一致的问题。通过在每个预测时间点从出版历史中重建语义和结构状态，并进行对级别融合，该方法能够有效预测科学关系的首次共现、形成和类型。实验结果表明，该框架显著提高了科学关系预测的准确性，在平均关系AUROC和AUPRC方面均优于现有基线。

title: Energy-Regularized Imitation Learning for Force- and Work-Aware Robotic Manipulation
comments: ECCV 2026 Workshop on Force-Grounded, Cross-View Articulated Manipulation
summary: This paper studies energy-aware manipulation as a physically grounded learning problem. We define a joint-space mechanical-work proxy from joint torque and angular displacement, and train a differentiable energy predictor that estimates this work from robot states and actions. The predictor converts a non-differentiable simulator-side physical quantity into a differentiable regularizer for fine-tuning a pretrained manipulation policy. We instantiate the framework with RVT-2 on RLBench and evaluate 12 manipulation tasks involving object contact, articulated motion, placement, pushing, and sweeping. The proposed fine-tuning reduces the average mechanical work from 208.8J to 204.4J (i.e., 2.1% reduction), while the mean task success rate also increases slightly from 86.2% to 86.9%. These results show that work-aware policy optimization can suppress physically inefficient motion without requiring an explicit differentiable dynamics model.
