AI.title_translation: 能量正则化模仿学习用于力-功感知的机器人操作
AI.tldr: 本文提出一种能量正则化模仿学习框架，通过可微分能量预测器将机械功作为正则化项，微调预训练的机器人操作策略，从而在减少机械功的同时略微提高任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 研究能量感知的机器人操作作为一个物理接地学习问题，旨在抑制物理上低效的运动。
AI.method: 本文定义了一个关节空间机械功代理，并训练了一个可微分能量预测器，该预测器将不可微分的模拟器侧物理量转换为可微分的正则化项，用于微调预训练的操作策略。该框架使用RVT-2在RLBench上进行了实例化，并评估了12个操作任务。
AI.result: 微调后，平均机械功从208.8J减少到204.4J（即减少2.1%）。平均任务成功率从86.2%略微增加到86.9%。
AI.conclusion: 功感知的策略优化可以在不需要显式可微分动力学模型的情况下抑制物理上低效的运动。
AI.translation: 本文将能量感知操作作为物理接地学习问题进行研究。我们从关节扭矩和角位移定义了一个关节空间机械功代理，并训练了一个可微分能量预测器，该预测器根据机器人状态和动作估计此功。该预测器将不可微分的模拟器侧物理量转换为可微分的正则化项，用于微调预训练的操作策略。我们使用RVT-2在RLBench上实例化了该框架，并评估了12个涉及物体接触、关节运动、放置、推和扫的操作任务。所提出的微调将平均机械功从208.8J减少到204.4J（即减少2.1%），同时平均任务成功率也从86.2%略微增加到86.9%。这些结果表明，功感知的策略优化可以在不需要显式可微分动力学模型的情况下抑制物理上低效的运动。
AI.summary: 本文提出一种能量正则化模仿学习框架，通过定义关节空间机械功代理并训练可微分能量预测器，将机械功作为可微分正则化项来微调预训练的机器人操作策略。实验结果表明，该方法在RLBench的12项任务中，有效减少了平均机械功（2.1%），并略微提升了任务成功率，证明了无需显式可微分动力学模型即可实现功感知策略优化以抑制低效运动的有效性。
AI.keywords: 能量正则化, 模仿学习, 机器人操作, 机械功, 可微分预测器
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于将机械功这一物理量通过可微分预测器转化为模仿学习的正则化项，从而在不依赖复杂可微分动力学模型的情况下，实现了机器人操作的能量效率优化。这种方法为机器人学习提供了一个新的物理接地视角，有助于开发更高效、更安全的机器人系统。其局限性可能在于能量预测器的准确性以及在更复杂、不确定环境中的泛化能力。

title: LUMO: Designing Luminous Contact Morphology for Repeatable Whole-Finger Contact Observation
summary: A low-impedance robot finger reports through joint torque how strongly it is loaded, but the same torque can arise from a small force near the fingertip or a large force near the joint. Resolving the force therefore requires knowing where along the finger contact occurred. LUMO makes that location externally observable. Embedded LEDs illuminate a compliant silicone pad, and contact deforms the pad so that light emerging from the finger's side changes in a pattern set by where the load acts. Because the same structure also carries the contact load, we optimize its cross-section, including the pad profile, rigid carrier, and lateral void, for two behaviors at once. Mechanically, the pad conforms under low preload while the carrier increasingly restricts further deformation as load rises. Optically, different contact locations produce separated responses on the finger's side. The search uses rigid--soft contact simulation, ray tracing, and multi-objective Bayesian optimization. Across two silicones, six contact locations, and 10- and 30-mm spherical indenters, the optimized morphologies improve neighboring-location separation relative to variation from re-establishing contact by \(15\)--\(59\%\). Estimating contact location from the optical response using the known LED spacing and combining it with joint torque gives \(1.44~\mathrm{N}\) normal-force MAE over 931 samples. In a two-finger hand, localized side responses appear on several links simultaneously during grasps.

AI.title_translation: LUMO：设计发光接触形态以实现可重复的全手指接触观测
AI.tldr: LUMO通过嵌入LED的柔性硅胶手指设计，利用侧向光图案变化与关节扭矩相结合，成功实现了对机器人手指接触位置的精确观测和法向力的准确估计。
AI.motivation: 低阻抗机器人手指通过关节扭矩报告负载大小，但相同的扭矩可能由指尖附近的小力或关节附近的大力产生。为了解决这种位置与力的混淆问题，需要一种能够外部观测接触位置的方法。
AI.method: 利用嵌入式LED照射柔性硅胶垫，当接触发生时垫层变形使侧向出射光产生特定模式。通过刚-柔接触仿真、光线追踪以及多目标贝叶斯优化，对硅胶垫剖面、刚性载体和侧向空隙等截面进行联合优化；并结合LED间距的侧向光学响应估计接触位置，再与关节扭矩结合计算法向力。
AI.result: 经优化后的形态在相邻位置分离度上比重新接触的变化提高了15%–59%；在931个样本中，结合光学响应与关节扭矩估计法向力的平均绝对误差（MAE）为1.44 N；在双指手抓取过程中，多个连杆上可同时呈现局部的侧向响应。
AI.conclusion: LUMO通过在机器人手指中嵌入LED并优化柔性硅胶垫与刚性载体的截面结构，成功实现了通过侧向光学响应来观测接触位置。结合关节扭矩，LUMO能够精确估计法向力，并在多指抓取中展现出良好的多连杆接触监测能力。
AI.translation: 低阻抗机器人手指通过关节扭矩来报告其受载程度，但相同的扭矩可能由指尖附近的小力或关节附近的大力引起。因此，解析力需要知道接触发生在手指的哪个位置。LUMO使该位置具有外部可观测性。嵌入式LED照亮顺应性硅胶垫，接触使硅胶垫变形，从而使从手指侧面发出的光以负载作用位置所决定的模式发生改变。由于同一结构还承载接触负载，我们同时优化了其截面（包括垫层轮廓、刚性载体和侧向空隙）以实现两种行为。在机械上，硅胶垫在低预载下顺应，而随着负载增加，刚性载体逐渐限制进一步变形；在光学上，不同的接触位置在手指侧面产生分离的响应。该搜索使用了刚-柔接触仿真、光线追踪和多目标贝叶斯优化。在两种硅胶、六个接触位置以及10毫米和30毫米球形压头下，优化后的形态使相邻位置的分离度相对于重新接触产生的变化提高了15%到59%。利用已知的LED间距从光学响应中估计接触位置，并将其与关节扭矩结合，在931个样本中得到了1.44 N的法向力平均绝对误差（MAE）。在一个双指手中，抓取过程中多个连杆上同时出现了局部的侧向响应。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了LUMO，一种通过设计发光接触形态来实现可重复全手指接触观测的方法。通过在柔性硅胶垫中嵌入LED，利用接触引起的侧向光图案变化来确定接触位置，并与关节扭矩相结合，实现了对接触位置和法向力的准确估计。
AI.keywords: 触觉传感, 接触形态优化, 光学触觉, 机器人手指, 多目标贝叶斯优化
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地提出了一种通过发光接触形态（LUMO）来实现可重复的全手指接触观测方法，结合了光学形变响应与关节扭矩，有效解决了机器手指尖力与力矩模糊的问题。其重要性在于通过多目标贝叶斯优化设计了兼具机械顺应性与光学可辨识性的手指截面结构，提升了触觉感知的准确性。局限性在于主要依赖仿真优化并在特定硅胶和压头尺寸下进行了验证，未来需在更复杂的实际交互场景中测试。

title: Learning Depth-3 Circuits with Polynomial Savings
summary:
We study the challenging problem of learning depth-three circuits in the mistake-bound model of (realizable) online learning, which is a more difficult model than distribution-free PAC learning. Prior algorithms for this problem, due to Servedio and Tan [ST17], could only learn polynomial-size depth-three circuits of poly$(n)$ size over $\{0,1\}^n$ with a running time of $2^{n - Ω(n/\log n)}$, and hence they ran in time $N^{1-o(1)}$ where $N=2^n$ is the running time of a naive memorization-based approach.
  In this work we substantially improve on the [ST17] result: for any constant $γ\geq1$, we give an algorithm that learns depth-three circuits of size $n^γ$ with running time \[ 2^{n-c_γn}, \] where $c_γ>0$ depends only on $γ$ and not on $n$. Hence we achieve a polynomial savings over the naive approach for learning any polynomial-size depth-three circuit.
  The main driving force behind our improvement is an improved bound on the approximate degree of width-$k$ CNFs. Inspired by Szegedy [Sze04] and Magniez et al. [MNRS11], the rough idea of our construction is to use a Chebyshev polynomial to efficiently amplify the spectral gap of a carefully designed random walk. This is combined with a random-restriction-like approach to separately learn different subfunctions corresponding to different assignments to a randomly chosen set of variables, using the Perceptron algorithm over a specially designed feature space.
  A simplified warmup instantiation of our approach achieves $c_γ= \exp(-O(γ))$; by augmenting this warmup with further ingredients we obtain the sharp form of our result, which achieves $c_γ=Ω(1)/γ$.

AI.title_translation: 学习具有多项式节省的深度3电路
AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种在在线学习模型下高效学习深度三电路的新算法，相比传统方法实现了实质性的多项式时间节省。
AI.motivation: 以往关于在可实现的主动在线学习模型下学习深度3电路的算法，其运行时间仅比朴素记忆方法快微不足道的小o(1)因子（即2^{n - \Omega(n/\log n)}），作者旨在打破这一瓶颈，实现真正的多项式节省。
AI.method: 结合了对宽度为k的CNF近似度数改进界（利用切比雪夫多项式放大随机游走的谱隙）以及类似随机限制的方法，在特殊设计的特征空间上使用感知器算法分别学习不同子函数。
AI.result: 对于任意常数γ≥1，给出了一个学习大小为n^γ的深度三电路的算法，其运行时间为2^{n-c_γn}（其中c_γ>0仅依赖于γ），从而对任意多项式大小的深度三电路学习实现了相对于朴素方法的真正多项式节省。
AI.conclusion: 该研究成功在在线学习模型下实现了对多项式大小深度3电路的高效学习，算法运行时间取得了对朴素方法的实质性多项式节省，显著推动了电路学习领域的发展。
AI.translation:
我们研究了（可实现的）在线学习的错误界模型中学习深度三电路这一具有挑战性的问题，该模型比无分布PAC学习更困难。Servedio和Tan [ST17] 先前的算法只能在 $2^{n - \Omega(n/\log n)}$ 的运行时间内学习 $\{0,1\}^n$ 上 poly$(n)$ 大小的多项式大小深度三电路，因此其运行时间为 $N^{1-o(1)}$，其中 $N=2^n$ 是朴素记忆方法的运行时间。
在本文中，我们实质性地改进了 [ST17] 的结果：对于任意常数 $\gamma\ge 1$，我们给出了一个学习大小为 $n^\gamma$ 的深度三电路的算法，运行时间为 $2^{n-c_\gamma n}$，其中 $c_\gamma>0$ 仅取决于 $\gamma$ 且不依赖于 $n$。因此，我们在学习任何多项式大小的深度三电路时，相对于朴素方法实现了多项式级的节省。
推动我们改进的主要动力是关于宽度为 $k$ 的 CNF 的近似度数的改进界。受 Szegedy [Sze04] 和 Magniez 等人 [MNRS11] 的启发，我们构造的大致思路是使用切比雪夫多项式来有效地放大精心设计的随机游走的谱隙。这与类似随机限制的方法相结合，在特殊设计的特征空间上使用感知器算法，分别学习对应于随机选择变量集的不用赋值的不同子函数。
我们方法的简化预热实例实现了 $c_\gamma= \exp(-O(\gamma))$；通过用更多的成分来增强这个预热实例，我们得到了结果的精确形式，实现了 $c_\gamma=\Omega(1)/\gamma$。
AI.summary: 该论文研究了在线学习模型中学习深度三电路的问题。通过提出一种改进的宽度为k的CNF近似度数界，结合切比雪夫多项式和随机限制技术，作者设计了一种新算法，成功对任意多项式大小的深度三电路学习实现了相对于朴素方法的多项式级运行时间节省。
AI.keywords: 深度三电路, 在线学习, 近似度数, 切比雪夫多项式, 随机限制
AI.comments: 该论文在可实现的主动在线学习模型下，针对深度为3的布尔电路学习问题取得了重大突破，通过改进宽度为k的CNF的近似度数界，首次实现了相对于朴素记忆方法的真正多项式节省。

title: Characterizing Replay Retention Under Dynamics Shift in Model-Based Reinforcement Learning
summary: Adapting to changes in robot dynamics requires learning from new data without discarding experience that may still be useful. In continual model-based reinforcement learning (RL), replay collected before a dynamics change can slow adaptation, while removing it unnecessarily reduces available training data and can be especially costly if earlier dynamics return. We study when recent transitions are preferable to the full replay history. Two quantities characterize this trade-off: change magnitude and age-staleness area under the curve (AUC), measuring how well transition age separates stale from fresh data. Forgetting stale data helps after large permanent shifts but hurts when dynamics recur and older data becomes useful again. Choosing a replay strategy therefore depends on predicting when older data will help or hurt. We test these effects across two locomotion morphologies, two model-based RL algorithms, and Real-World RL benchmark perturbations. Because ground-truth staleness labels are unavailable on deployed robots, we evaluate whether an estimator built from interaction data can still provide the quantities needed to choose a replay strategy after permanent changes. Our results show that replay retention depends on change magnitude and on how the dynamics evolve.

AI.title_translation: 基于模型强化学习中动态变化下的经验回放保留特性研究
AI.tldr: 研究了基于模型强化学习中如何根据动力学变化的大小和演化方式来选择经验回放保留策略。
AI.motivation: 在持续基于模型强化学习中，动态变化后适应新数据与保留有用经验之间存在权衡，移除旧数据可能导致数据不足或在旧动力学恢复时代价高昂，因此需要研究何时以及如何进行经验回放保留。
AI.method: 研究了何时优先使用最近的转移数据而不是完整的回放历史，提出了变化幅度和年龄-陈旧度AUC（面积下）两个特征量，并在两种运动形态、两个基于模型RL算法以及真实世界RL基准扰动上进行了测试，同时评估了基于交互数据的估计器。
AI.result: 遗忘陈旧数据在经历较大的永久性变化后是有帮助的，但在动力学循环出现且旧数据重新变得有用时会产生负面影响；基于交互数据构建的估计器能够为永久性变化后的回放策略选择提供所需指标。
AI.conclusion: 经验回放的保留策略高度依赖于环境变化幅度和动力学的演化方式，通过交互数据构建的估计器可以在永久性变化后有效辅助选择回放策略。
AI.translation: 适应机器人动力学的变化需要从新数据中学习，同时不丢弃可能仍然有用的经验。在持续基于模型强化学习（RL）中，动力学变化之前收集的回放数据可能会减慢适应速度，而不必要地删除它会减少可用的训练数据，如果先前的动力学特性回归，代价可能会特别高。我们研究了何时最近的转移数据比完整的回放历史更可取。两个量表征了这种权衡：变化幅度和年龄-陈旧度曲线下面积（AUC），它衡量了转移年龄区分陈旧数据与新鲜数据的程度。在经历大的永久性变化后，遗忘陈旧数据是有帮助的，但在动力学循环出现且旧数据再次变得有用时则有害。因此，选择回放策略取决于预测旧数据何时会有帮助或有害。我们在两种运动形态、两种基于模型RL算法以及真实世界RL基准扰动下测试了这些影响。由于在部署的机器人上无法获得真实的陈旧度标签，我们评估了由交互数据构建的估计器是否仍能提供在永久性变化后选择回放策略所需的量。我们的结果表明，回放保留取决于变化的大小以及动力学的演化方式。
AI.summary: 本文研究了基于模型强化学习中动力学变化下的经验回放保留策略。通过引入变化幅度和年龄-陈旧度AUC两个关键指标，论文分析了何时该使用近期数据或完整历史数据，发现在永久性变化和循环变化下策略选择有所不同，并通过实验验证了基于交互数据的估计器的可行性。
AI.keywords: Model-Based Reinforcement Learning, Continual Learning, Dynamics Shift, Experience Replay
AI.comments: 该论文深入探讨了基于模型强化学习中应对动态环境变化时经验回放（Replay Retention）的策略问题，创新性地引入了变化幅度和年龄-陈旧度AUC两个量化指标，对机器人持续学习具有重要的指导意义和实用价值。

title: Approximating High Dimensional Self-Motion Manifolds via Deep Generative Models
summary: Self-motion manifold (SMM) characterizes the geometric structure of the infinite inverse kinematic solutions set of a redundant manipulator at a fixed end-effector pose, and its efficient recovery underpins feasible and global optimal motion planning. Existing methods such as null-space continuation and learning-based methods are formulated around the assumption that an SMM is a curve, and do not extend to higher redundancy orders. We instead adopt a probabilistic view: SMMs are the support of the conditional posterior over configurations given a target pose, so that recovering it reduces to sampling from a learned distribution and separating its disjoint components by clustering. The formulation is independent of the manifold dimension and requires no architectural change as the redundancy order grows. In this work, we demonstrate that our method can approximate 1-D SMMs with performance comparable to the latest null-space continuation and learning-based approach, and that it is the first method capable of approximating highly redundant 4-D SMMs in a 7R manipulator for position tasks. Project website: \href{https://github.com/accuracy-maker/high-dimenstional-self-motion-manifold-approximation}{https://github.com/accuracy-maker/high-dimenstional-self-motion-manifold-approximation}

AI.title_translation: 通过深度生成模型近似高维自运动流形
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于深度生成模型的自运动流形（SMM）逼近方法，首次实现了对7R机械臂高维4-D SMM的高效逼近。
AI.motivation: 现有的自运动流形（SMM）恢复方法大多基于SMM是一条曲线的假设，无法扩展到更高冗余度的阶数，因此需要一种不依赖于流形维度且能处理高维冗余的方法。
AI.method: 采用概率视角，将自运动流形视为给定目标位姿下构型条件后验分布的支持集，通过从学习到的分布中采样并利用聚类分离其不相交的成分来恢复SMM。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法不仅能以与最新零空间延拓法和基于学习的方法相媲美的性能逼近1维SMM，而且是第一种能够逼近7R机械臂中用于位置任务的高度冗余4维SMM的方法。
AI.conclusion: 该方法通过将SMM恢复建模为条件后验分布的采样和聚类问题，成功克服了传统方法无法处理高冗余度的限制，能够高效逼近一维及高维（如四维）自运动流形。
AI.translation: 自运动流形（SMM）表征了冗余机械臂在固定末端执行器位姿下无限逆运动学解集的几何结构，其高效恢复是可行且全局最优运动规划的基础。现有的方法（如零空间延拓法和基于学习的方法）均基于SMM是一条曲线的假设，无法扩展到更高的冗余度。因此，我们采用概率视角：SMM是给定目标位姿下构型的条件后验分布的支持集，从而将恢复过程简化为从学习到的分布中采样并通过聚类分离其不相交的成分。该公式与流形维度无关，且随着冗余阶数的增长无需更改网络架构。在这项工作中，我们证明了该方法能够以与最新零空间延拓法和基于学习的方法相媲美的性能逼近1-D SMM，并且它是第一种能够逼近7R机械臂中用于位置任务的高度冗余4-D SMM的方法。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种基于深度生成模型的自运动流形（SMM）逼近方法，通过概率视角将SMM恢复转化为条件后验分布的采样与聚类问题。该方法不依赖流形维度，能够有效克服传统方法无法处理高冗余阶数的局限，首次实现了对7R机械臂高维4-D SMM的逼近。
AI.keywords: 自运动流形, 深度生成模型, 机械臂, 逆运动学, 运动规划
AI.comments: 该论文采用概率视角，将自运动流形（SMM）恢复问题转化为从学习分布中采样并进行聚类的问题，突破了传统方法局限于一维流形的限制，首次实现了对7R机械臂高维（4-D）SMM的高效逼近，具有重要的理论和应用价值。

title: TacBPM: A Tactile-conditioned Behavior Prior Model for Dexterous Reorientation
summary: Dexterous in-hand manipulation requires policies that coordinate high-DoF hand joints through intermittent, contact-rich interaction. Beyond target-orientation tracking, such policies must discover finger gaits that preserve object stability while adapting to geometry, anisotropy, pose, contact, and sensing changes. We propose \method, a tactile-conditioned behavior prior model for dexterous reorientation. \method distills multi-scale sphere specialists into a latent controller and lets downstream policies reuse the fixed tactile prior through residual latent actions, reducing renewed exploration from raw joint commands. The prior conditions on tactile-proprioceptive history so latent behavior reflects the current hand-object interaction. We evaluate arbitrary-pose transfer across anisotropic objects, commanded-axis rotation, and an arm-hand Grasp-to-AnyPose task in which the robot must grasp, lift, transport, and reach goal poses for novel tool geometries and generalized placements. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed method accelerates training and enables stable policies where matched raw-action PPO remains near failure, with successful sim-to-real transfer in in-hand and arm-hand tasks.

AI.title_translation: TacBPM：一种用于灵巧重新定向的触觉条件行为先验模型
AI.tldr: TacBPM是一种触觉条件行为先验模型，通过蒸馏多尺度专家并利用残差潜在动作，显著加速了灵巧手内操作的训练并提高了稳定性，实现了成功的模拟到现实迁移。
AI.motivation: 灵巧手内操作需要协调高自由度手部关节以进行间歇性、接触丰富的交互，并需要策略来发现手指步态、保持物体稳定性以及适应几何、各向异性、姿态、接触和感知变化。
AI.method: 本文提出了TacBPM，一个触觉条件行为先验模型，用于灵巧重新定向。该方法将多尺度球体专家提炼成一个潜在控制器，并允许下游策略通过残差潜在动作重用固定的触觉先验，从而减少从原始关节命令开始的探索。该先验以触觉-本体感受历史为条件，使潜在行为反映当前的手-物体交互。
AI.result: 该方法加速了训练，并在原始动作PPO接近失败的情况下实现了稳定的策略。在手内和手臂-手任务中实现了成功的模拟到现实迁移，包括各向异性物体的任意姿态转移、指令轴旋转以及抓取到任意姿态任务。
AI.conclusion: TacBPM通过引入触觉条件行为先验模型，显著提高了灵巧手内操作策略的训练效率和稳定性，并成功实现了模拟到现实的迁移。
AI.translation: 灵巧的手内操作需要通过间歇性、接触丰富的交互来协调高自由度手部关节的策略。除了目标姿态跟踪，这些策略还必须发现手指步态，以在适应几何、各向异性、姿态、接触和感知变化的同时保持物体稳定性。我们提出了TacBPM，一种用于灵巧重新定向的触觉条件行为先验模型。TacBPM将多尺度球体专家提炼成一个潜在控制器，并允许下游策略通过残差潜在动作重用固定的触觉先验，从而减少从原始关节命令开始的重新探索。该先验以触觉-本体感受历史为条件，因此潜在行为反映了当前的手-物体交互。我们评估了各向异性物体的任意姿态转移、指令轴旋转，以及一个手臂-手抓取到任意姿态任务，在该任务中，机器人必须抓取、举起、运输并达到新工具几何形状和广义放置的目标姿态。广泛的实验表明，所提出的方法加速了训练，并在匹配的原始动作PPO接近失败的情况下实现了稳定的策略，并在手内和手臂-手任务中成功实现了模拟到现实的迁移。
AI.summary: 本文提出TacBPM，一个用于灵巧手内物体重新定向的触觉条件行为先验模型。TacBPM通过将多尺度专家提炼为潜在控制器，并利用残差潜在动作，使下游策略能够高效利用固定的触觉先验，从而减少探索。该模型以触觉-本体感受历史为条件，确保行为与当前交互相关。实验证明，TacBPM显著加速了训练，提高了策略稳定性，并在模拟到现实的各种手内和手臂-手任务中表现出色。
AI.keywords: 灵巧操作, 触觉感知, 行为先验, 机器人抓取, 模拟到现实迁移
AI.comments: 这篇论文通过引入触觉条件行为先验模型TacBPM，为灵巧手内操作提供了一个创新的解决方案。其核心在于将复杂行为蒸馏为潜在控制器，并通过残差动作利用触觉反馈，显著降低了策略学习的复杂性。这种方法在处理高自由度、接触丰富的任务时，展现出加速训练和提高稳定性的优势，并且成功实现了模拟到现实的迁移，这对于机器人操作领域具有重要意义。

title: MoRE: Mixture of Reused Experts
comments: Accepted to the Conference on Language Modeling (COLM 2026)
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures decouple model capacity from computational cost, yet incur high memory footprints as parameters grow linearly with the number of experts. Recurrent Transformers achieve parameter efficiency by reusing layer weights, but typically lack the capacity for competitive language modeling. We propose Mixture of Reused Experts (MoRE), a hybrid that shares expert pools across groups of adjacent layers. Each layer retains its own router but selects from a larger shared pool, expanding the diversity of routing combinations without additional parameters. To enable shared experts to distinguish between layers, we introduce lightweight learnable depth embeddings that condition each layer's input before routing. Experiments across three model scales (114M-1.15B parameters) show that MoRE consistently achieves lower perplexity and stronger downstream performance than standard MoEs and state-of-the-art weight-sharing architectures at matched compute and parameter budgets, with only minimal modifications to existing MoE implementations.
comment: Accepted to the Conference on Language Modeling (COLM 2026)

AI.title_translation: MoRE：复用专家的混合架构
AI.tldr: MoRE 结合了混合专家（MoE）与权重复用技术，通过跨层共享专家池和引入深度嵌入，在不增加参数和计算成本的前提下提升了语言模型性能。
AI.motivation: 传统的混合专家（MoE）模型虽然能解耦模型容量与计算成本，但由于参数随专家数量线性增长而带来巨大的内存占用；而循环 Transformer 虽然通过重用层权重实现了参数高效性，但缺乏竞争力。为此，需要一种既能保持参数高效又能具备高容量的架构。
AI.method: 提出 Mixture of Reused Experts (MoRE) 架构，在相邻层组之间共享专家池，每层保留各自的路由器并引入轻量级可学习深度嵌入来区分不同层的输入。
AI.result: 在 114M 到 1.15B 参数的三种模型规模上进行实验，结果表明在匹配计算和参数预算的情况下，MoRE 相比标准 MoE 和先进的权重共享架构，能够持续取得更低的困惑度（perplexity）和更强的下游任务性能。
AI.conclusion: MoRE 成功结合了 MoE 和循环 Transformer 的优势，在同等参数和计算预算下取得了更好的语言建模与下游任务性能，为高效大模型设计提供了一个有前景的新方向。
AI.translation: 混合专家（MoE）架构将模型容量与计算成本解耦，但随着参数随专家数量线性增长，会导致极高的内存占用。循环 Transformer 通过复用层权重实现了参数高效性，但通常缺乏用于竞争性语言建模的容量。我们提出了混合复用专家（MoRE），这是一种在相邻层组之间共享专家池的混合架构。每一层保留自己的路由器，但从更大的共享池中进行选择，在没有额外参数的情况下扩展了路由组合的多样性。为了使共享专家能够区分不同的层，我们引入了轻量级的可学习深度嵌入，在路由之前对每一层的输入进行条件化处理。在三个模型规模（114M-1.15B 参数）上的实验表明，在匹配计算和参数预算的情况下，MoRE 持续实现了比标准 MoE 和最先进的权重共享架构更低的困惑度和更强的下游性能，且对现有的 MoE 实现只需进行极小的修改。
AI.summary: 本文提出了混合复用专家（MoRE）架构，通过在相邻层间共享专家池并结合轻量级深度嵌入，在不增加额外参数的情况下扩展了路由组合的多样性，在多种模型规模下实现了比标准MoE更优的语言建模和下游性能。
AI.keywords: 混合专家模型, 权重复用, 循环Transformer, 语言建模, 参数效率
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的混合专家与权重复用结合的架构（MoRE），通过共享专家池和引入深度嵌入，在不增加参数量的前提下显著提升了模型的容量与性能，兼具高效性与实用性。

title: A Lattice Boltzmann Method with Adaptive Relaxation Parameter and Lax--Friedrichs-Type Equilibrium for Hyperbolic Systems
summary: In this paper, a lattice Boltzmann method with an adaptive relaxation parameter and a Lax--Friedrichs-type equilibrium is proposed for hyperbolic systems with source terms. The equilibrium distribution recovers the conservative variables and physical fluxes while incorporating dissipation determined by characteristic-speed bounds. To balance accuracy and robustness, the relaxation parameter is selected from a local smoothness indicator based on characteristic projections. In smooth regions, the parameter approaches the low-dissipation limit, retaining second-order accuracy; near discontinuities, it is automatically reduced to introduce localized dissipation and suppress nonphysical oscillations. The stabilization acts directly through the local collision step and preserves the standard collide-and-stream structure, without a posteriori recomputation or interface-based limiting. Maxwell iteration establishes second-order consistency in smooth regions, and a weighted $L^2$-stability estimate is proved for linear hyperbolic systems with periodic boundary conditions under a standard CFL condition. Numerical experiments for scalar advection, Euler, shallow-water, and reactive Euler equations demonstrate the expected accuracy for smooth solutions and robust resolution of challenging one- and two-dimensional discontinuous problems, including wet--dry fronts and reactive discontinuities. A large-scale simulation of a 2D cellular detonation further demonstrates the capability of the method to resolve long-time multidimensional shock--reaction interactions.

AI.title_translation: 一种具有自适应弛豫参数和Lax-Friedrichs型平衡态的双曲系统格子玻尔兹曼方法
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于带源项双曲系统的格子玻尔兹曼方法，该方法结合了自适应弛豫参数和Lax-Friedrichs型平衡态，以在保持精度的同时鲁棒地处理间断问题。
AI.motivation: 针对带源项的双曲系统，提出一种格子玻尔兹曼方法，旨在平衡精度和鲁棒性，有效处理间断问题并抑制非物理振荡。
AI.method: 该方法是一种格子玻尔兹曼方法，采用Lax-Friedrichs型平衡分布来恢复守恒变量和物理通量，并引入由特征速度界限确定的耗散。弛豫参数根据基于特征投影的局部光滑性指标进行自适应选择：在光滑区域接近低耗散极限以保持二阶精度；在间断附近自动减小以引入局部耗散并抑制非物理振荡。稳定化通过局部碰撞步骤直接作用，保持标准的碰撞-流结构。通过Maxwell迭代建立了光滑区域的二阶一致性，并对带周期性边界条件的线性双曲系统在标准CFL条件下证明了加权$L^2$稳定性估计。
AI.result: 数值实验表明，该方法对光滑解具有预期的二阶精度，并能鲁棒地处理具有挑战性的一维和二维间断问题，包括干湿界面和反应性间断。大规模模拟进一步证明了该方法解析长时间多维激波-反应相互作用的能力。理论上，在光滑区域建立了二阶一致性，并对线性系统证明了加权$L^2$稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出并验证了一种具有自适应弛豫参数和Lax-Friedrichs型平衡态的格子玻尔兹曼方法，该方法能够对带源项的双曲系统进行准确且鲁棒的模拟，有效处理光滑解和各种间断问题。
AI.translation: 本文提出了一种具有自适应弛豫参数和Lax-Friedrichs型平衡态的格子玻尔兹曼方法，用于带源项的双曲系统。平衡分布恢复了守恒变量和物理通量，同时结合了由特征速度界限确定的耗散。为了平衡精度和鲁棒性，弛豫参数根据基于特征投影的局部光滑性指标进行选择。在光滑区域，该参数接近低耗散极限，保持二阶精度；在间断附近，它自动减小以引入局部耗散并抑制非物理振荡。稳定化直接通过局部碰撞步骤作用，并保留了标准的碰撞-流结构，无需事后重新计算或基于界面的限制。麦克斯韦迭代建立了光滑区域的二阶一致性，并且在标准CFL条件下，对具有周期性边界条件的线性双曲系统证明了加权$L^2$稳定性估计。对标量对流、欧拉、浅水和反应欧拉方程的数值实验表明，该方法对光滑解具有预期的精度，并能鲁棒地解析具有挑战性的一维和二维间断问题，包括干湿界面和反应性间断。二维蜂窝状爆轰的大规模模拟进一步证明了该方法解析长时间多维激波-反应相互作用的能力。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种新颖的格子玻尔兹曼方法，用于模拟带源项的双曲系统。该方法通过引入Lax-Friedrichs型平衡态和基于局部光滑性指标的自适应弛豫参数，有效平衡了计算精度和数值鲁棒性。它在光滑区域保持二阶精度，并在间断处引入局部耗散以抑制振荡，且稳定化过程直接作用于局部碰撞步骤。数值实验验证了其对光滑解的准确性和对各种复杂间断问题的鲁棒解析能力，包括激波和反应间断，并从理论上证明了其二阶一致性和稳定性。
AI.keywords: 格子玻尔兹曼方法, 双曲系统, 自适应弛豫参数, Lax-Friedrichs型平衡, 间断问题
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于将自适应弛豫参数与Lax-Friedrichs型平衡态相结合，为双曲系统提供了一种鲁棒且高精度的格子玻尔兹曼方法。通过局部光滑性指标自适应调整弛豫参数，避免了传统LBM在处理间断时的缺陷，同时保持了标准碰撞-流结构的简洁性。这种直接在局部碰撞步骤中实现稳定化的方式，相比于后处理或界面限制方法更具效率和普适性。该方法在处理多种复杂流体动力学问题上的成功应用，突显了其潜在的重要性和广泛应用前景。

title: Zero-I/O Fault Recovery for Sharded Deep Learning via Dynamic Framework Dependency Rebinding
summary: Distributed model training at scale is frequently interrupted by transient network failures, conventionally forcing cluster managers to abort all processes and roll back to the latest checkpoint. While periodic checkpointing provides durability, frequent snapshotting introduces severe storage backpressure: our measurements on a 1.216B-parameter decoder reveal that per-update asynchronous checkpointing incurs up to a +656.7% latency overhead, consumes 32.5 GiB of host memory, and generates 3.39 TB/hour of storage traffic. To eliminate this overhead, we present AccelPact, a parallel runtime enabling zero-I/O in-memory fault recovery for sharded distributed training. When communication fails at a committed optimizer step, device memory remains quiescent and uncorrupted, yet continuation fails because frameworks like PyTorch FSDP cache internal communication handles across module wrappers and parameter hierarchies. AccelPact resolves this dependency invalidation via a non-invasive reference-rebinding mechanism coordinated by an out-of-band Gloo consensus protocol. On 16 NVIDIA RTX 5880 GPUs training full-parameter Mistral-7B, AccelPact eliminates checkpoint replay, yielding a 1.197x whole-run goodput improvement over cold restart and 1.194x over NVRx checkpoint restoration at checkpoint age 5, rising to 1.698x at age 18. Across ten successive fault injections, all 16 ranks maintain bit-identical parameter state with zero numerical drift. Across 4-to-16 GPU cluster topologies, reference rebinding executes in constant time (0.493-0.518 ms). Operating directly on native communicator instances, AccelPact requires zero application-code modifications and avoids compiler graph breaks under torch.compile, providing an efficient foundation for resilient deep learning.

AI.title_translation: 基于动态框架依赖重绑定的分片深度学习零I/O故障恢复
AI.tldr: AccelPact是一种用于分片深度学习训练的零I/O内存故障恢复系统，通过动态引用重绑定消除了检查点带来的巨大存储和延迟开销。
AI.motivation: 大规模分布式模型训练常受瞬时网络故障中断，传统定期检查点机制会导致严重的存储背压（如高延迟、内存消耗和存储流量），因此亟需一种无存储I/O开销的高效容错机制。
AI.method: 提出AccelPact并行运行时，利用带外Gloo共识协议协调非侵入式引用重绑定机制，直接操作原生通信器实例以修复通信失败后的依赖失效问题。
AI.result: 在16个NVIDIA RTX 5880 GPU上训练Mistral-7B时，AccelPact消除了检查点重放，相比冷启动提升了1.197倍的有效吞吐量，在检查点年龄较大时提升高达1.698倍，且在多次故障注入下保持零数值漂移，引用重绑定执行时间保持在恒定的0.493-0.518毫秒。
AI.conclusion: AccelPact通过动态框架依赖重绑定技术，成功实现了分片深度学习训练的零I/O内存故障恢复，在消除存储背压的同时大幅提升了训练吞吐量和系统可靠性。
AI.translation: 大规模分布式模型 training 经常被瞬时网络故障打断，传统做法是强迫集群管理器中止所有进程并回滚到最近的检查点。虽然定期检查点保证了持久性，但频繁的快照带来了严重的存储背压：我们对一个1.216B参数解码器的测量显示，每次更新的异步检查点会带来高达 +656.7% 的延迟开销，消耗 32.5 GiB 主机内存，并产生 3.39 TB/小时的存储流量。为了消除这一开销，我们提出了 AccelPact，这是一个并行运行时，可为分片分布式训练实现零 I/O 的内存故障恢复。当通信在某个提交的优化器步骤失败时，设备内存保持静默且未被破坏，但由于 PyTorch FSDP 等框架会在模块包装器和参数层次结构中缓存内部通信句柄，训练无法继续。AccelPact 通过由带外 Gloo 共识协议协调的非侵入式引用重绑定机制解决了这种依赖失效问题。在 16 个 NVIDIA RTX 5880 GPU 上训练全参数 Mistral-7B 时，AccelPact 消除了检查点重放，在检查点年龄为 5 时，相比冷 restart 获得了 1.197x 的整体运行吞吐量提升，相比 NVRx 检查点恢复获得了 1.194x 的提升，在年龄为 18 时上升至 1.698x。在连续十次故障注入中，所有 16 个 rank 都保持了位相同的参数状态，零数值漂移。在 4 到 16 个 GPU 集群拓扑中，引用重绑定在恒定时间（0.493-0.518 毫秒）内执行。AccelPact 直接操作原生通信器实例，需要零应用代码修改，并且在 torch.compile 下避免了编译器图中断，为弹性深度学习提供了高效的基础。
AI.summary: 论文介绍了AccelPact，一个用于分片分布式深度学习训练的零I/O内存故障恢复并行运行时。它通过非侵入式引用重绑定机制解决通信失败后的依赖失效问题，无需修改应用代码或破坏编译器图，有效消除了传统检查点的存储瓶颈并提升了训练吞吐量。
AI.keywords: 零I/O容错, 分布式深度学习, 内存恢复, 引用重绑定, 全参数分片训练
AI.comments: 该论文针对分布式深度学习训练中频繁快照带来的存储和性能瓶颈，创新性地提出了基于内存的零I/O故障恢复机制。通过非侵入式的引用重绑定和Gloo共识协议，在无需修改应用代码的前提下实现了高效容错，具有极高的实用价值和性能优势。

title: Replication Studies: Not Just a Copy
summary: Replication studies revisit previous experimental findings for multiple purposes, including assessing reliability, exploring generalisability, and evaluating research methods. Such studies entail design decisions that a single replication label cannot fully capture, making their designs difficult to describe and compare. We present REPVIS2, a validated design space that describes how a replication study relates to a reference study across eight practical dimensions, each coded as identical, similar, or different. We refined our initial design space, REPVIS1, by applying it to a corpus of replication studies and validated REPVIS2 against a separate corpus. We then characterised 86 replication studies from 51 papers in visualisation through paired reading of the replication and reference reports. Studies often retained the task while changing the procedure, interface, environment, participant population, evidence, or analysis. Additions beyond the replication core were also common. REPVIS2 makes replication design explicit for characterisation, reporting, and planning. An interactive visualisation and supplementary materials are available at https://replication-study.github.io/.

AI.title_translation: 复制研究：不仅仅是复制
AI.tldr: 复制研究并非简单的复制，其设计复杂难以描述和比较。REPVIS2是一个新的、经过验证的设计空间，它通过八个维度来描述复制研究与参考研究的关系，有助于明确复制设计。
AI.motivation: 复制研究的设计决策复杂，单一的“复制”标签无法完全捕捉其设计，导致其难以描述和比较。本研究旨在提供一个结构化的方法来表征复制研究的设计。
AI.method: 本文提出了REPVIS2，一个经过验证的设计空间，它通过八个实用维度（每个维度编码为相同、相似或不同）描述复制研究与参考研究的关系。作者通过将其应用于复制研究语料库来完善初始设计空间REPVIS1，并针对单独的语料库验证了REPVIS2。随后，通过配对阅读复制和参考报告，作者表征了可视化领域51篇论文中的86项复制研究。
AI.result: REPVIS2设计空间得到了开发和验证。对86项复制研究的表征发现，研究通常保留任务，但会改变程序、界面、环境、参与者群体、证据或分析。此外，核心复制之外的补充也很常见。
AI.conclusion: REPVIS2使复制设计变得明确，有助于其表征、报告和规划，从而提高了对复制研究的理解和比较。
AI.translation: 复制研究出于多种目的重新审视先前的实验发现，包括评估可靠性、探索普适性和评估研究方法。此类研究涉及单一复制标签无法完全捕捉的设计决策，使得其设计难以描述和比较。我们提出了REPVIS2，一个经过验证的设计空间，它通过八个实用维度（每个维度编码为相同、相似或不同）描述复制研究与参考研究的关系。我们通过将其应用于复制研究语料库来完善了我们最初的设计空间REPVIS1，并针对单独的语料库验证了REPVIS2。然后，我们通过配对阅读复制和参考报告，表征了可视化领域51篇论文中的86项复制研究。研究通常保留任务，但会改变程序、界面、环境、参与者群体、证据或分析。核心复制之外的补充也很常见。REPVIS2使复制设计在表征、报告和规划方面变得明确。交互式可视化和补充材料可在https://replication-study.github.io/获取。
AI.summary: 本论文引入了REPVIS2，这是一个经过验证的八维度设计空间，旨在明确描述和比较复制研究与其参考研究之间的关系，从而解决复制设计复杂难以表征的挑战。通过将REPVIS2应用于语料库并进行验证，以及表征86项可视化领域的复制研究，作者发现复制研究常在保留核心任务的同时改变程序、界面或参与者等要素，并经常包含额外的补充内容。REPVIS2有助于复制研究的更清晰表征、报告和规划。
AI.keywords: 复制研究, 设计空间, REPVIS2, 可视化, 研究方法
AI.comments: 这篇论文提供了一个有价值的框架（REPVIS2），用于理解和标准化复制研究的描述，这对于科学研究的可靠性至关重要。其创新之处在于将复制研究分解为具体的维度，从而实现细致入微的比较，而非简单的“复制”标签。这有望显著提高复制工作的透明度和实用性。

title: WFM: Wiki Foundation Model for Complex Agentic Reasoning
summary: Real-world agents fundamentally require persistent non-parametric knowledge for dynamic reasoning, i.e., long-term memory and retrieval-augmented generation. While graphs have shown reliable advantages in providing structured evidence, the sparse graph representations naturally restrict machine readability and semantic density required for complex agentic workflows. Driven by this limitation, the entire industry is witnessing a paradigm shift from traditional sparse graphs to LLM Wiki, an agent-native knowledge representation that couples dense document contexts with markdown files containing multi-layered topological linkages. However, parameterizing such rich semantics is challenging to encode dense textual contexts using traditional sparse graph embeddings. Moreover, learning LLM Wiki with existing graph encoders could overwhelm distributed system overheads that hinder deployment in large-scale commercial scenarios. To this end, we propose a novel paradigm Wiki Foundation Model, i.e., WFM, tailored for scalable, agent-native representation and retrieval. Specifically, (i) we formalize a Wiki Graph schema that seamlessly bridges fine-grained structures with dense contexts, maintaining explicit topologies alongside continuous semantics; (ii) A query-conditioned attentive aggregation is tailored for rich wiki message passing and explicit attention variance regularization; (iii) We engineer an infrastructural NCCL boundary exchange protocol that hoists static partition indices and leverages fixed-shape GPU-to-GPU collectives, bypassing CPU serialization and memory copy overheads. Extensive evaluations across five long-term agent memory and multi-hop reasoning benchmarks demonstrate the remarkable performance of WFM, while achieving a 10.5 times training acceleration on distributed clusters.

AI.title_translation: WFM：面向复杂智能体推理的维基基础模型
AI.tldr: WFM是一个新的维基基础模型，用于可扩展的、智能体原生知识表示和检索，解决了传统稀疏图和现有图编码器在处理LLM Wiki时的局限性，并在性能和训练速度上表现出色。
AI.motivation: 传统稀疏图表示限制了机器可读性和复杂智能体工作流所需的语义密度。现有图编码器在处理LLM Wiki（一种结合密集文档上下文和多层拓扑链接的智能体原生知识表示）时，难以编码密集文本上下文，并可能导致分布式系统开销过大，阻碍大规模商业部署。
AI.method: 提出了WFM（Wiki Foundation Model）范式，具体包括：(i) 形式化了一个Wiki Graph schema，将细粒度结构与密集上下文无缝连接，同时保持显式拓扑和连续语义；(ii) 设计了查询条件注意力聚合，用于丰富的维基消息传递和显式注意力方差正则化；(iii) 工程化了基础设施NCCL边界交换协议，提升静态分区索引并利用固定形状的GPU到GPU集合通信，绕过CPU序列化和内存复制开销。
AI.result: 在五个长期智能体记忆和多跳推理基准测试中，WFM展现出卓越的性能，并在分布式集群上实现了10.5倍的训练加速。
AI.conclusion: WFM提供了一种可扩展、智能体原生的知识表示和检索新范式，有效解决了现有方法的局限性，并在性能和效率方面取得了显著提升。
AI.translation: 真实世界的智能体从根本上需要持久的非参数知识来进行动态推理，即长期记忆和检索增强生成。虽然图在提供结构化证据方面显示出可靠的优势，但稀疏的图表示自然限制了机器可读性和复杂智能体工作流所需的语义密度。受此限制驱动，整个行业正在见证从传统稀疏图到LLM Wiki的范式转变，LLM Wiki是一种智能体原生知识表示，它将密集文档上下文与包含多层拓扑链接的Markdown文件相结合。然而，参数化这种丰富的语义对于使用传统稀疏图嵌入来编码密集文本上下文具有挑战性。此外，使用现有图编码器学习LLM Wiki可能会导致分布式系统开销过大，从而阻碍在大规模商业场景中的部署。为此，我们提出了一种新颖的范式——维基基础模型（WFM），专为可扩展的、智能体原生表示和检索而设计。具体来说，(i) 我们形式化了一个维基图模式，它无缝地桥接了细粒度结构与密集上下文，同时保持了显式拓扑和连续语义；(ii) 针对丰富的维基消息传递和显式注意力方差正则化，定制了查询条件注意力聚合；(iii) 我们设计了一个基础设施NCCL边界交换协议，该协议提升了静态分区索引并利用固定形状的GPU到GPU集合通信，绕过了CPU序列化和内存复制开销。在五个长期智能体记忆和多跳推理基准测试中进行的广泛评估表明，WFM表现出卓越的性能，同时在分布式集群上实现了10.5倍的训练加速。
AI.summary: 这篇论文提出了WFM（Wiki Foundation Model），一个针对复杂智能体推理的维基基础模型。WFM通过引入Wiki Graph schema、查询条件注意力聚合和优化的NCCL边界交换协议，解决了传统稀疏图和现有图编码器在处理LLM Wiki时的局限性，实现了可扩展、智能体原生的知识表示和检索。实验表明，WFM在多项基准测试中表现卓越，并显著加速了训练过程。
AI.keywords: Wiki Foundation Model, 智能体推理, 知识表示, 图神经网络, 分布式训练
AI.comments: WFM的创新之处在于其结合了密集文档上下文与结构化拓扑链接的LLM Wiki知识表示，并针对其可扩展性提出了专门的模型架构和分布式训练优化。它解决了现有图表示和编码器在处理复杂、动态、大规模智能体知识时的瓶颈，特别是通过硬件层面的优化来提升效率，对于推动智能体在现实世界应用中的发展具有重要意义。

title: Misgendering as Breakdown in Human-Machine Communication: How AI Companion Chatbot Users Experience and Repair Misgendering
summary: In recent years, large language model-based AI companion and role play chatbots have grown increasingly popular. People turn to these chatbots for emotional support and to engage in romantic and erotic role play. Although prior research suggests that digital role play can help people explore their gender and sexuality, LLM based technologies are also replete with gender and sexuality biases. In this study, we examine one way that AI chatbots can harm users: misgendering. In order to study chatbot misgendering we qualitatively analyzed 326 posts mentioning misgendering that were shared in AI companion or role play subreddits. We document how chatbot misgendering takes place and how, in response, users engage in ongoing work to curate their gender presentation to prevent and repair misgendering. We discuss how researchers and designers can mitigate chatbot misgendering and consider the implications of using AI chatbots for identity exploration.

AI.title_translation: 将性别错认视为人机交流中的故障：AI伴侣聊天机器人用户如何经历和修复性别错认
AI.tldr: AI伴侣聊天机器人因偏见而对用户进行性别错认。用户努力预防和修复这种情况，这凸显了设计师需要减轻性别错认并考虑其对身份探索的影响。
AI.motivation: 基于大型语言模型的AI伴侣和角色扮演聊天机器人日益流行，用户寻求情感支持和参与角色扮演。尽管数字角色扮演有助于性别和性取向探索，但LLM技术也存在性别和性取向偏见。本研究旨在探讨AI聊天机器人通过性别错认对用户造成伤害的方式。
AI.method: 本研究定性分析了在AI伴侣或角色扮演子版块中分享的326个提及性别错认的帖子。
AI.result: 研究记录了聊天机器人性别错认是如何发生的，以及作为回应，用户如何持续努力策划自己的性别呈现以防止和修复性别错认。
AI.conclusion: 研究人员和设计师需要减轻聊天机器人的性别错认问题，并应考虑使用AI聊天机器人进行身份探索的潜在影响。
AI.translation: 近年来，基于大型语言模型的AI伴侣和角色扮演聊天机器人越来越受欢迎。人们转向这些聊天机器人寻求情感支持，并参与浪漫和情色角色扮演。尽管先前的研究表明数字角色扮演可以帮助人们探索自己的性别和性取向，但基于LLM的技术也充满了性别和性取向偏见。在本研究中，我们探讨了AI聊天机器人可能伤害用户的一种方式：性别错认。为了研究聊天机器人性别错认，我们定性分析了在AI伴侣或角色扮演子版块中分享的326个提及性别错认的帖子。我们记录了聊天机器人性别错认是如何发生的，以及作为回应，用户如何持续努力策划自己的性别呈现以防止和修复性别错认。我们讨论了研究人员和设计师如何减轻聊天机器人性别错认，并考虑了使用AI聊天机器人进行身份探索的影响。
AI.summary: 本研究调查了基于大型语言模型的AI伴侣聊天机器人如何对用户进行性别错认，这是一种源于LLM固有性别和性取向偏见的伤害，尽管它们在情感支持和身份探索方面很受欢迎。通过对326个Reddit帖子的定性分析，研究揭示了聊天机器人性别错认的机制以及用户如何积极管理其性别呈现以预防和纠正这种错误。论文最后敦促研究人员和设计师解决性别错认问题，并考虑AI在身份探索方面的更广泛影响。
AI.keywords: AI聊天机器人, 性别错认, 人机交流, 性别认同, LLM偏见, 身份探索
AI.comments: 这篇论文强调了人机交互中一个关键的伦理和设计挑战，尤其考虑到AI伴侣在情感支持和身份探索等敏感领域日益重要的作用。定性方法为理解AI偏见的实际影响和用户应对策略提供了宝贵的用户中心洞察。其对“修复”和“策划”的关注为改进AI设计提供了实用的方向。

title: Single-Token Expected-Value Scoring for Cold-Start Candidate Ranking
comments: 10 pages, 7 figures. Accepted at RecSys in HR '26: The 6th Workshop on Recommender Systems for Human Resources, in conjunction with the 20th ACM Conference on Recommender Systems (RecSys 2026), September 28 - October 2, 2026, Minneapolis, MN, USA. To appear in CEUR Workshop Proceedings
summary:
AI-assisted sourcing streamlines candidate review, reducing the administrative burden of manual screening for recruiters. However, deploying language models as production rankers remains challenging. Zero-shot Large Language Models (LLMs) may produce unstable, non-deterministic scores and rank less accurately, while conventional deep neural rankers require millions of logged interactions that a low-traffic, niche sourcing platform does not produce. What is available instead is a few hundred thousand ordinal relevance labels -- small by ranker-training standards, but sufficient when a pretrained language model already encodes the general world knowledge the task depends on.
  We present single-token expected-value scoring, a ranking primitive that casts candidate-job relevance as an ordinal classification over the grade tokens {1, ..., 5} and reads the relevance score as the expectation of the first-token probability distribution. Because the score comes from a single decoding step rather than open-ended generation, it is a deterministic function of the model's logits, requires no output parsing, and serves at low latency. To learn the non-linear interdependencies of heterogeneous hiring criteria from this supervision alone, we fine-tune a Small Language Model (SLM) with a hybrid ordinal regression loss combining a Mean Squared Error term, which preserves ordinal distance, with a categorical Cross-Entropy term, which sharpens class boundaries.
  We evaluate along two dimensions -- Jobseeker Relevance and Employer Relevance -- using NDCG@10 and low relevance rate. Offline, our fine-tuned model outperforms a heuristic baseline and zero-shot LLMs. An end-to-end simulation shows the same direction at larger magnitude (+54.2% Jobseeker NDCG@10, -46.7% low relevance rate), and a live online experiment reduces employer low-relevance by 27.3% and raises employer keep rate by 7.07%.
comment: 10 pages, 7 figures. Accepted at RecSys in HR '26: The 6th Workshop on Recommender Systems for Human Resources, in conjunction with the 20th ACM Conference on Recommender Systems (RecSys 2026), September 28 - October 2, 2026, Minneapolis, MN, USA. To appear in CEUR Workshop Proceedings

AI.title_translation: 用于冷启动候选人排序的单Token期望值评分
AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于单Token期望值评分和小语言模型的冷启动候选人排序方法，有效解决了传统大模型不稳定和传统排序器数据依赖的问题，大幅提升了招聘匹配的准确性和业务指标。
AI.motivation: 解决AI辅助招聘中冷启动候选人排序的难题：零样本大语言模型存在不稳定且非确定性评分的问题，而传统的深度神经网络排序器需要海量的交互日志，这在低流量、小众的招聘平台上无法满足。
AI.method: 提出单Token期望值评分法（将相关性转化为等级Token的概率期望），并使用带有均方误差和交叉熵的混合序数回归损失对小型语言模型（SLM）进行微调。
AI.result: 离线评估中，微调模型优于启发式基线和零样本LLM；端到端仿真显示Jobseeker NDCG@10提升54.2%，低相关率降低46.7%；线上实验表明雇主低相关率降低27.3%，雇主保留率提高7.07%。
AI.conclusion: 通过单Token期望值评分和混合序数回归微调，小型语言模型能够有效解决冷启动候选人排序问题，在离线和在线实验中均表现出优异的性能。
AI.translation:
AI辅助寻源简化了候选人审查，减轻了招聘人员手动筛选的管理负担。然而，将语言模型部署为生产排序器仍然具有挑战性。零样本大语言模型（LLM）可能会产生不稳定、非确定性的分数，且排序准确性较低，而传统的深度神经排序器需要数百万次低流量、小众寻源平台所不具备的日志交互数据。取而代之的是几十万个序数相关性标签——按照排序器训练的标准来看这很小，但当预训练语言模型已经编码了任务依赖的通用世界知识时，这就足够了。
我们提出了单Token期望值评分，这是一种将候选人-工作相关性投射为对等级Token {1, ..., 5} 的序数分类的排序基元，并将相关性分数读取为第一个Token概率分布的期望值。由于该分数来自单步解码而非开放式生成，它是模型Logits的确定性函数，无需输出解析，且服务延迟低。为了仅从这种监督中学习异构招聘标准的非线性相互依赖性，我们使用结合了均方误差项（保持序数距离）和分类交叉熵项（尖锐化类别边界）的混合序数回归损失来微调小型语言模型（SLM）。
我们从两个维度（求职者相关性和雇主相关性）进行了评估——使用了NDCG@10和低相关率。在离线状态下，我们的微调模型优于启发式基线和零样本LLM。端到端仿真显示了更大幅度的同方向提升（Jobseeker NDCG@10提升+54.2%，低相关率降低-46.7%），并且实时在线实验将雇主的低相关率降低了27.3%，将雇主保留率提高了7.07%。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了一种用于冷启动候选人排序的单Token期望值评分方法。通过将候选人-工作相关性转化为对等级Token的序数分类，并计算第一个Token概率分布的期望值，该方法实现了低延迟、确定性的评分。结合混合序数回归损失微调小型语言模型，在离线仿真和线上实验中均显著提升了候选人排序的准确性和业务指标。
AI.keywords: 候选人排序, 冷启动, 语言模型, 序数分类, 期望值评分
AI.comments: 该论文针对冷启动候选人排序问题，创新性地提出了单Token期望值评分法，结合小型语言模型（SLM）与混合序数回归损失，有效解决了零样本LLM的不稳定性和传统深度学习排序器对海量交互数据的依赖，在理论和实际应用中均取得了显著效果。

title: Transformation Laws in Neural Representations: Structure, Realisability, and Construction
summary: How neural representations preserve the structure of input changes connects representation analysis with internal intervention. We study operable representational content through compatible actions of reference transformations on neural features. We characterise when a transformation descends through an encoder, and give a linear setting in which the defect is governed by the transformation's demand for discarded information, measured in the metric the representation induces. On a rectifier the failure to realise a transformation has two distinguishable sources --- what the source region has already made unrecoverable, and what it costs to satisfy every region the transformation visits with one operator --- and for a \textit{measured} harmonic carrier the same question has a closed answer: a linear realisation exists exactly when the retained harmonic blocks are invariant under the action. Using colour as the in-depth instance, we find that hue orbits in frozen visual features concentrate 84--88\% of their energy in the first two harmonics with rotation planes shared across shapes, that this organisation is substantially inherited from input and architecture and is reshaped by training and depth, and that the measured structure supports prediction, transport from new starting states, and composition --- with global and local realisations differing sharply in which they achieve. Guided by the measurements, we construct a compact interface whose rotation action is fixed by the structure and never fitted: it reads hue zero-shot at 3.4$^\circ$ median error on unseen shapes. Theory, structural measurement, and construction together establish transformation laws as a concrete object connecting the understanding of neural representations to their design.

AI.title_translation: 神经表示中的变换规律：结构、可实现性与构建
AI.tldr: 该论文研究了神经网络表示中的变换规律，从理论、测量和构建三个方面揭示了神经特征如何保持输入结构，并据此设计了高性能的零样本色调预测接口。
AI.motivation: 理解神经网络表示如何保持输入变化的结构，这连接了表征分析与内部干预，旨在研究可操作的表征内容以及变换在神经特征上的实现规律。
AI.method: 研究了参考变换在神经特征上的相容作用，刻画了变换何时能通过编码器，并在线性设置、整流器和测度谐波载体（measured harmonic carrier）下分析了变换实现的缺陷；以颜色色调（hue）为例进行了深入的实证测量，并构建了一个无需拟合的紧凑接口。
AI.result: 发现冷冻视觉特征中的色调轨道将其84-88%的能量集中在前两个谐波中，且旋转平面在不同形状间共享；构建了一个零样本下预测色调中位误差达3.4°的紧凑接口。
AI.conclusion: 通过理论、结构测量和构建相结合，该论文确立了变换规律作为连接神经网络表示理解与设计的具体桥梁。
AI.translation: 神经网络表示如何保持输入变化的结构，将表征分析与内部干预连接起来。我们通过参考变换在神经特征上的相容作用来研究可操作的表征内容。我们刻画了变换何时能通过编码器下降，并给出了一个线性设置，其中缺陷由变换对被丢弃信息的需求所决定，该需求由表示诱导的度量来衡量。在整流器上，未能实现变换有两个可区分的来源——源区域已经无法恢复的信息，以及用一个算子满足变换访问的每个区域所需的代价；对于一个测度的谐波载体，相同的问题有一个封闭的答案：当且仅当保留的谐波块在作用下是不变的时，线性实现才存在。以颜色作为深入实例，我们发现冷冻视觉特征中的色调轨道将84-88%的能量集中在前两个谐波中，其旋转平面在不同形状间共享，这种组织在很大程度上继承自输入和架构，并被训练和深度所重塑，并且测度的结构支持预测、从新起始状态的传输以及组合——全局和局部实现在它们所能达到的目标上存在显著差异。在测量的指导下，我们构建了一个紧凑的接口，其旋转作用由结构固定且无需拟合：它在未见过的形状上以3.4°的中位误差零样本读取色调。理论、结构测量和构建共同确立了变换规律作为连接神经网络表示理解与其设计的具体对象。
AI.summary: 该论文研究了神经网络中如何通过参考变换的相容作用来保持输入变化结构，探讨了变换在编码器、整流器及谐波载体中的可实现性，并通过颜色色调的实例验证了理论，最终构建了一个基于结构的不需拟合的紧凑接口。
AI.keywords: Neural Representations, Transformation Laws, Feature Analysis, Harmonic Carrier, Color Hue
AI.comments: 该论文从结构、可实现性和构建三个维度深入探讨了神经网络表示中的变换规律，将表征分析与内部干预紧密结合，具有很高的理论价值和实际应用潜力。

title: OmniRisk: Omnidirectional Trajectory-Risk Learning for Agile Quadrotor Dynamic Avoidance
summary: Agile quadrotor avoidance of fast-moving obstacles requires anticipating collisions and selecting feasible maneuvers within short reaction windows. Reliable predictive avoidance remains challenging because sparse range observations do not directly reveal obstacle motion, while online trajectory optimizers either scale poorly with obstacle count or remain efficient at the expense of reliability in dense, high-speed encounters. We present OmniRisk, an omnidirectional planning framework that learns trajectory-level risk offline for efficient onboard evasion. A fixed-dimensional tensor combines LiDAR range panoramas, dynamic masks, and Cartesian surface velocities to represent geometry and motion jointly. We formulate an asymmetric risk field aligned with obstacle velocity that emphasizes approaching interactions and attenuates receding ones. Accumulating this risk along predicted relative trajectories provides dense supervision and discourages unnecessary hesitation after obstacles pass. A dual-branch circular convolutional network predicts terminal boundary states and dynamic risks for candidate primitives over an omnidirectional anchor lattice in a single forward pass, followed by selection and closed-form reconstruction of the selected candidate primitive. This formulation removes online risk accumulation along trajectories and makes risk-inference cost independent of obstacle count. OmniRisk enables efficient onboard avoidance, with real-world flights demonstrating consecutive evasive maneuvers at relative encounter speeds up to 15 m/s without fine-tuning. Code is available at https://github.com/VANdexj/OmniRisk.

AI.title_translation: OmniRisk：用于灵巧四旋翼动态避障的全向轨迹风险学习
AI.tldr: OmniRisk是一个创新的四旋翼全向动态避障框架，通过离线轨迹风险学习和单次前向推理，实现了在高达15 m/s相对速度下的高效连续避障。
AI.motivation: 灵巧四旋翼对快速移动障碍物的规避需要在短反应窗口内预测碰撞并选择可行的机动动作。现有的在线轨迹优化器在面对密集、高速环境时，在计算效率和可靠性之间难以两全。
AI.method: 利用固定维度的张量联合表示LiDAR测距全景图、动态掩码和笛卡尔表面速度；构建与障碍物速度对齐的非对称风险场；采用双分支循环卷积网络在单次前向传递中预测候选基元的终端边界状态和动态风险。
AI.result: 实现了高效的车载避障，真实世界的飞行测试表明，在相对交会速度高达15米/秒的情况下，无需微调即可进行连续的规避机动。
AI.conclusion: OmniRisk能够实现高效的车载动态避障，在无微调的情况下，在高达15米/秒的相对交会速度下表现出连续的避障能力。
AI.translation: 四旋翼灵巧规避快速移动的障碍物需要在短反应窗口内预测碰撞并选择可行的机动方案。可靠的预测性规避依然充满挑战，因为稀疏的测距观测无法直接揭示障碍物的运动，而在线轨迹优化器要么在面对障碍物数量时扩展性差，要么在密集、高速的交会中以牺牲可靠性为代价换取效率。我们提出了OmniRisk，这是一个全向规划框架，它离线学习轨迹级风险以进行高效的车载规避。固定维度的张量结合了LiDAR测距全景图、动态掩码和笛卡尔表面速度，以联合表示几何和运动。我们构建了一个与障碍物速度对齐的非对称风险场，该风险场强调接近的交互并减弱远离的交互。沿着预测的相对轨迹累积该风险提供了密集监督，并抑制了障碍物通过后不必要的犹豫。双分支循环卷积网络在单次前向传递中预测全向锚定格子上的候选基元的终端边界状态和动态风险，随后对选定的候选基元进行选择和闭式重建。这种公式消除了轨迹上的在线风险累积，并使风险推理成本与障碍物数量无关。OmniRisk实现了高效的车载规避，真实世界的飞行展示了在相对交会速度高达15米/秒的情况下进行连续规避机动且无需微调。代码可在 https://github.com/VANdexj/OmniRisk 获取。
AI.summary: OmniRisk是一个全向规划框架，通过离线学习轨迹级风险来实现高效的机载规避。它通过固定维度张量结合LiDAR和运动数据，构建非对称风险场，利用双分支循环卷积网络在单次前向传递中预测候选风险，消除了在线风险累积，使得推理成本与障碍物数量无关，从而在高速动态避障中表现优异。
AI.keywords: 四旋翼避障, 轨迹级风险学习, 动态避障, 全向规划, 深度学习
AI.comments: 该论文提出了OmniRisk框架，通过离线学习轨迹级风险，并在全向锚定格子（anchor lattice）上进行高效的在线推理，成功解决了灵巧四旋翼在高速、密集动态障碍物环境下的避障难题。其核心创新在于速度对齐的非对称风险场以及独立于障碍物数量的推理开销。

title: WAVE-Go: World-Model Navigation with Adaptive Execution for Wheel-Legged Robots
summary: World models can anticipate the consequences of navigation actions, but predicted action sequences may become invalid during execution, especially when wheel-legged robots encounter dynamic obstacles or change locomotion modes. We propose WAVE-Go, an image-goal navigation framework that separates world-action prediction from interruptible command execution. Its executor adaptively selects an action prefix and cancels pending commands when updated observations invalidate execution. A conditional-risk formulation specifies prefix selection under an estimated cumulative failure budget, while posture and locomotion-mode transitions require clearance, stability, and task-evidence checks. In the reported navigation evaluation, WAVE-Go achieves 74.1% in-distribution success and 63.3% dynamic out-of-distribution success, exceeding the strongest baseline by 4.7 and 7.7 percentage points, respectively, while reducing collisions from 4.4 to 2.9 per 100 m. Compared with interruptible fixed four-command execution, WAVE-Go raises success by 4.0 percentage points while reducing replanning frequency by 51.2% and collision rate by 6.5%. Execution ablations also show that runtime interruption improves success, collision rate, and reaction latency at the cost of additional replanning. These results support adaptive, interruptible execution as a means of balancing navigation performance and planning overhead. Code is available at https://github.com/vigorlee/wave-go.

AI.title_translation: WAVE-Go：面向轮足机器人的具备自适应执行能力的世界模型导航
AI.tldr: WAVE-Go是一个面向轮足机器人的世界模型导航框架，通过自适应和可中断的命令执行，在动态环境中实现了更高成功率和更少碰撞。
AI.motivation: 虽然世界模型能够预测导航动作的后果，但当轮足机器人遇到动态障碍物或改变运动模式时，预测的动作序列在执行过程中可能会失效，现有的方法难以平衡导航性能与规划开销。
AI.method: 提出了WAVE-Go图像目标导航框架，将世界-动作预测与可中断的命令执行分离；执行器能够根据更新的观测结果自适应选择动作前缀并取消未决命令，同时采用条件风险公式进行前缀选择，并对姿态与运动模式转换进行清除、稳定性和任务证据检查。
AI.result: 在导航评估中，WAVE-Go在分布内成功率达到74.1%，动态分布外成功率达到63.3%，分别比最强基线高出4.7和7.7个百分点，并将碰撞率从每100米4.4次降低到2.9次，同时将重规划频率降低了51.2%。
AI.conclusion: WAVE-Go通过结合世界模型预测与自适应、可中断的命令执行机制，显著提升了轮足机器人在动态和复杂环境中的导航成功率，并降低了碰撞率与重规划频率。
AI.translation: 世界模型可以预测导航动作的后果，但预测的动作序列在执行过程中可能会失效，尤其是当轮足机器人遇到动态障碍物或改变运动模式时。我们提出了WAVE-Go，这是一个将世界-动作预测与可中断命令执行相分离的图像目标导航框架。其执行器能够自适应地选择动作前缀，并在更新的观测结果使执行失效时取消未决命令。条件风险公式在估计的累积失败预算下指定前缀选择，而姿态和运动模式转换则需要进行清除、稳定性和任务证据检查。在报告的导航评估中，WAVE-Go在分布内取得了74.1%的成功率，在动态分布外取得了63.3%的成功率，分别比最强基线高出4.7和7.7个百分点，同时将每100米的碰撞次数从4.4次减少到2.9次。与可中断的固定四命令执行相比，WAVE-Go将成功率提高了4.0个百分点，同时将重规划频率降低了51.2%，碰撞率降低了6.5%。执行消融实验还表明，运行时中断以额外的重规划为代价，提高了成功率、碰撞率和反应延迟。这些结果支持将自适应、可中断的执行作为平衡导航性能和规划开销的一种手段。代码可在 https://github.com/vigorlee/wave-go 获取。
AI.summary: WAVE-Go是一个针对轮足机器人的图像目标导航框架，通过将世界-动作预测与可中断的命令执行相分离，利用条件风险公式和自适应执行机制，在动态环境中显著提高了导航成功率并减少了碰撞。
AI.keywords: 轮足机器人, 世界模型, 视觉导航, 自适应执行, 动态避障
AI.comments: 该论文针对轮足机器人在动态环境下的图像目标导航问题，提出了WAVE-Go框架。其创新点在于将世界-动作预测与可中断的命令执行解耦，并通过条件风险公式和多维度检查机制自适应调整动作前缀与取消失效命令，有效平衡了导航性能和规划开销。

title: T-SANDHI: Tone Sandhi-aware Adaptive Network with Decoupled Hybrid Injection for Low-resource Taiwanese Hokkien Speech Recognition
summary: In Taiwanese Hokkien automatic speech recognition (ASR), prior studies often treat tone sandhi as a major challenge under the assumption that models fail to process implicit phonological variations. However, our experiments on Taiwanese Hokkien reveal that speech foundation models actually handle tone sandhi variations effectively, and the real performance bottleneck stems from a localized confusion between these variations and retained citation tones. To address this, we propose T-SANDHI to explicitly decouple surface acoustics from underlying lexical intent on top of a frozen Whisper backbone. Using a lexicon-guided multi-task learning structure driven by text-derived pseudo labels, our lightweight hybrid injection module integrates independent citation and sandhi phonetic streams via dynamic gating. Extensive evaluation on the TAT-MOE corpus and two blind test sets demonstrates that this explicit disentanglement effectively resolves tonal mapping confusion, outperforming baselines with strict parameter efficiency.

AI.title_translation: T-SANDHI：面向低资源台湾闽南语语音识别的连读变调感知自适应网络与解耦混合注入
AI.tldr: 本文提出了T-SANDHI模型，通过显式解耦变调与本调来解决低资源台湾闽南语语音识别中的音调映射混淆问题，显著提升了识别性能并保持了参数高效性。
AI.motivation: 传统研究认为语音基础模型无法处理台湾闽南语中隐式的连读变调现象，而作者发现其实际上能有效处理，真正的性能瓶颈在于变调变体与保留的本调之间的局部混淆。
AI.method: 提出T-SANDHI模型，在冻结的Whisper骨干网络之上，采用词典引导的多任务学习结构和文本导出的伪标签，通过动态门控的轻量级混合注入模块集成独立的引申调和变调语音流。
AI.result: 在TAT-MOE语料库和两个盲测集上的广泛评估表明，该显式解耦方法有效解决了音调映射混淆问题，在保持严格参数效率的同时优于基线模型。
AI.conclusion: T-SANDHI模型通过显式解耦表面声学与底层词汇意图，有效解决了台湾闽南语语音识别中的变调混淆问题，在低资源设置下以极高的参数效率超越了现有基线。
AI.translation: 在台湾闽南语自动语音识别（ASR）中，先前的研究通常将连读变调视为主要挑战，假设模型无法处理隐式的音系变体。然而，我们在台湾闽南语上的实验表明，语音基础模型实际上能有效地处理变调变体，真正的性能瓶颈源于这些变体与保留的本调之间的局部混淆。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了T-SANDHI，在冻结的Whisper骨干网络之上，显式地将表面声学与底层词汇意图解耦。利用由文本派生伪标签驱动的词典引导多任务学习结构，我们的轻量级混合注入模块通过动态门控集成独立的本调和变调语音流。在TAT-MOE语料库和两个盲测集上的广泛评估表明，这种显式解耦有效地解决了音调映射混淆问题，以严格的参数效率优于基线模型。
AI.summary: 该论文针对低资源台湾闽南语语音识别，发现语音基础模型处理变调的瓶颈在于变调与本调的局部混淆，并提出了T-SANDHI模型，通过解耦声学与词汇意图、引入轻量级混合注入模块，有效提升了识别性能。
AI.keywords: 台湾闽南语, 语音识别, 连读变调, 语音基础模型, 多任务学习
AI.comments: 本文针对台语语音识别中的变调现象提出了独特的见解，打破了传统观念，并通过解耦声学与词汇意图的轻量级混合注入模块解决了局部混淆问题，兼具创新性与参数效率。

title: ISIA-AF: Orchestrating Reproducible Attacks and Multi-Source Data Collection for OT Systems
comments: 8 pages, 1 Figure, 1 Table, submitted version to Euromicro Software Engineering and Advanced Applications (SEAA)
summary: Operational Technology (OT) environments require realistic, reproducible security datasets, yet existing approaches often lack automation, multi-source data capture, and sufficient documentation for reuse. This paper presents ISIA-AF, a modular attack framework for orchestrating reproducible attack execution and automated dataset generation on industrial systems. The framework coordinates distributed attack clients, records network traffic and operational data, ultimately leading to a multi-source dataset. We derive functional and non-functional requirements from prior work and stakeholder discussions, and realise the framework following a design science research approach. A case study on the ISIA testbed, comprising a real industrial system and a simulated process, demonstrates how the framework supports centralised control, low communication overhead, and flexible deployment across network segments. The result is a practical basis for generating extensible, multi-source OT security datasets for intrusion detection research.

AI.title_translation: ISIA-AF：编排OT系统的可重复攻击与多源数据采集

title: WholeBodyWAM: Learning Whole-Body World Action Models with Scalable Motion Priors
summary: Humanoid whole-body manipulation requires coordinated whole-body dynamics, yet large-scale trajectories from a target robot are expensive to collect and difficult to scale. In contrast, whole-body motion from human and humanoid sources is abundantly available, although such data cannot be directly used as embodiment-specific robot actions. This work asks whether these scalable motion resources can instead provide a transferable predictive prior for humanoid world-action modeling. We introduce WholeBodyWAM, a humanoid world-action model that learns whole-body dynamics from large-scale heterogeneous motion before target-robot training. We curate UniMotion-4K, a motion corpus spanning more than 4K hours from human videos, native 3D motion datasets, and heterogeneous humanoid platforms, and canonicalize these diverse sources into a unified motion space. A language-conditioned Motion Expert is then pretrained to predict future whole-body motion without target-robot action supervision. During robot post-training, the pretrained Motion Expert is integrated with Video and Action Experts through asymmetric Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) attention, enabling predictive scene dynamics and whole-body motion to jointly inform embodiment-specific action generation. Experiments show that WholeBodyWAM consistently benefits from increased motion-pretraining scale, improves future-motion prediction and downstream task performance, and transfers effectively to real-world humanoid manipulation. Moreover, the pretrained motion prior substantially improves data efficiency under limited target-robot demonstrations.

title: Subquadratic-Query Algorithms for Finding Another Maximum Matroid Intersection
summary: Let $\mathcal{M}_1,\mathcal{M}_2$ be two matroids on a common ground set $V$, given by independence oracles, and let $S$ be a maximum-cardinality common independent set. We study the problem of deciding whether there exists another maximum common independent set $T\ne S$, and of outputting one when it exists. Writing $n=|V|$ and $r=|S|$, we give a Las Vegas algorithm using $\tilde O(n\sqrt r)$ expected independence queries and a deterministic algorithm using $\tilde O(nr^{2/3})$ queries. As an application, all maximum common independent sets can be enumerated with at most two another-solution calls between consecutive outputs and after the last output; if there are $L$ solutions, exactly $2L-1$ such calls are made. Neither algorithm constructs the exchange graph. Instead, they perform Kahn-style source peeling through two deletion-only data structures. One side uses the heavy/light categorization of Blikstad, van den Brand, Mukhopadhyay, and Nanongkai. For the opposite side, where no transposed oracle is available, we give a collective randomized classifier and a deterministic capacity-saturation certificate.

title: Behavior2Value: Benchmarking and Empowering LLMs for Consumer Value Measurement from E-commerce Behaviors
summary: Human values are deep motivational orientations that shape human behaviors. In e-commerce, they reveal the stable drivers behind users' purchase decisions. Compared with short-term interests, consumer values better explain how users evaluate products before purchase. However, consumer values are often implicit in complex and fragmented behavioral trajectories, leaving value measurement from e-commerce behaviors largely underexplored. To this end, we propose the Behavior-to-Value (B2V) task, which aims to identify consumer values from e-commerce behavioral trajectories. Centered on this task, we first construct the E-commerce Consumption Value Taxonomy (ECVT) and introduce B2V-Bench, the first B2V dataset and benchmark, based on anonymized Taobao behavioral logs. B2V-Bench consists of real-world purchase decision episodes, covering 25 types of purchase behaviors, along with corresponding consumer value orientations manifested in each episode. To improve consumer value measurement accuracy, we further present B2V-Verifier, a behavior-to-value measurement model based on Value Verification Tuning, which learns to assess whether behaviors provide sufficient evidence for each value inference. Experiments show that B2V-Verifier outperforms strong LLM baselines, improving multi-label classification by 34\%. The dataset and code will be publicly released upon acceptance.

title: Beyond Accuracy: How Procedural Traces Shift the Decision Criterion of LLM Overseers
comments: 11 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables. Accepted at the 60th Hawaii International Conference on System Sciences (HICSS)
summary: Organizations increasingly use oversight loops where one large language model (LLM) audits another's outputs alongside procedural traces of claimed steps. A common concern about such LLM-as-a-judge pipelines is that detailed traces make overseers gullible. Using signal detection theory, we audit five LLM overseers on 19 compliance tasks (4,551 analyzed judgments), varying only trace detail and evidence labeling. With disconfirming evidence always visible, error detection remains near ceiling. Instead, elaborate traces shift the decision criterion toward rejection, increasing false alarms in susceptible overseers. Without option labels, human-validated reason coding shows about 60% of false alarms cite an inability to tie evidence to its option. Labels eliminate this stated reason, yet residual rejection of correct work persists in those overseers and rises with trace detail. Procedural traces thus act as governance artifacts that shape oversight decisions. AI auditors should be evaluated by their decision criterion and false-alarm behavior, alongside accuracy.

title: CapMap-MS-TTA: 3rd Place Solution for the MUMU Track of the 8th LSVOS Challenge at ECCV 2026
summary: The MUMU track of the 8th Large-scale Video Object Segmentation (LSVOS) Challenge requires a single unified multimodal model to jointly solve image tagging (Task A), open-vocabulary object detection (Task B), and English captioning (Task C) under strict resource constraints (<=0.5B parameters and <=8 GB peak GPU memory). We present CapMap-MS-TTA, a training-free submission built on Microsoft Florence-2-base (~231M parameters), combining caption keyword mapping with multi-scale flip test-time augmentation. Task C uses the native <DETAILED_CAPTION> pathway with length/token sanitization. Task A maps the same detailed caption into the official quality/scene/event vocabularies via an expanded keyword lexicon with whole-word matching and a lightweight expand-hints stage. Task B runs Florence-2 open detection (<OD>) with multi-scale and horizontal-flip test-time augmentation (TTA), followed by label-aware non-maximum suppression (NMS). Without fine-tuning, the system improves our reproduced Florence-2 baseline from 15.16 to a best public score of 16.4815, and ranks 3rd on the final MUMU leaderboard.

title: Reinforcement Learning for Real-Time Vision-Language-Action Policies
summary: Reinforcement learning fine-tuning on top of large, pretrained Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models offers promise for highly reliable robot deployment. However, because of their scale, modern VLA models suffer from high inference latency, so the observation used to select an action is often stale by execution time, creating a distribution shift that can substantially degrade reliability and performance. Prior work has explored asynchronous policy execution to reduce the effect of latency, but these methods are mostly built on imitation learning and offer no mechanism for moving beyond the training distribution toward higher reliability. We close this gap by enabling RL fine-tuning that meets the real-time control requirements of dynamic real-world manipulation. Our approach builds on EXPO-FT, a framework for sample-efficient, reliable VLA fine-tuning with reinforcement learning, and decouples slow, expressive action generation from fast, reactive action edits: a large pretrained VLA proposes action chunks using its strong behavior prior, while a lightweight edit policy performs fast, reactive decision-making by editing actions in response to changes in state, conditioned on the latest observation. We instantiate this as Real-Time EXPO-FT, an RL framework for finetuning real-time VLA policies. On the Kinetix benchmark, Real-Time EXPO-FT enables a delayed policy to achieve the best performance among delayed and non-delayed methods in 10 out of 10 environments. On four dynamic real-world tasks, robot object passing, ball balancing, table soccer kicking, and dynamic object picking, with online robot data capped at 10 minutes, Real-Time EXPO-FT improves average policy performance from 42% to 97%, all without human intervention, demonstrating rapid, sample-efficient adaptation to challenging real-world dynamics. title: Understanding Dynamic Scenes at Gigapixel Scale: Wide-Area Spatio-Temporal Perception from UAVs
summary: UAV-borne imaging has advanced from megapixel to gigapixel sensors, shifting aerial perception from recognizing individual targets to understanding entire dynamic scenes. We characterize this demand as Wide-area Spatio-temporal Scene Understanding (WSTU), which requires wide-area coverage, per-target resolution, and temporal continuity at once, a combination existing datasets lack. To fill this gap, we introduce an ultra-High-resolution (12768x9564) Airborne Remote-sensing Dataset (HARD) annotated at three levels for object detection, multi-object tracking, and scene-level visual question answering. Ultra-high-resolution imagery raises per-frame processing time to seconds. At that scale latency can no longer be ignored in evaluation. Thus, we propose a latency-aware metric for multi-object tracking called streaming-HOTA (s-HOTA). Extensive baseline experiments show how ultra-high-resolution processing reshapes each task. For detection, the end-to-end pipeline affects accuracy and speed as much as the detector itself does. For tracking, high latency charges the association axis far more unevenly than the detection axis, and association is where pipelines diverge. As a result, the pipeline that performs best offline can lose its lead under s-HOTA. For VQA, vision-language models remain weak at cross-frame identity binding and cannot transfer their single-frame gains to it. Together these findings show that the baselines we evaluate fall short of WSTU. HARD provides the data and the systematic baselines to advance it.

title: A Lightweight CNN Integrated Compact Convolutional Transformer for Multi-Scale Feature Learning and reducing computational complexity for breast cancer mammography image detection and classification
summary: Over the years, Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) have demonstrated strong capability in cancer detection and classification using medical images. However, CNN-based models often struggle to capture long-range contextual dependencies. In such scenarios, integrating Compact Convolutional Transformer (CCT) architectures after the CCT layer allows CNN-extracted features to reshape into compact patch tokens using a CCT tokenizer, followed by the addition of positional embeddings to preserve spatial structure. Using 5-fold cross-validation, the model was tested on 3 sets of breast cancer mammography. With only 250,435 parameters, the model achieved 99%-100% accuracy across 3 datasets, indicating robust generalization. Explainable AI (XAI) was integrated into the model to explain the breast cancer classification process to enhance clinical trust. The results indicate that the proposed framework is suitable for computer-aided diagnosis systems, particularly in resource-constrained clinical environments. The novelty of the proposed CNN-integrated CCT overcomes the limitation of CNN's gradient degradation in the last layers by integrating convolutional tokenization with transformer-based learning. Lighter than ViT, which is effective in capturing long-range dependencies, the model has also proven efficient in breast cancer classification by capturing long-range dependencies among breast tissue regions.

title: CANTABILE: Learning Expressive Dynamics for Robotic Piano Performance
summary: Robotic piano playing has emerged as a standard benchmark for dexterous bimanual manipulation, yet progress on it has been measured almost entirely by note accuracy -- which keys are pressed (pitch) and when (onset) -- leaving the musical dynamics essential for expressive performance neither rewarded nor evaluated. We propose CANTABILE, a dynamics-aware framework for robotic piano performance that (i) closes the score-to-contact loop by conditioning the policy on upcoming velocity goals and mapping each key's angular velocity at onset back to MIDI velocity, (ii) couples a velocity-fidelity reward with an onset-coverage reward, so that dynamics cannot be improved by omitting difficult notes, and (iii) refines a frozen dynamics-aware base policy with an alpha-scaled, finger-only residual that localizes strike-intensity adaptation away from nominal note execution. On EXPRESSIVE-51, a dynamics-rich 51-song subset of RoboPianist, CANTABILE raises Velocity F1 -- jointly measuring pitch, onset, and intensity within a +/-8 MIDI-velocity tolerance -- from 0.06 to 0.34 over the RoboPianist baseline, improves all 51 songs, more than halves matched-note velocity error, and reduces log-mel distance to reference audio by 8%. Intensity-randomized training further enables runtime control of performance intensity without retraining.

title: CPR: Combining global composing, local performing and full-sequence refining in piano rendering with continuous autoregressive modelling
summary: Prompt-conditioned piano MIDI-to-Music rendering aims to faithfully render target notes while reproducing the timbre of a reference recording. Existing approaches primarily follow two paradigms: autoregressive (AR) modeling and flow matching (or diffusion). Discrete-codec AR models provide causal temporal modeling, but quantization can discard acoustic detail. Flow matching better preserves acoustic structure in the cost of full-sequence attention costs and worse semantic structure. Continuous autoregressive models operate directly on continuous representations. It not only combines the condition-following ability of AR models and distribution-modeling capacity of flow matching but also bypasses the quantization bottleneck with lower computational costs. Building on this principle, we present Composer--Performer--Refiner (CPR) framework. Composer autoregressively predicts continuous hidden states, Performer generates 24kHz acoustic latents through local flow matching and Refiner then upsamples the waveform to 48 kHz. We further introduce Bottlenecked Representation Alignment (BREPA) and Modality--Time RoPE (MT-RoPE) to strengthen musical semantic structure in Composer hidden states and temporal alignments across modalities. Codes are available at https://github.com/FEAfeatherTHER/CPR_official

title: Measuring and Exploiting Implicit Trust in LLM Tool-Calling Pipelines
summary: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) enables LLMs to invoke external tools, but every tool interaction exposes the model to attacker-controlled text through multiple input channels (tool descriptions, tool results, sampling messages) that share a single context window without privilege separation. In this paper, we present a framework to measure the trust profile of an arbitrary LLM based on a variety of payload framings sent through different channels. Following this assessment, we devise cross-channel fragmentation attacks that distribute seemingly benign payloads across two or three channels; no individual channel carries a complete injection, yet the LLM compiles the fragments into credential exfiltration. We evaluated our attacks across 12 frontier models, three production clients, and six payloads, totalling over 15,000 trials. Our evaluation reveals that cross-channel attacks are an unexplored attack surface: models that fully resist single-channel injection (0% compliance) exfiltrate sensitive data at up to 100% under two-channel fragmentation (e.g., GPT-4o, Llama 70B, Composer 2, Haiku 4.5). We further demonstrate value-aligned exploitation, where a tool's stated purpose requires the data the attacker targets, and a sampling system prompt override that injects persistent instructions via VS Code's MCP implementation. Finally, we evaluated our attacks against seven third-party MCP security tools and three prompt-based defenses. All tools failed to detect fragmented payloads, and prompt defenses proved model-specific rather than universal.

title: Context-Free Fixed Points and Complete Classification of Orbits in Picard Iteration for Guarded Power Language Operators
summary: We study the language-theoretic structure of fixed points and finite Picard iterates for guarded q-power language operators. For the general operator, we prove that a context-free seeded language deter- mines a unique context-free fixed point and give an effective construction of a context-free grammar generating this fixed point, independently of the initial language.We then consider a marked single-guard special case in which two new symbols separate the recursive contribution from the the contribution of the seed. In this setting, the initial language can be traced and recovered exactly from every finite Picard iterate by means of a regular slice and fixed-word quotients. This yields injectivity of the finite-time maps and an abstract finite-time class-preservation prin- ciple. As a consequence, we obtain a classification of the finite Picard iterates according to the exact position of the initial language in the Chomsky hierarchy. Thus the exact language-theoretic complexity may persist at every finite stage, while all Picard orbits converge to the same context-free fixed point.

title: APGEM: Adaptive Policy-Guided Error Mitigation for Quantum Reinforcement Learning on a Real-World CVRP Case Study
comments: Accepted at The 6th International Multi-Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (MCAIT2026)
summary: Quantum Reinforcement Learning (QRL) represents policies as variational quantum circuits (VQCs), making it attractive for combinatorial optimization such as the Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem (CVRP). On noisy intermediate-scale quantum (NISQ) hardware, however, decoherence degrades fidelity and destabilizes learning, and conventional error mitigation is applied statically without regard to the learning context. We introduce Adaptive Policy-Guided Error Mitigation (APGEM), a controller that selects among Zero-Noise Extrapolation (ZNE), Probabilistic Error Cancellation (PEC), Clifford Data Regression (CDR), and Readout Error Mitigation (REM) online, driven by a fidelity, entropy, and cost aware utility function and an epsilon-greedy rule over temporal-difference Q-scores. We evaluate on a realistic urban-logistics testbed, a Delhi-based CVRP over real landmarks with geodesic inter-node costs, exercised across five noise families and four severity levels. On this instance, the QRL agent outperforms constructive heuristics and approaches metaheuristics, while mitigation restores approximation ratios from 0.84-0.87 to 0.92-0.94 under high noise. The controller shifts from a CDR-dominated regime under short training horizons to a balanced deployment across all four techniques under longer horizons, indicating genuine regime-dependent selection. These preliminary results position adaptive, learning-aware mitigation as a practical route to noise-resilient QRL.

title: ABM-SIRTEM: A Hybrid Agent-Based and Epidemiological Model for Pandemic Response
summary: The COVID-19 pandemic has had profound impacts on global health, social structures, and economies. It disproportionately affected lower socioeconomic groups and those reliant on interaction-based jobs. Regulatory bodies faced the challenge of designing policies that preserve public health while limiting disruption to economic stability and productivity. Epidemiological models such as SIR and agent-based models (ABMs) have been used to study disease dynamics and the socioeconomic impacts of disease and interventions. Population-level models often simplify individual heterogeneity, while detailed ABMs can become computationally expensive as the numbers of agents and interactions increase. We propose ABM-SIRTEM, a hybrid model that incorporates occupation categories, economic productivity, and welfare at the individual level while dynamically modeling compliance with government interventions. We calibrate the model against historical positive and negative test counts from four U.S. states and examine the resulting compliance dynamics. This framework provides a basis for studying the interaction between disease spread and socioeconomic behavior in pandemic-response planning.

title: WISE: A Lightweight, Weakly-Supervised Model for Onboard Fire Smoke Detection and Localization
summary: Wildfire smoke detection from satellite imagery is critical for early warning and rapid response. For onboard satellite deployment, detection systems must operate under strict memory and latency constraints while providing spatially informative outputs for downstream decision-making. Existing tile-level classification methods are computationally efficient but lack spatial localization, whereas pixel-level segmentation approaches provide detailed masks yet are typically too computationally demanding for real-time onboard execution. To address this gap, we propose WISE (Weakly-supervised Inference-efficient Smoke Extraction), a deployment-oriented framework for onboard fire smoke detection and localization. WISE leverages only tile-level annotations through a teacher-student distillation strategy, where an offline teacher provides soft spatial supervision to a lightweight WISE-Student optimized for efficient onboard inference. The student jointly predicts tile-level smoke presence and smoke probability maps within a single forward pass, enabling spatially informative detection under strict computational constraints. WISE was evaluated through in-orbit execution aboard the ISS-mounted IMAGIN-e payload. Three model variants achieve average inference times of 0.10 s, 0.14 s, and 0.26 s per tile, indicating near-real-time per-tile inference within onboard resource limits. Ground-based experiments on Landsat 5 and Landsat 8 imagery further indicate effective detection and spatially informative localization. The best-performing variant achieves a mean tile-level F1 score of 0.964 and a mean pixel-level F1 score of 0.750 across 10 runs, while containing only 0.12M parameters and requiring approximately 3 GFLOPs. Together, these results indicate that WISE is a practical candidate for low-latency wildfire smoke monitoring from space under onboard resource constraints.

title: Anomaly Detection in General Ledger Data: Results from a Hybrid Approach
comments: Presented at the International Conference on Auditing and Artificial Intelligence 2024
summary: Journal Entry Tests (JETs) are a mandatory part of annual audits to evaluate and assess both highrisk audit areas and potential material misstatements. However, as JETs are designed to detect known patterns based on domain knowledge, the resulting lists are often very large and require substantial additional effort from the auditor. To ensure the economic efficiency of the audit, the number of false positives in JET result lists must be reduced. Especially machine learning (ML) methods represent a promising approach to improve anomaly detection in this field. In this research in progress paper, we investigate different approaches on how to combine JETs with ML-methods in a hybrid manner. We present specialized models to increase the detection performance and validity of anomaly detection results to improve audit efficiency. The experiments are based on synthetic data consisting of different normal and anomalous journal entries.

title: UMI-Bridge: Action-Anchored Latent Alignment across Human and Robot Manipulation Data
summary: Real-robot demonstrations are limited, motivating the use of human manipulation data collected without robots, including egocentric videos and handheld Universal Manipulation Interface (UMI) demonstrations. However, differences in viewpoint, embodiment, and available action supervision make it difficult to align representations across these sources according to manipulation motion rather than visual appearance. We introduce UMI-Bridge, which uses UMI as an intermediate domain to align representations according to action equivalence rather than pixel similarity. UMI action supervision anchors the latent representation to end-effector motion and gripper behavior, while synchronized head-wrist observations and paired ego-UMI clips support alignment across views and domains. We train a dual-view latent action model (LAM) on human manipulation data without robot demonstrations, then freeze its wrist teacher and dynamics model to regularize vision-language-action (VLA) post-training on UMI and robot data. The shared wrist interface enables this training-time supervision across both domains while preserving the policy's standard inference architecture. Across three real-robot tasks, UMI-Bridge achieves 91.7% mean success versus 73.3% for Naive Co-training with matched UMI and robot data. On two data-efficiency tasks, it surpasses a full-data Robot-only baseline using 25% of the robot demonstrations together with UMI data. It also achieves 85% and 90% success on two additional tasks learned from UMI demonstrations without task-specific robot demonstrations. These results support action-anchored latent alignment for data-efficient robot learning and UMI-to-robot task transfer.

title: SmartFlex: An Adaptive Lumbar Support System Based on Posture Recognition and Air Bag Array
comments: 4 pages, 5 figures, Accepted for publication in the Companion of the 2026 ACM International Joint Conference on Pervasive and Ubiquitous Computing (UbiComp Companion '26)
summary: Low back pain (LBP) is a leading cause of disability worldwide and affects populations ranging from working adults to students with prolonged sitting habits. Conventional lumbar support belts are generally static and non-adaptive, which limits their ability to accommodate dynamic postural changes and individualized comfort requirements. This paper presents SmartFlex, an intelligent wearable lumbar support system that integrates real-time posture recognition with an adaptive air bag array. The system uses a JY901S gyroscope sensor to detect user posture and a lightweight TinyML neural network deployed on an Arduino R4 UNO to process posture data at the edge. Based on the recognized posture state, a closed-loop pneumatic control system dynamically inflates or deflates 14 distributed air bags through four independent micro air pumps to provide targeted biomechanical support. Evaluation results show that SmartFlex achieves over 94% posture recognition accuracy and generates corresponding pressure-control commands with a sensing-to-command delay of less than 120 ms. The pneumatic system operates within a calibrated pressure range of 15-85 kPa. A user study with 20 participants produced a 4.5/5 rating for support effectiveness, suggesting that adaptive wearable support may improve daily sitting comfort and reduce lumbar fatigue.

title: A Factorization Method for Support Recovery in Magnetic Induction Tomography
summary: We develop a factorization framework for magnetic induction tomography in the eddy-current regime. The induced current density is represented by a divergence-free current vector potential, and the external excitation by magnetic dipole densities on an observation sphere. This choice reveals a natural physical factorization of the near-field operator into a data operator, an interior boundary response operator, and an adjoint counterpart. By introducing the Riesz map on the flux space, we recast this factorization in a Hilbert-space setting, which yields a positive-semidefinite operator with a coercive middle factor. Douglas' range theorem then identifies the range of the square root of this dissipative operator with the range of the data operator. For inclusions with a regular boundary, this range identity yields a uniqueness theorem for the support of the conductivity. This characterization leads to a non-iterative spectral indicator based on a regularized Picard quotient computed from the Hermitian imaginary part of the near-field data matrix. The reconstruction stage requires no forward solves. Numerical experiments confirm that the indicator localizes and separates the inclusions accurately, degrades gracefully under increasing noise, and captures non-convex support geometry without any convexity prior.

title: The 3/4 Conjecture for q-Ary Fix-Free Codes With at Most Three Distinct Codeword Lengths
summary: We prove the \(3/4\) conjecture for \(q\)-ary fix-free codes with at most three distinct codeword lengths, for every integer \(q\geq2\). Every prescribed length distribution with Kraft sum at most \(3/4\) is realized by a deterministic construction. We introduce a matrix approach based on an exact identity for the overlap between forbidden prefix extensions and suffix residuals. Natural numerical order fixes the shortest layer, and the remaining selection problem is expressed through row and column counts. A fixed-cardinality interpolation theorem supplies feasible sets of every intermediate cardinality between nested endpoints, provided their differences satisfy one-sided uniqueness and either acyclicity or integral slack. Reverse-order selection handles the uniform cases directly; in the remaining cases, layer completion and aligned groups provide endpoints for interpolation. Together, these methods extend the binary three-length result to arbitrary finite alphabets and give a deterministic procedure for constructing the code.
