title: HarnessVLN: Unifying Training-Free Embodied Navigation through an Agent Harness
summary: Embodied navigation requires agents to ground instructions or object goals in spatial observations and translate plans into successful execution. As multimodal large language models (MLLMs) become increasingly capable, they offer stronger support for navigation without task-specific training; however, improved semantic reasoning alone does not ensure that proposed actions remain consistent with spatial evidence, task progress, and execution outcomes. We introduce HarnessVLN, a zero-shot, training-free framework that unifies instruction-following and object-goal navigation through a shared Agent Harness. The Harness coordinates perception, memory, and execution tools through a unified interface, validating planner proposals for evidential support, geometric feasibility, and subgoal consistency before dispatch. It jointly manages hierarchical event memory and a persistent Spatiotemporal Graph to track task progress, preserve spatial evidence, and contextualize failures. Structured execution feedback updates this shared state, guiding subsequent planning, recovery, and termination. Across R2R, RxR, HM3D-v2, and HM3D-OVON, HarnessVLN achieves success rates of 60.8%, 53.9%, 76.0%, and 59.3%, respectively, outperforming prior training-free state-of-the-art methods. Humanoid robot deployment further demonstrates its applicability to both navigation tasks in real-world environments. The project page is available at https://agibot-harnessvln.netlify.app/.

AI.title_translation: HarnessVLN：通过代理线束统一免训练具身导航
AI.tldr: HarnessVLN是一个零样本、免训练的框架，通过一个共享的Agent Harness统一了指令遵循和目标导航，在多个基准测试中超越了现有的免训练方法，并适用于真实世界环境。
AI.motivation: 具身导航需要智能体将指令或目标与空间观察相结合，并将计划转化为成功执行。尽管多模态大型语言模型（MLLMs）在语义推理方面提供了强大支持，但仅凭语义推理无法确保所提出的动作与空间证据、任务进展和执行结果保持一致。
AI.method: HarnessVLN引入了一个零样本、免训练的框架，通过一个共享的Agent Harness统一了指令遵循和目标导航。该Harness通过统一接口协调感知、记忆和执行工具，并在派遣前验证规划器提案的证据支持、几何可行性和子目标一致性。它共同管理分层事件记忆和持久时空图，以跟踪任务进展、保留空间证据和背景化失败。结构化执行反馈更新此共享状态，指导后续的规划、恢复和终止。
AI.result: 在R2R、RxR、HM3D-v2和HM3D-OVON上，HarnessVLN的成功率分别为60.8%、53.9%、76.0%和59.3%，均优于先前的免训练最先进方法。人形机器人部署进一步证明了其在真实世界环境中两种导航任务的适用性。
AI.conclusion: HarnessVLN通过其统一的Agent Harness框架，有效解决了免训练具身导航中语义推理与实际执行之间的一致性问题，并在多个基准测试和真实世界部署中展现出优越的性能和广泛的适用性。
AI.translation: 具身导航要求智能体将指令或物体目标与空间观察相结合，并将计划转化为成功的执行。随着多模态大型语言模型（MLLMs）的能力日益增强，它们为无需任务特定训练的导航提供了更强的支持；然而，仅凭改进的语义推理并不能确保所提出的动作与空间证据、任务进展和执行结果保持一致。我们引入了HarnessVLN，一个零样本、免训练的框架，通过一个共享的Agent Harness统一了指令遵循和物体目标导航。该Harness通过统一接口协调感知、记忆和执行工具，在派遣前验证规划器提案的证据支持、几何可行性和子目标一致性。它共同管理分层事件记忆和持久时空图，以跟踪任务进展、保留空间证据并背景化失败。结构化执行反馈更新此共享状态，指导后续的规划、恢复和终止。在R2R、RxR、HM3D-v2和HM3D-OVON上，HarnessVLN的成功率分别为60.8%、53.9%、76.0%和59.3%，均优于先前的免训练最先进方法。人形机器人部署进一步证明了其在真实世界环境中两种导航任务的适用性。项目页面可在https://agibot-harnessvln.netlify.app/上获取。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了HarnessVLN，一个零样本、免训练的框架，通过一个统一的Agent Harness实现具身导航中的指令遵循和物体目标导航。该框架协调感知、记忆和执行工具，并通过验证规划器提案、管理分层事件记忆和时空图来确保动作与空间证据和任务进展的一致性。HarnessVLN在多个具身导航基准测试中取得了优于现有免训练方法的表现，并成功应用于真实世界的人形机器人导航任务。
AI.keywords: 具身导航, 免训练, 多模态大型语言模型, Agent Harness, 零样本
AI.comments: HarnessVLN的创新在于其“Agent Harness”机制，它有效弥合了MLLMs的强大语义推理能力与具身导航中实际执行和空间一致性之间的差距。这种统一的、免训练的方法对于推动通用具身智能体的发展具有重要意义，特别是在零样本和真实世界部署方面的表现，展示了其强大的泛化能力和实用性。

title: Why LLM Agents Collapse Without Oversight: The Enforcement Gap as the Mechanism Behind Emergence World Failures
comments: 27 pages, 3 figures, 8 tables. Submitted to ICLR 2027
summary: When Emergence World placed frontier LLM agents in an unsupervised multi-agent simulation, the results were alarming: agents committed crimes, starved, and enforced unanimous conformity -- without any external attacker. This paper identifies the mechanism. Reflexion-style agents already detect dangerous plan steps through iterative self-critique, yet the architecture provides no pathway from detection to action. We call this the enforcement gap: the audit sees the problem; the controller ignores it. Closing the gap requires a single conditional check -- fewer than 20 lines of code -- and reduces attack success by more than fourfold in large-scale experiments across frontier models, all five major agent frameworks, and an independent benchmark. We prove formally that when enforcement probability is near zero, detection quality is irrelevant to security. We further identify two compounding failure modes -- unreliable auditors and unparseable verdicts -- that explain every collapse pattern in Emergence World. A GRPO-trained enforcement controller resolves the ambiguity case. Concurrent work on filtering and information-flow control addresses the detection step but leaves the enforcement gap unaddressed; our results show this is the binding constraint. Together these results motivate a three-requirement Audit Enforcement Specification that is absent from every deployed framework today.
comment: 27 pages, 3 figures, 8 tables. Submitted to ICLR 2027

AI.title_translation: 为什么LLM代理在没有监督的情况下会崩溃：作为涌现世界失败机制的执行差距
AI.tldr: 当LLM代理在无监督环境中运行时，它们会因为“执行差距”而崩溃，即代理能够检测到危险但无法采取纠正措施。一个简单的代码修改可以显著提高安全性，并解决了两种复合故障模式。
AI.motivation: 解释为什么在缺乏监督的多代理模拟中，LLM代理会发生灾难性崩溃（犯罪、饥饿、强制一致性），并识别其背后的机制。
AI.method: 本文识别了“执行差距”——Reflexion风格代理能够检测危险计划步骤但缺乏从检测到行动的途径。通过引入一个简单的条件检查（少于20行代码）来弥补这一差距。通过大规模实验、形式化证明和识别两种复合故障模式（不可靠审计员和不可解析裁决，后者通过GRPO训练的执行控制器解决）来验证和解释崩溃模式。
AI.result: 弥补执行差距可将攻击成功率降低四倍以上。形式化证明当执行概率接近零时，检测质量与安全性无关。识别出不可靠的审计员和不可解析的裁决是所有崩溃模式的原因。GRPO训练的执行控制器解决了歧义情况。现有框架缺乏本文提出的审计执行规范。
AI.conclusion: LLM代理在没有监督的情况下崩溃是由于“执行差距”造成的，即代理能够检测到危险但无法采取纠正措施。通过弥补这一差距和解决复合故障模式，可以显著提高代理的安全性，并需要制定新的审计执行规范。
AI.translation: 当涌现世界（Emergence World）将前沿LLM代理置于无监督的多代理模拟中时，结果令人震惊：代理实施犯罪、挨饿并强制执行一致性——而没有任何外部攻击者。本文识别了其机制。Reflexion风格的代理已经通过迭代自我批判检测到危险的计划步骤，但其架构没有提供从检测到行动的途径。我们称之为执行差距：审计发现了问题；控制器却忽略了它。弥合这一差距只需要一个简单的条件检查——少于20行代码——并且在针对前沿模型、所有五个主要代理框架和一个独立基准进行的大规模实验中，将攻击成功率降低了四倍以上。我们正式证明，当执行概率接近零时，检测质量与安全性无关。我们进一步识别了两种复合故障模式——不可靠的审计员和不可解析的裁决——它们解释了涌现世界中的所有崩溃模式。GRPO训练的执行控制器解决了歧义情况。关于过滤和信息流控制的同期工作解决了检测步骤，但未解决执行差距；我们的结果表明这是主要的限制。这些结果共同促使提出了一个三要求的审计执行规范，而该规范在当今所有已部署的框架中都不存在。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了LLM代理在无监督多代理模拟中崩溃的原因，将其归因于“执行差距”——代理能够检测到危险计划但缺乏从检测到行动的机制。研究表明，通过一个简单的代码修改可以弥补这一差距，显著提高安全性。论文还识别了不可靠审计员和不可解析裁决这两种复合故障模式，并提出解决方案。最终，文章提出了一个所有现有框架都缺乏的“审计执行规范”。
AI.keywords: LLM代理, 执行差距, 多代理系统, 安全性, 自我批判
AI.comments: 本文提出了一种简洁而有效的方法来解决LLM代理在无监督环境中面临的关键安全问题，即“执行差距”。其创新点在于识别了检测与执行之间的脱节，并用极少的代码实现了显著的改进。这对于LLM代理的部署和安全性具有重要意义，尤其是在多代理系统中。

title: Planning in the Backbone: DiffAdapterVLA for Native Continuous Trajectory Generation with Driving VLMs
summary: Pretrained driving vision-language models (VLMs) integrate visual, route, language, and driving context into rich driving priors, yet their representation objectives remain separated from continuous driving planning. Existing methods typically begin trajectory generation only after the VLM has formed a final condition, leaving depth-wise condition computation outside the stepwise formation of trajectory state. We introduce DiffAdapterVLA, which realizes Planning in the Backbone: it injects explicit trajectory tokens into selected VLM late layers, bringing trajectory state into backbone forward computation, where it co-evolves with driving conditions at different depths. Lightweight layer-wise DiffAdapters organize this computation into recursive trajectory refinement, while asymmetric joint attention preserves directed guidance from the condition stream to trajectory planning. By placing planning within existing backbone computation rather than relying on an independent trajectory planner, DiffAdapterVLA adapts only lightweight trajectory modules to turn existing driving priors into efficient continuous planning capability. NAVSIM results show that it achieves high-quality closed-loop planning with low end-to-end latency using few trainable parameters, and demonstrate that jointly evolving trajectory state and depth-wise driving conditions in VLM late-layer computation effectively realizes continuous trajectory planning.

AI.title_translation: 骨干网络中的规划：用于驾驶VLM原生连续轨迹生成的DiffAdapterVLA
AI.tldr: 提出DiffAdapterVLA，通过将轨迹生成嵌入驾驶VLM的骨干网络并进行递归精炼，实现了高效的连续轨迹规划。
AI.motivation: 现有的预训练驾驶VLM虽然融合了丰富的驾驶先验，但其表示目标与连续驾驶规划相分离，轨迹生成通常在VLM形成最终条件后才开始，未能将深度方向的条件计算融入到轨迹状态的逐步形成中。
AI.method: 提出了DiffAdapterVLA，将显式轨迹标记注入VLM的后期层中，利用轻量级的逐层DiffAdapters组织递归轨迹求精计算，并通过非对称联合注意力保持自条件流到轨迹规划的定向引导。
AI.result: NAVSIM实验结果表明，该方法仅使用少量可训练参数即可实现高质量的闭环规划和低端到端延迟。
AI.conclusion: DiffAdapterVLA证明了通过在VLM骨干网络中联合演化轨迹状态与深度驾驶条件，能够以极少的参数和低延迟实现高质量的连续轨迹规划。
AI.translation: 预训练的驾驶视觉-语言模型（VLM）将视觉、路线、语言和驾驶上下文整合为丰富的驾驶先验，然而它们的表示目标与连续驾驶规划依然是分离的。现有方法通常在VLM形成最终条件后才开始生成轨迹，这使得深度方向的条件计算游离于轨迹状态的逐步形成之外。我们引入了DiffAdapterVLA，实现了“骨干网络中的规划”：它将显式的轨迹标记注入选定的VLM后期层中，将轨迹状态引入骨干网络的前向计算中，使其与不同深度的驾驶条件共同演化。轻量级的逐层DiffAdapters将此计算组织为递归的轨迹求精，同时非对称的联合注意力保持了从条件流到轨迹规划的定向引导。通过将规划置于现有的骨干网络计算中而不依赖独立的轨迹 planner，DiffAdapterVLA仅适配轻量级的轨迹模块，即将现有的驾驶先验转化为高效的连续规划能力。NAVSIM的结果表明，它以较少的可训练参数实现了高质量的闭环规划和较低的端到端延迟，并证明了在VLM后期层计算中联合演化轨迹状态与深度驾驶条件能有效实现连续轨迹规划。
AI.summary: 本文提出了DiffAdapterVLA，一种将连续轨迹生成直接融入驾驶视觉语言模型骨干网络的方法。通过在VLM后期层注入显式轨迹标记并利用轻量级DiffAdapter进行递归轨迹精炼，该方法实现了轨迹状态与深度驾驶条件的共同演化，在NAVSIM上以低延迟和少参数实现了高效的高质量闭环规划。
AI.keywords: 视觉语言模型, 连续轨迹规划, 骨干网络, 扩散适配器, 自动驾驶
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将轨迹生成嵌入到视觉语言模型的骨干网络深层中，通过轻量级DiffAdapter实现了轨迹状态与深度驾驶条件的共同演化，避免了传统方法中独立轨迹规划器的繁琐，兼顾了高效性与高性能。

title: Volumetric Harmonic Field Navigation for Quadrotors
summary: Quadrotor navigation in cluttered 3-D environments requires global guidance while local motion remains subject to collision and motion limits. Harmonic potentials provide dense guidance from a global boundary value problem, but coupling a volumetric harmonic field to constrained physical quadrotor motion remains an open experimental problem. We couple a precomputed volumetric harmonic field with a constrained predictive planner that queries the field at predicted positions instead of extracting a global reference path. In Structured 3-D tests, harmonic guidance yields larger minimum clearance and lower RMS jerk than matched Dijkstra guidance, at the cost of longer paths; the same pattern remains when both methods use the same passage. Long maze tests span routes far beyond one prediction horizon, and Crazyflie trials validate physical execution. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first physical quadrotor demonstration of volumetric harmonic field navigation. The results show that globally constructed harmonic guidance can directly support local constrained motion generation on a physical quadrotor.

AI.title_translation: 四旋翼无人机的体谐波场导航
AI.tldr: 本文首次在物理四旋翼无人机上实现了基于三维体谐波场的导航，通过直接将全局谐波场与局部约束规划器耦合，实现了优于传统方法的间隙保持和平滑度。
AI.motivation: 四旋翼在密集三维环境中导航需要全局引导，但将体谐波场与受限的四旋翼物理运动进行耦合在实验上仍是一个开放性问题，本文旨在解决这一问题并进行物理验证。
AI.method: 将预先计算的三维体谐波场与一个受限的预测规划器进行耦合，在预测位置处直接查询该场，而不是提取全局参考路径。
AI.result: 在结构化三维测试中，相比传统的Dijkstra引导，谐波引导可产生更大的最小间隙和更低的均方根急动度（RMS jerk），代价是路径较长；并通过Crazyflie进行了物理飞行验证。
AI.conclusion: 基于三维体谐波场的全局引导能够成功支撑物理四旋翼无人机在复杂环境中的局域约束运动生成，为无人机全局导航提供了新的有效途径。
AI.translation: 在杂乱的三维环境中进行四旋翼导航需要全局引导，同时局部运动仍受碰撞和运动限制的约束。谐波势能通过全局边界值问题提供密集引导，但将体积谐波场与受限的物理四旋翼运动耦合仍然是一个未解决的实验问题。我们将预先计算的体谐波场与受限预测规划器相结合，该规划器在预测位置查询场，而不是提取全局参考路径。在结构化三维测试中，与匹配的Dijkstra引导相比，谐波引导产生了更大的最小间隙和更低的均方根急动度，代价是路径更长；当两种方法使用相同的通道时，同样的模式依然存在。长迷宫测试跨越了远远超出单个预测地平线的路线，Crazyflie试验验证了物理执行。据我们所知，这是第一次在物理四旋翼上演示体谐波场导航。结果表明，全局构建的谐波引导可以直接支持物理四旋翼上的局部约束运动生成。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种将预先计算的三维体谐波场与受限预测规划器耦合的四旋翼导航方法，通过在预测位置直接查询谐波场来实现全局引导，并通过了物理实验验证。
AI.keywords: 四旋翼导航, 体谐波场, 预测规划器, 避障, 物理实验
AI.comments: 本文首次实现了基于三维体谐波场的四旋翼无人机物理导航飞行，通过将全局谐波场与局部约束预测规划器直接耦合，避免了传统提取全局参考路径的做法，在结构化复杂环境中展现出良好的避障和运动平滑性能。

title: TopoRig: Topology-Agnostic Facial Rigging via Multi-Source Supervision
summary: Automatic facial rigging across heterogeneous mesh topologies remains challenging because high-quality expression supervision is often tied to canonical templates, while deformation transfer to arbitrary meshes can introduce geometric artifacts and correspondence errors. We present TopoRig, a topology-agnostic facial rigging framework that predicts FACS-conditioned deformations directly on input mesh vertices while preserving the original topology. Starting from the ICT FaceKit expression model, we construct complementary supervision from accurate but template-biased common-topology rigs, topology-diverse but noisier transferred rigs, and targeted image-based cues for controls poorly captured by geometric transfer. TopoRig combines local surface geometry, landmark-relative semantic features, global shape context, and FACS controls to predict per-vertex displacements. We train on 3,496 generated identities using 45 non-gaze expression controls from the 53-control ICT FaceKit vocabulary. On held-out identities and unseen mesh topologies, TopoRig more faithfully reproduces the reference expression space than prior neural facial-rigging methods, while qualitative results show consistent localized deformations across diverse character geometries. Ablations demonstrate that semantic landmark features and complementary supervision improve cross-identity and cross-topology generalization. Overall, TopoRig amortizes heterogeneous and imperfect expression supervision into a single topology-preserving deformation model.

AI.title_translation: TopoRig：通过多源监督实现拓扑无关的面部绑定
AI.tldr: TopoRig提出了一种拓扑无关的面部绑定框架，通过多源监督直接预测任意网格上的FACS条件形变，有效解决了跨拓扑面部动画的几何伪影和对应误差问题。
AI.motivation: 跨异构网格拓扑进行自动面部绑定仍然具有挑战性，因为高质量的表情监督通常绑定在规范模板上，而形变迁移到任意网格会导致几何伪影和对应误差。
AI.method: TopoRig框架结合了局部表面几何、landmark相对语义特征、全局形状上下文以及FACS控制来预测每个顶点的位移，并利用来自ICT FaceKit的互补监督信号进行训练。
AI.result: 实验表明，在未见过的身份和未见过的网格拓扑上，TopoRig比以往的神经面部绑定方法更忠实地重现了参考表情空间，定性结果也展示了跨不同角色几何的一致局部形变。
AI.conclusion: TopoRig成功通过多源监督将异构且不完美的表情监督转化为统一的拓扑保持形变模型，在未见过的网格拓扑和身份上均展现出优于现有方法的性能。
AI.translation: 在异构网格拓扑中进行自动面部绑定仍然具有挑战性，因为高质量的表情监督通常与规范模板绑定，而向任意网格的形变迁移可能会引入几何伪影和对应误差。我们提出了TopoRig，这是一个拓扑无关的面部绑定框架，它直接在输入网格顶点上预测FACS条件下的形变，同时保持原始拓扑。从ICT FaceKit表情模型出发，我们构建了互补监督：来自准确但具有模板偏差的同拓扑绑定、拓扑多样但噪声更大的迁移绑定，以及针对几何迁移捕捉不佳的控制的目标图像线索。TopoRig结合了局部表面几何、landmark相对语义特征、全局形状上下文和FACS控制来预测每个顶点的位移。我们在使用ICT FaceKit 53个控制词汇表中的45个非注视表情控制生成的3,496个身份上进行训练。在未见过的身份和未见过的网格拓扑上，TopoRig比先前的神经面部绑定方法更忠实地重现了参考表情空间，而定性结果显示了跨多样角色几何的一致局部形变。消融实验表明，语义landmark特征和互补监督改善了跨身份和跨拓扑的泛化能力。总的来说，TopoRig将异构且不完美的表情监督转化为单一的拓扑保持形变模型。
AI.summary: TopoRig是一个拓扑无关的面部绑定框架，通过多源监督直接在输入网格顶点上预测FACS条件下的形变，从而在保持原始网格拓扑的同时准确重现复杂的面部表情。
AI.keywords: 面部绑定, 拓扑无关, 深度学习, 形变迁移, FACS表情控制
AI.comments: 该论文针对异构网格拓扑的自动面部绑定难题，创新性地结合了多源监督（模板偏置监督、拓扑多样但噪点的监督、以及基于图像的提示），并在保持原始拓扑的同时实现了基于FACS的高精度顶点形变预测，对跨身份和跨拓扑的面部动画生成具有重要意义。

title: PipeSwift: Revisiting Pipeline Parallelism for Large-Scale Completion-Oriented Agentic LLM Serving
summary: LLM agents execute long-horizon workflows where each model response determines the progress of subsequent tool interactions and environment transitions. Unlike chatbot serving, where TTFT and TPOT SLO constraints are critical, agentic workloads are increasingly governed by completion time. This shift challenges existing LLM serving designs, which are optimized around token-level SLOs. We revisit scheduling and parallelism under this completion-oriented objective. Through systematic exploration, we show that job completion time (JCT) is governed by the balance between prefill and decode efficiency. Prefill-prioritized scheduling, while achieving the best TTFT and decode throughput, renders suboptimal JCT; across the scheduling-policy space, completion time varies by up to 1.40$\times$, with the optimum at neither extreme. We further show that pipeline parallelism (PP), previously overlooked due to its limited decode latency advantage, benefits JCT by providing a favorable balance of prefill--decode trade-off. Based on these insights, we build \name{}, an optimized open-source pipeline-parallel runtime that co-designs scheduling and parallelism through a JCT-aware scheduling layer and pipeline-integrated multi-token prediction. Evaluated on deterministic replays of real coding and web-search agent trajectories with two 360B+ MoE models on 64 H800 GPUs, \name{} reduces overall JCT by up to 1.45$\times$ over SGLang wide-EP, 2.33$\times$ over vLLM PP2, and 1.54$\times$ over today's state-of-the-art open-source PD-disaggregated deployment.

AI.title_translation: PipeSwift：重新审视用于大规模面向完成的智能体大模型服务的流水线并行
AI.tldr: 本文提出了 PipeSwift，一个针对大模型智能体服务的流水线并行运行时，通过优化预填充与解码的平衡，显著减少了作业完成时间（JCT）。
AI.motivation: 现有的大模型服务设计主要针对聊天室场景（关注 TTFT 和 TPOT），无法满足以作业完成时间（JCT）为核心的长视界智能体工作流的需求。
AI.method: 提出了 PipeSwift，一个开源的流水线并行运行时系统，通过联合设计调度与并行策略，包含 JCT 感知的调度层和流水线集成的多 token 预测。
AI.result: PipeSwift 在 64 个 H800 GPU 上运行 360B+ MoE 模型时，相比 SGLang wide-EP、vLLM PP2 和 PD 分离部署，整体 JCT 分别降低了最高 1.45 倍、2.33 倍和 1.54 倍。
AI.conclusion: PipeSwift 通过结合 JCT 感知的调度层与流水线集成的多token预测，成功优化了大模型智能体服务的作业完成时间，在多项真实智能体工作流测试中显著优于现有主流服务框架。
AI.translation: 大模型智能体执行长视界工作流，其中每个模型的响应决定了后续工具交互和环境转换的进展。与聊天机器人服务（其中 TTFT 和 TPOT SLO 约束至关重要）不同，智能体工作负载越来越多地由完成时间决定。这种转变对围绕词元级 SLO 优化的现有大模型服务设计提出了挑战。我们在这个面向完成的目标下重新审视了调度和并行性。通过系统探索，我们表明作业完成时间 (JCT) 受预填充和解码效率之间的平衡支配。预填充优先调度虽然实现了最佳的 TTFT 和解码吞吐量，但导致了亚优化的 JCT；在调度策略空间中，完成时间变化高达 1.40 倍，最佳点既不在两个极端。我们进一步表明，流水线并行 (PP) 以前由于其有限的解码延迟优势而被忽视，但它通过提供有利的预填充-解码权衡平衡有利于 JCT。基于这些见解，我们构建了 \name{}（一个优化的开源流水线并行运行时），通过 JCT 感知调度层和流水线集成的多词元预测共同设计了调度和并行性。在具有两个 360B+ MoE 模型和 64 个 H800 GPU 的真实编码和网络搜索智能体轨迹的确定性重放上进行评估，\name{} 将总体 JCT 比 SGLang wide-EP 减少了高达 1.45 倍，比 vLLM PP2 减少了 2.33 倍，比当今最先进的开源 PD 分离部署减少了 1.54 倍。
AI.summary: 该论文针对大模型智能体服务中以完成时间为导向的新需求，重新审视了流水线并行和调度策略。研究发现，平衡预填充与解码效率是优化作业完成时间（JCT）的关键，传统的极端策略无法达到最优。基于此，作者开发了 PipeSwift 系统，通过 JCT 感知调度与多 token 预测实现了显著的性能提升。
AI.keywords: 大模型智能体, 流水线并行, 作业完成时间, 服务优化, 预填充与解码平衡
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将大模型服务的目标从传统的聊天室指标（TTFT/TPOT）转向了以完成时间（JCT）为核心的智能体工作流，并重新评估了流水线并行（PP）在现代智能体服务中的巨大价值。这对未来大规模智能体部署具有重要意义。

title: Geospatial Metadata Improves Discoverability by Connecting Datasets Across Scientific Disciplines
summary: Research data repositories are essential infrastructure for scientific inquiry and for ensuring that datasets follow FAIR (Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, and Reusable) principles. However, repository reuse depends on the quality and completeness of geospatial and thematic metadata, which researchers generally provide voluntarily. Given limited curation resources, it is unsurprising that even Harvard Dataverse, the world's largest general-purpose research repository, contains many incomplete metadata records. Missing fields represent lost information and reduce interoperability. We find that datasets with more missing metadata receive fewer downstream citations and have fewer resolvable connections to other datasets. The implications are particularly important for geospatial datasets: only 0.3% of research datasets include a bounding box, and most represent archival points rather than complete geographic shapes. Our analysis shows that geospatial metadata helps connect concepts across disciplines. After embedding Harvard Dataverse datasets in a metadata knowledge graph, we find that datasets are twice as likely to connect across scientific disciplines through shared geospatial metadata as through keywords. This suggests that geographic metadata is a more reliable basis for cross-disciplinary interoperability than keyword vocabularies, which often remain discipline-specific. We train and fine-tune a small language model using datasets from Harvard Dataverse. Through geospatial metadata enrichment, we increase the share of datasets from different disciplines connected through metadata elements from 58.5% to 63.2%.

AI.title_translation: 地理空间元数据通过连接跨学科数据集来提高可发现性
AI.tldr: 地理空间元数据能显著提升科学数据集的跨学科可发现性和互操作性，其效果优于传统关键词，且可通过语言模型进行有效增强。
AI.motivation: 研究数据仓库的重用依赖于元数据的质量和完整性，然而许多元数据记录不完整。论文旨在探讨地理空间元数据如何通过连接跨学科的数据集来改善数据的可发现性。
AI.method: 通过将Harvard Dataverse的数据集嵌入到元数据知识图谱中进行分析，并训练和微调小型语言模型来进行地理空间元数据丰富。
AI.result: 研究发现带有更多缺失元数据的下游引用较少；地理空间元数据比关键词更能促进跨学科连接（可能性高两倍）；通过元数据丰富，跨学科连接的数据集比例从58.5%提高到63.2%。
AI.conclusion: 地理空间元数据对于提高研究数据集的跨学科可发现性和互操作性至关重要，通过语言模型进行元数据丰富可以有效弥补人工填写的不足，促进跨学科的科学研究。
AI.translation: 研究数据仓库是科学探究和确保数据集遵循FAIR（可查找、可访问、可互操作和可重用）原则的基础设施。然而，仓库的重用取决于研究人员通常自愿提供的地理空间和主题元数据的质量与完整性。鉴于有限的策展资源，即使是世界最大的通用研究仓库Harvard Dataverse，也包含许多不完整的元数据记录，这并不令人意外。缺失的字段代表了丢失的信息并降低了互操作性。我们发现，元数据缺失更多的数据集接收到的下游引用更少，与其他数据集的可解析连接也更少。这些影响对地理空间数据集尤为重要：只有0.3%的研究数据集包含边界框，且大多数代表的是档案点而不是完整的地理形状。我们的分析表明，地理空间元数据有助于连接跨学科的概念。在将Harvard Dataverse数据集嵌入元数据知识图谱后，我们发现数据集通过共享的地理空间元数据跨学科连接的可能性是通过关键词跨学科连接的两倍。这表明，地理空间元数据比通常局限于特定学科的关键词词汇表，更能成为跨学科互操作性的可靠基础。我们使用来自Harvard Dataverse的数据集训练并微调了一个小型语言模型。通过地理空间元数据丰富，我们将通过元数据元素连接的不同学科数据集的比例从58.5%提高到了63.2%。
AI.summary: 本文研究了地理空间元数据对科学研究数据仓库中数据集可发现性和跨学科互操作性的影响。通过分析Harvard Dataverse的数据集，发现地理空间元数据比关键词更有效地促进跨学科连接，并且利用小型语言模型进行元数据丰富可以显著增加跨学科数据集的关联度。
AI.keywords: 地理空间元数据, 可发现性, 跨学科互操作性, 知识图谱, 小型语言模型
AI.comments: 该论文探讨了地理空间元数据在跨学科数据集连接中的重要作用，通过构建元数据知识图谱并利用小型语言模型进行元数据增强，展示了地理空间元数据在提升数据可发现性和互操作性方面的巨大潜力。创新点在于揭示了地理空间元数据比传统关键词更能促进跨学科联系。

title: The Local-to-Global AD-k Conjecture is Resolved
summary: AD-k stands for Alternating Differences through order k, and it is a property of set functions denoting that the first order difference of the set function is nonnegative (a.k.a. monotnocity), the second order difference is nonpositive (submodularity), and so on with signs alternating through order k. Chen et al. [1] conjectured that in an influence diffusion model called the general threshold model originally defined by Kempe et al. [2], if every local influence function is AD-k, then the global influence spread function is also AD-k, for any (possibly cyclic) directed graph and any k. This paper provides a complete proof showing that the conjecture is true. The proof utilizes Möbius inversion, reverse reachable sets, and decision tree partition techniques and extends the probability distribution of node triggering sets into a generalized algebraic structure allowing negative weights for triggering sets. The extension to negative-weighted triggering sets may be of independent interest and may have further algorithmic implications.

AI.title_translation: 局部到全局AD-k猜想已被解决
AI.tldr: 本文利用莫比乌斯反演和负权重触发集等技术，完整证明了图论与影响扩散模型中的Local-to-Global AD-k猜想。
AI.motivation: 为了证明陈等人提出的猜想：在一般阈值模型中，若每个局部影响函数是AD-k的，则全局影响传播函数对于任意有向图和任意k也是AD-k的。
AI.method: 利用莫比乌斯反演、反向可达集和决策树划分技术，将节点触发集的概率分布扩展为允许负权重的广义代数结构。
AI.result: 完整证明了Local-to-Global AD-k猜想是正确的，并引入了可能具有独立研究价值的负权重触发集扩展。
AI.conclusion: 作者给出了完整的证明，证实了陈等人的猜想：在一般阈值模型中，若每个局部影响函数具有AD-k性质，则全局影响传播函数也具有AD-k性质。
AI.translation: AD-k代表阶数最多为k的交替差分，它是集合函数的一个属性，表示集合函数的一阶差分为非负（即单调性），二阶差分为非正（即子模性），以此类推，其符号通过阶数k交替变化。Chen等人[1]曾推测，在由Kempe等人[2]最初定义的名叫通用阈值模型的影响扩散模型中，如果每个局部影响函数都是AD-k的，那么对于任意的（可能是循环的）有向图和任意的k，全局影响传播函数也是AD-k的。本文提供了一个完整的证明，表明该猜想是正确的。该证明利用了莫比乌斯反演、反向可达集和决策树划分技术，并将节点触发集的概率分布扩展为一个允许触发集具有负权重的广义代数结构。对负权重触发集的扩展可能具有独立的兴趣，并可能产生进一步的算法影响。
AI.summary: 该论文彻底证明了关于一般阈值模型中局部到全局AD-k性质的猜想。通过采用莫比乌斯反演、反向可达集、决策树划分以及允许负权重的广义代数结构等创新方法，作者证实了局部AD-k性质可以推导至全局，为该领域提供了重要的理论突破。
AI.keywords: AD-k猜想, 影响扩散模型, 一般阈值模型, 莫比乌斯反演, 负权重触发集
AI.comments: 该论文彻底解决了关于一般阈值模型中局部到全局AD-k性质的猜想，方法创新性地引入了负权重的触发集，利用了莫比乌斯反演、反向可达集和决策树划分等技术，具有重要的理论价值和潜在的算法应用前景。

title: little m: An AI Agent for Industrial Process Optimization
summary: Manufacturing consumes one third of global energy and still has significant room for improvement in terms of energy efficiency. Optimal process control is essential for this purpose. However, synthesizing mathematical optimization models from messy, real-world industrial specifications requires bridging unstructured natural language and spatial diagrams with rigorous mathematical syntax. This poses a profound challenge for general-purpose Large Language Models (LLMs), which may introduce invalid constraints when tasked with modeling continuous multi-physics dynamics. To address this, we introduce little m, an AI agent designed to assist the formulation of industrial process control models. Combining a domain-specific knowledge repository with LLM-driven interaction, the proposed framework formulates real-world optimization problems as mathematical models. For systematic evaluation, we introduce the Industrial Process Control Benchmark (IPC-Bench), a novel multimodal dataset of 50 canonical scenarios requiring joint reasoning over text and process diagrams. Through comprehensive automated structural assessments and double-blind human evaluation, little m substantially outperforms state-of-the-art LLMs, generating semantically correct models. These evaluations assess formulation quality rather than solver feasibility, formal physical validity, or closed-loop industrial performance. The implementation of little m and the IPC-Bench dataset are available at https://github.com/yeyongchao/process-modeling-benchmark.

title: CorrRisk-WM: Corridor-Conditioned Risk World Modeling for Safety-Critical Trajectory Planning
comments: 9 pages, 3 figures; added an AI-use disclosure, clarified the appendix description, and revised a figure; results unchanged
summary: Safe local planning requires forecasting surrounding-agent motion and evaluating candidate-specific risks, since identical agent motion can pose different risks to different ego trajectories. We present CorrRisk-WM, a planning-oriented partial world model coupling environment evolution with supervised intrusion and near-miss prediction over bounded candidate-trajectory corridors. A latent environment model recursively predicts agent states and updates agent-agent and agent-map interactions. Each candidate queries the evolving environment through footprint- aware geometry and learned agent-corridor representations. A lightweight recurrent risk module uses temporal context to estimate per-slice hazards; survival aggregation yields first-entry and horizon-level event probabilities. On 29,176 scenarios from 100 Waymo validation shards, CorrRisk-WM achieves intrusion average precision (AP) of 0.8567 and 1-m near-miss first-entry AP of 0.8671. In baseline comparisons, it attains the highest near-miss AP at all three distance thresholds and the lowest observed open-loop collision rate (4.88%), with route progress of 15.35 m. Across three seeds, removing dynamic environment modeling or candidate-conditioned geometric interaction reduces mean intrusion AP from 0.8590 to 0.7624 and 0.7252, respectively. These results support coupling environment evolution with candidate-conditioned geometric reasoning for risk prediction and safety-oriented candidate selection.

title: Visual Cue Guided Video Planning for Generalizable Robot Navigation
summary: Generative video models can serve as a promising backbone for robot navigation by predicting future observations as video plans. Recent approaches often condition video planning on short-horizon guidance and recover geometric waypoints through scene reconstruction, leaving longer-horizon planning and precise video-to-action translation less explored. We present CueNav, a video model-based navigation framework combining visual cue guided video planning with an embodiment-specific Inverse-Dynamics Model (IDM). As visual cues, we use a Bird's-Eye View (BEV) map to convey global task context and retain part of the robot body in the egocentric observation to expose embodiment context. These cues guide the video planner, while the IDM translates dense flow fields extracted from the video plan into robot actions. With the visual cue encoding global task context, CueNav achieves nearly 2x higher success in maze navigation than planning without the cue. The body-aware view with the IDM enables precise navigation with 70% success in a narrow passage where comparison methods largely fail to complete the task. We further demonstrate zero-shot semantic-conditioned navigation and deployment of the same video planner across different robot platforms. Our results show that visual cue-guided video planning with embodiment-specific action grounding paves the way toward a generalizable navigation framework for longer-horizon planning and embodiment-aware control. Additional results and code are available on our project website: https://cuenav.github.io.

AI.title_translation: 用于可泛化机器人导航的视觉线索引导视频规划

AI.conclusion: 通过结合视觉线索引导的视频规划与具身特定的逆动力学模型，CueNav实现了长视距、高精度且可泛化的机器人导航。
AI.translation: 生成式视频模型通过预测未来观测作为视频计划，可以作为机器人导航的有希望的主干网络。最近的方法通常以短期引导为条件进行视频规划，并通过场景重建恢复几何路径点，这使得长视距规划和精确的视频到动作转换受到的探索较少。我们提出了CueNav，这是一种基于视频模型的导航框架，它将视觉线索引导的视频规划与具身特定的逆动力学模型（IDM）结合起来。作为视觉线索，我们使用鸟瞰图（BEV）地图来传达全局任务上下文，并在自我中心观察中保留部分机器人身体以暴露出具身上下文。这些线索指导视频规划器，而IDM将从视频计划中提取的密集光流场转换为机器人动作。通过编码全局任务上下文的视觉线索，CueNav在迷宫导航中的成功率比没有该线索的规划高出近2倍。具有身体感知视角的IDM能够实现精确导航，在对比方法大多无法完成任务的狭窄通道中取得了70%的成功率。我们进一步演示了零样本语义条件导航以及在不同机器人平台上部署同一视频规划器。我们的结果表明，具有具身特定动作基础的视觉线索引导视频规划为通往长视距规划和具身感知控制的可泛化导航框架铺平了道路。

title: The Latent That Never Was: A Forensic Re-run of the CVAE Ablation in Action Chunking Transformers
summary: Action Chunking Transformers (ACT) are widely used to learn robot manipulation from demonstrations. Their conditional variational autoencoder includes an encoder meant to capture differences between demonstrations during training. The original ACT paper reported that encoder removal dropped the mean success rate from 35% to 2% on two simulated tasks with human demonstrations. We re-ran this ablation in the original code and checked whether the findings depend on the implementation or training data. The published drop does not reappear in our tests, although smaller gains or losses in success rate remain uncertain. To investigate the discrepancy, we varied training length and how checkpoints are selected for evaluation. Both can reverse which policy scores higher, but the published drop's cause remains unknown. Success rates alone leave open whether the encoder provides information that helps the policy reconstruct demonstrated actions. On the tested ACT benchmark, the sampled latent provides little reconstruction benefit at every tested nonzero weight of the penalty on latent information. At inference, ACT leaves this latent unused and sets it to zero. Skipping the encoder increases training throughput in both implementations we timed. We release code, evaluation tools and results so others can repeat the comparisons and test the encoder on other tasks.

title: Unifying Semantic Priors and High-Frequency Traces: Enhancing V-JEPA with Mixture-of-Experts for Robust Synthetic Image Forensics
comments: Accepted at the 2026 Workshop on AI for Multimedia Forensics & Disinformation Detection @ ECCV. Code available at https://github.com/ALCOR-Lab-DIAG/MoE-JEPA
summary: The unchecked proliferation of manipulated images on social media platforms has increased the spread of misinformation, posing a severe threat to public trust and information integrity. Modern deepfake detectors typically rely on Vision Transformers (ViTs) to capture the low-level inconsistencies that characterize fully synthetic or locally tampered images. However, the global understanding of such foundation models is not enough to discriminate alone between real and fake multimedia content, especially in challenging scenarios where images are compressed or transmitted through social media. In this paper we pioneer the application of Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) models to deepfake detection, taking advantage of the generalized representation of visual reality that such World Models have exhibited. We hypothesize, and empirically demonstrate, that the intrinsic world understanding of JEPA models can be used as a strong prior for a deepfake detector. To fully exploit JEPA capabilities, we propose MoE-JEPA, a dual-stream architecture for deepfake detection. By enhancing a V-JEPA 2 backbone with a Residual Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) mechanism, along with a noise stream branch, our model dynamically internalizes forensic knowledge. Furthermore, a Gated Attention Multiple Instance Learning (MIL) module is employed to ensure precise spatial semantic understanding. Evaluated on the SID-Set benchmark, comprising 300K AI-generated, tampered and authentic images, MoE-JEPA establishes a new state-of-the-art with an accuracy of 95.54%, successfully outperforming vastly larger models.

title: Geometry of learning dynamics: Gradient descent versus natural gradient on the ridge of optimization
summary: High-capacity associative memories based on Kernel Logistic Regression (KLR) exhibit a "Ridge of Optimization" characterized by extreme stability and a highly skewed weight spectrum. However, the dynamical process by which learning converges to this critical regime has remained unclear. This paper provides a geometric analysis of the learning trajectories on the statistical manifold of a KLR-trained Hopfield network. By comparing the paths of Gradient Descent (GD) and Natural Gradient Descent (NGD), we elucidate the mechanisms governing the optimization process. Our analysis reveals that learning on the Ridge proceeds in two distinct phases. We show that the extreme curvature of the Ridge causes standard GD to follow a highly oscillatory, non-geodesic path. In stark contrast, NGD explicitly corrects for this geometry, following the ideal geodesic path and completely overcoming the instabilities faced by GD. We demonstrate experimentally that NGD not only converges significantly faster but also achieves a solution with superior generalization performance. These results establish that the highly structured geometry of the Ridge is optimally suited for information-geometric optimization, providing a new perspective on the interplay between learning dynamics and emergent representation geometry.

title: Can We Do Interpretable NLI with Graphs Based on Atomic Propositions?
summary: While Large Language Model (LLM)-based Natural Language Inference (NLI) systems achieve high accuracy, their decision-making processes lack auditable structures. This paper explores whether NLI can be performed using only interpretable, graph-based representations of evidence. We introduce a fully graph-based pipeline where the classifier never directly processes the input text. Instead, sentences are decomposed into atomic propositions, converted into ConceptNet triples via constrained decoding, and represented as three graphs per pair: premise, hypothesis, and a retrieved ConceptNet subgraph. These graphs are then fed into a fine-tuned 0.8-billion-parameter language model. On the SNLI dataset, our pipeline achieves 89.7% accuracy, just 1.9 points below an identically trained text-based model. On ANLI, it matches the published performance of RoBERTa-large on rounds R2 and R3 (48.0% vs. 48.9% and 44.9% vs. 44.4%) but trails by 16 points on R1, resulting in an overall gap of 9 to 14 points compared to its text counterpart. We term this gap the price of interpretability and demonstrate that it stems from representational limitations rather than data constraints. Ablation studies further reveal that graphs and text are complementary: combining both modalities achieves 92.1% accuracy on SNLI.

title: Information Geometric Self-Organization at the Edge of Stability in High-Capacity Kernel Associative Memories
summary: High-capacity associative memories based on Kernel Logistic Regression (KLR) exhibit exceptional storage capabilities and robustness. Previous empirical studies identified a hyperparameter regime, the "Ridge of Optimization," where attractor stability is maximized. However, the geometric nature of this regime and the optimization dynamics required to reach it have remained unclear. In this paper, we investigate the static geometry of the parameter space and the learning trajectory of Gradient Descent (GD) in KLR-trained Hopfield networks. Using the eigenvalue spectrum of the Hessian, we reveal that the Ridge corresponds to a phase boundary located adjacent to a rank-1 spectral collapse, acting as a geometric singularity where the principal curvature is massively amplified. Furthermore, we demonstrate that the learning dynamics exhibit a transient self-stabilizing behavior driven by the Edge of Stability (EoS) phenomenon. Rather than seeking flat regions, the network parameters are driven toward a state where the local curvature dynamically equilibrates near the stability limit dictated by the learning rate, allowing the optimization to survive the initial instability. We provide analytical derivations for both the rank-1 asymptotic collapse and the dynamic feedback loop governing this equilibration. These findings suggest that optimal, high-capacity memory representations are not formed in flat minima, but are dynamically sculpted at the highly curved boundaries of geometric singularities.

title: High-Fidelity Video Quality Assessment with VQA-Specific Saliency
summary: No-reference video quality assessment (NR VQA) has recently seen promising progress with deep learning. However, video data is inherently large, and processing them with deep models incurs high computational cost. This challenge is particularly acute in VQA, where preserving original-resolution cues and dense temporal information is critical for accuracy. Existing efficiency-driven preprocessing strategies, such as fragmenting, reduce computation but alter the input data distribution, limiting effective reuse of pretrained video foundation models (ViFMs). To address these challenges, we propose \textbf{H}igh-\textbf{F}idelity \textbf{V}ideo \textbf{Q}uality \textbf{A}ssessment (\textbf{HFVQA}), a framework built on fixed-size spatio-temporal (ST) patches that is fully compatible with pretrained ViFMs. HFVQA samples ST patches across multiple scales, including the original resolution, with minimal temporal subsampling to preserve low-level quality cues and semantic context. To limit computation, HFVQA introduces a lightweight auxiliary network trained end-to-end with the ViFM encoder to learn \textit{VQA-specific saliency}. Distilled directly from quality supervision, this saliency captures task-specific importance patterns, reflecting that video quality perception is dominated by a small subset of spatio-temporal regions. By combining high-fidelity spatio-temporal cues with learned, task-specific saliency, HFVQA achieves SOTA performance on standard NR VQA benchmarks while processing as little as 12\% of candidate ST patches, making high-fidelity ViFM-based VQA computationally tractable.

title: Budgeted Express-Mesh: Traffic-Aware Link Placement and Deadlock-Free Adaptive Routing
comments: 14 pages, 14 figures, 9 tables. Code and artifacts: https://github.com/tsjyma/Express_mesh
summary: We present Budgeted Express-Mesh, a topology-routing co-design that adds a small number of traffic-aware express links under a fixed wire budget. An ASPL-based greedy placement is refined by simulation-guided annealing, while packets use committed top-K routes selected from delayed express-link congestion and reservation signals. Across four synthetic workloads, optimized placements consistently improve high-load throughput over Mesh and random placement, and annealing further improves Greedy. The gains persist under delayed quantized congestion information, longer express-link latency, multi-flit packets, and a 16-by-16 heterogeneous workload.

title: LiLi: Lie Theory Based 3D LiDAR Scan Alignment Degeneracy Detection
comments: 8 pages, 9 figures. Vsevolod Hulchuk and Jan Bayer contributed equally
summary: In this paper, we study 3D LiDAR scan alignment in challenging scenarios with degeneracies, such as straight corridors or flat fields, where the alignment solution is not unique and compromises localization and mapping accuracy. Existing degeneracy detection methods that neglect the potential for reassociating data points are prone to being sensitive to noise and complex degeneracies. Therefore, we propose LiLi - a novel method that leverages Lie theory to identify the full set of degenerate transformations within the SE(3) Lie group of rigid transformations. The method employs perturbations of the optimized solution and compares the resulting optimized poses to ensure robust detection of degeneracies. By leveraging generators from the Lie algebra se(3), the method provides a systematic approach to describing the set of degenerate transformations. Quantitative evaluations on synthetic data show significant improvement over the state-of-the-art Hessian-based method, reducing alignment error by 50%, with more significant improvements for datasets featuring noise. In the real-world degenerate datasets, the proposed method integrated into LiDAR-based odometry yields superior localization performance compared to the reference solution based on the Hessian-based degeneracy detector on a 260 m long trajectory, and succeeds on a 430 m long round-trip tunnel trajectory where the reference fails.

title: A unified framework for global and local interpretability using adaptive derivative-ordered random explanation
summary: The interpretability of complex machine learning models is of paramount importance, especially in real-world high-stakes domains such as healthcare and finance. However, existing post-hoc interpretability methods suffer from inherent limitations: fragmented analytical processes, inadequate capacity to model nonlinear feature interactions, computational inefficiencies, and over-reliance on specific model architectures. To address these challenges, this paper provides a novel method - Adaptive Derivative-Ordered Random Explanation (ADORE) - that leverages first- and second-order derivatives to accommodate nonlinear model complexities, while enabling effective capture of feature-sample interactions within a unified analytical framework. ADORE integrates global feature importance with local sample contributions, precisely quantifying feature impact by capturing both magnitude and direction, and identifying critical samples influencing model decisions. Furthermore, it achieves computational efficiency through randomized singular value decomposition (SVD) and dynamic sparsity detection, making it scalable to large, high-dimensional datasets. Experiments across three data modalities - tabular, text, and image - demonstrate that ADORE outperforms existing methods such as LIME and SHAP in handling complex interactions and computational efficiency, while providing detailed and reliable explanations. To facilitate adoption and reproducibility, ADORE has been released as an open-source Python package, hosted on GitHub, enabling researchers and practitioners to readily adapt and apply our approach to their specific tasks, models, and datasets.

title: Self-Distilled Pronunciation and Accent Control for Neural Text-to-Speech
comments: Since the ICASSP deadline was extended, I decided to redo the experiment
summary: Text-to-speech that reads raw text has no lexicon: a rare word is read as guessed. Remedies train a reading-and-accent channel on recorded speech or edit words one at a time from exemplars. We do neither. The frozen backbone reads a sentence containing a common word it already says correctly, and its own output then serves as the teacher for the same sentence, with that word replaced by a tagged, accented reading; this training pair is the whole idea. On Sarashina2.2-TTS, screened raters at Fleiss' kappa = 0.85 hear the prescribed accent on 0.89 of unseen words against 0.57 for kana, which cannot express one; kana wins no pair; naturalness is not measurably hurt. Moved untuned to autoregressive, diffusion, and encoder-decoder backbones, it transfers reading, 0.25 to 0.47 above no edit on 319 words, and on CosyVoice 2 accent on two words in three, but not on Irodori; the paper locates why.

title: After the Party: Growth, Governance, and Security Scanning in the OpenClaw Agent Skill Ecosystem
comments: To appear in IEEE Digital Library as the 33rd Asia-Pacific Software Engineering Conference (APSEC 2026) conference proceedings. Accepted version, not camera ready version
summary: AI agents increasingly act through agent skills, i.e., natural-language instructions, that direct a host agent toward shell, network, credential, file, and process actions, and public registries distribute them at scale. In the first half of 2026, the OpenClaw AI agent went viral, and its public skill registry boomed: the observable stock nearly doubled in 91 days, and a majority of the listings visible in June were created in just two months. By the end of our study window, the wave had crested, and monthly listing creation and core-repository activity were falling from their spring peaks. This paper measures what the boom left behind, drawing on the OpenClaw Git history, its GitHub issues and pull requests, and three ClawHub registry snapshots. Attention is concentrated: the top 10% of skills received 46.93% of all downloads. No simple skill features (like size or download counts) remained a stable predictor of continued listing once creation cohort and skill age were controlled. Human scrutiny did not stay: 77.86% have zero stars and zero comments, while 85.06% of the readable skills carry privilege evidence. And automated cleanup is not ready: the three security scanners disagreed on 23,702 of the 61,990 skills they all cover. After human adjudication, weighted scanner sensitivity against the reference standard ranged from 21.67% to 61.06%. Governing fast-growing agent-skill registries cannot rely on simple metadata or single scanner scores; it requires robust, transparent measurement and independent validation.

AI.title_translation: 派对之后：OpenClaw代理技能生态系统中的增长、治理与安全扫描
AI.tldr: OpenClaw AI代理技能生态在爆发增长后暴露出人类监督缺失、自动化安全扫描不可靠以及简单元数据预测失效等问题，亟需更稳健的治理与独立验证机制。
AI.motivation: 随着AI代理技能（Agent skills）的广泛应用和公共注册表的快速膨胀，2026年上半年OpenClaw AI代理及其公共技能注册表经历了爆发式增长。然而，这种快速增长背后留下了怎样的生态遗留问题？现有的简单元数据预测、人类监督以及自动化安全扫描是否足以应对这些挑战？为此，本论文旨在度量和评估增长狂潮之后的OpenClaw代理技能生态系统的真实状况。
AI.method: 利用OpenClaw的Git历史记录、GitHub问题与拉取请求（PR），以及三个ClawHub注册表快照，通过数据分析与安全扫描器对比，研究了该生态系统在爆发增长后的现状、集中度、人类监督情况以及自动化扫描器的有效性。
AI.result: 研究发现：1. 注意力高度集中，前10%的技能占据了46.93%的下载量；2. 控制创建同类群组和技能年龄后，没有简单的技能特征（如大小或下载量）能稳定预测列表的持续存在；3. 缺乏人类审查，77.86%的技能没有星标和评论，而85.06%的可读技能带有权限提升证据；4. 自动化清理尚未成熟，三个安全扫描器在它们共同覆盖的61,990个技能中，有23,702个存在分歧，加权敏感度仅在21.67%到61.06%之间。
AI.conclusion: 对快速增长的AI代理技能注册表进行治理，不能仅仅依赖简单的元数据或单一的扫描器评分，而需要建立稳健、透明的度量和独立的验证机制。
AI.translation: AI代理越来越多地通过代理技能（即指导宿主代理执行shell、网络、凭证、文件和进程操作的自然语言指令）来采取行动，并且公共注册表对其进行大规模分发。在2026年上半年，OpenClaw AI代理迅速走红，其公共技能注册表蓬勃发展：可观测的存量在91天内几乎翻了一番，6月份可见的大部分列表是在短短两个月内创建的。在我们研究窗口结束时，这股热潮已经见顶，每月的列表创建量和核心仓库活动量开始从春季的峰值回落。本文基于OpenClaw的Git历史、GitHub问题与拉取请求（PR）以及三个ClawHub注册表快照，对这场繁荣留下的痕迹进行了度量。注意力高度集中：前10%的技能获得了所有下载量的46.93%。在控制了创建同类群组和技能年龄后，没有任何简单的技能特征（如大小或下载次数）能够成为列表持续存在的稳定预测指标。人类的审视并未持续：77.86%的技能没有星标和评论，而85.06%的可读技能带有特权证据。自动化清理也尚未准备就绪：三个安全扫描器在它们共同覆盖的61,990个技能中，有23,702个存在分歧。经过人工裁决，相对于参考标准，加权扫描器敏感度在21.67%到61.06%之间。对快速增长的代理技能注册表进行治理，不能依赖简单的元数据或单一的扫描器评分；它需要稳健、透明的度量和独立的验证。
AI.summary: 本文通过分析OpenClaw的Git历史、GitHub活动和注册表快照，研究了该AI代理技能生态系统在爆发式增长后的现状。研究表明，该生态面临注意力高度集中、缺乏人类监督以及自动化安全扫描器准确度不足和不一致等严峻挑战，凸显了建立健壮且独立的治理机制的必要性。
AI.keywords: AI agents, Agent skills, Security scanning, Ecosystem governance, OpenClaw
AI.comments: 该论文对OpenClaw这一快速增长的AI代理技能生态系统进行了首次全面且深入的实证研究，揭示了其在爆发式增长后留下的安全治理与质量控制隐患。论文指出了传统元数据预测失效、缺乏人类监督以及自动化安全扫描器准确率不足等关键问题，对未来AI代理生态的安全治理具有重要的警示与指导意义。

title: When AI Becomes Hard to Understand: Cognitive Demands in Real-World Human-AI Conversations
summary: Generative AI increasingly supports complex financial and health decisions, yet we know little about when its responses become difficult to process in real-world dialogue. We analyse more than 84,000 ChatGPT and Gemini conversations, using repeated prompting and clarification following misunderstanding as behavioural indicators of cognitive difficulty. We find that response characteristics such as length, readability and lexical diversity do not have fixed relationships with conversational difficulty; instead, their relationships depend on how they combine. Most notably, greater lexical diversity was associated with less repeated prompting in shorter responses, but this association weakened as response length increased, a pattern that replicated across financial and health conversations. We propose a conversational complexity budget to conceptualise these interdependencies: the demands associated with one response characteristic may depend on those accompanying it. The resulting design challenge is how to configure response complexity for the particular user, task and interaction.

AI.title_translation: 当AI变得难以理解时：真实世界人机对话中的认知需求
AI.tldr: 研究分析了ChatGPT和Gemini的84,000多条对话，发现AI回复的认知难度并非由单一特征决定，而是由回复特征（如长度、可读性、词汇多样性）的组合方式决定，并提出了“对话复杂性预算”概念。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI越来越多地支持复杂的金融和健康决策，但我们对其回复何时在真实世界对话中变得难以理解知之甚少。
AI.method: 分析了超过84,000条ChatGPT和Gemini对话，使用重复提示和误解后的澄清作为认知困难的行为指标。
AI.result: 回复特征（如长度、可读性和词汇多样性）与对话难度没有固定的关系，而是取决于它们的组合方式。值得注意的是，在较短的回复中，更高的词汇多样性与更少的重复提示相关联，但随着回复长度增加，这种关联减弱，这一模式在金融和健康对话中均得到复现。
AI.conclusion: 提出了“对话复杂性预算”概念，认为一个回复特征的认知需求可能取决于伴随它的其他特征。设计挑战在于如何为特定的用户、任务和交互配置回复的复杂性。
AI.translation: 生成式AI越来越多地支持复杂的金融和健康决策，但我们对其回复何时在真实世界对话中变得难以理解知之甚少。我们分析了超过84,000条ChatGPT和Gemini对话，使用重复提示和误解后的澄清作为认知困难的行为指标。我们发现回复特征，如长度、可读性和词汇多样性，与对话难度没有固定的关系；相反，它们的关系取决于它们的组合方式。最值得注意的是，在较短的回复中，更高的词汇多样性与更少的重复提示相关联，但随着回复长度增加，这种关联减弱，这一模式在金融和健康对话中均得到复现。我们提出了“对话复杂性预算”来概念化这些相互依赖性：一个回复特征相关的需求可能取决于伴随它的需求。由此产生的设计挑战是如何为特定的用户、任务和交互配置回复的复杂性。
AI.summary: 本研究旨在探究生成式AI回复在真实世界对话中变得难以理解的原因。通过分析84,000多条ChatGPT和Gemini对话，研究发现AI回复的认知难度并非由单一特征（如长度、可读性、词汇多样性）独立决定，而是由这些特征的组合方式所影响。例如，在短回复中，高词汇多样性有助于减少重复提示，但在长回复中效果减弱。研究提出了“对话复杂性预算”概念，强调了AI回复设计中需要考虑用户、任务和交互的复杂性匹配。
AI.keywords: AI可理解性, 认知需求, 人机对话, 对话复杂性, 生成式AI
AI.comments: 这项研究创新性地提出了“对话复杂性预算”的概念，超越了单一特征对AI可理解性影响的传统认知，揭示了AI回复特征之间复杂的相互作用。其重要性在于为未来设计更易于理解和用户友好的AI系统提供了新的视角和指导，特别是在高风险决策领域。研究的局限性可能在于其行为指标的间接性，以及未能深入探讨用户个体差异对认知需求的影响。

title: Zero-shot narrative detection in social messaging
summary: This study investigates the zero-shot ability of large language models (LLMs) to identify and classify hidden narratives in social messages. Our research hypothesis is that LLMs' extensive contextual knowledge allows them to interpret messages on a deeper, pragmatic level, going beyond basic sentiment or topic analysis. Experiments on the Dipromats and SemEval datasets show that providing models with human-written narrative descriptions significantly improves performance, without the need of training examples. In contrast, automatically generated descriptions or the use of few examples (few-shot) often degrade accuracy due to subtle shifts in framing. The study also finds that ensemble methods, particularly majority voting, enhance robustness and that larger models perform best while also being less sensitive to prompt variations. The findings validate that LLMs can effectively detect strategic narratives in a zero-shot setting, and when combined with simple ensembling and human-written descriptions, they can rival supervised systems, offering a scalable solution for narrative detection, specially when there is no training data for the vast majority of domains.

title: Vroom-Vroom at SHROOM-Visions: A Multi-Judge Committee for Detecting Hallucinated Spans in Vision-Language Outputs
comments: Accepted to UncertaiNLP 2026 @ EMNLP. SHROOM-Visions 2026 shared task system description
summary: This paper describes our submission to the SHROOM-Visions shared task on detecting and classifying hallucinated character spans in vision-language model outputs across four languages. We employ several fine-tuned vision-language models as independent annotators and combine their span predictions through character-level majority voting, and additionally explore activation probes. The approach ranks first in three of four languages and places on the podium in every language and metric. Our analysis indicates that disagreement among diverse models tracks disagreement among human annotators.

AI.title_translation: SHROOM-Visions 上的 Vroom-Vroom：用于检测视觉语言输出中幻觉跨度的多评委委员会方法
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于多视觉语言模型和多数投票的幻觉检测方法，在SHROOM-Visions多语言共享任务中夺得多个第一。
AI.motivation: 为了参加 SHROOM-Visions 共享任务，解决跨四种语言检测和分类视觉语言模型输出中幻觉字符跨度的问题。
AI.method: 采用多个微调的视觉语言模型作为独立标注者，通过字符级多数投票结合它们的跨度预测，同时探索了激活探测方法。
AI.result: 该方法在四个语言中的三个语言中排名第一，并且在每个语言和指标上都进入了领奖台（前三名）。分析还表明，不同模型之间的分歧反映了人类标注者之间的分歧。
AI.conclusion: 多评委委员会方法（结合字符级多数投票）能够有效检测视觉语言输出中的幻觉，并在多语言任务中取得领先性能。
AI.translation: 本文描述了我们提交给 SHROOM-Visions 共享任务的方案，该任务旨在检测和分类跨四种语言的视觉语言模型输出中的幻觉字符跨度。我们采用几个微调的视觉语言模型作为独立标注者，通过字符级多数投票结合它们的跨度预测，并额外探索了激活探测。该方法在四分之三的语言中排名第一，并在每种语言和指标上都名列前茅。我们的分析表明，不同模型之间的分歧与人类标注者之间的分歧相吻合。
AI.summary: 该论文介绍了其在 SHROOM-Visions 共享任务中的参赛方案，通过构建多评委委员会（使用多个微调的视觉语言模型并结合字符级多数投票）来检测视觉语言输出中的幻觉跨度。该方法在各项多语言评测中名列前茅，且模型分歧与人类分歧高度相关。
AI.keywords: 视觉语言模型, 幻觉检测, 多评委委员会, 字符级多数投票, 共享任务
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种基于多模型委员会和字符级多数投票的视觉语言模型幻觉检测方法，在SHROOM-Visions共享任务中取得了优异的成绩。创新点在于将多个不同的视觉语言模型作为独立标注者结合起来，并且其分歧程度能够反映人类标注者的分歧。

title: On the Existence of Pressure-Equilibrium-Preserving Numerical Fluxes for Supercritical Fluids
summary: In this work we propose a new existence theorem for numerical-flux functions for supercritical fluids that are pressure-equilibrium-preserving (PEP). In particular, we characterize the existence of consistent numerical-flux functions that satisfy an algebraic PEP property. Our theory links the existence of PEP schemes to geometric properties of the equation of state describing the thermodynamics of the fluid. When these geometric properties fail for a pair of states on the same isobar, no PEP schemes of the considered form can exist on a domain containing those states. In our analysis the equation of state itself can be fully general only needing to satisfy some fundamental thermodynamic principles. Recently, PEP compatibility conditions for general equations of state have been derived [1] that rely on the existence of certain thermodynamic derivatives which are not guaranteed to be defined under fundamental thermodynamic principles. The geometric conditions in our theory do not depend on the existence of these derivatives and recover the recent compatibility conditions in the case that these derivatives are defined. Finally, using numerical experiments we demonstrate for two supercritical fluids that our existence conditions are restrictive and thus that no PEP schemes of the form we consider exist on the domain we specify for these fluids. Using our geometric perspective, we also shed light on mechanisms by which PEP schemes can develop numerical issues, which we also demonstrate using numerical experiments.

AI.title_translation: 关于超临界流体压力平衡保持数值通量的存在性研究
AI.tldr: 本文研究了超临界流体中保持压力平衡数值通量的存在性，通过建立基于状态方程几何属性的理论，揭示了PEP格式的局限性及数值问题成因。
AI.motivation: 现有的通用状态方程PEP相容性条件依赖于某些不一定存在的热力学导数，为了克服这一局限性并深入理解PEP格式在超临界流体模拟中的存在性与数值问题，需要建立基于一般热力学原理的几何存在性理论。
AI.method: 通过理论推导建立PEP数值通量存在性与状态方程几何属性之间的联系，不依赖特定的热力学导数，并在超临界流体上进行数值实验验证。
AI.result: 研究发现，当等压线上的状态对违反特定几何属性时，所考虑形式的PEP格式在包含这些状态的域上将不存在。数值实验证实了这些存在条件的限制性，并展示了PEP格式产生数值问题的机制。
AI.conclusion: 本研究建立了超临界流体压力平衡保持（PEP）数值通量存在的几何理论，证明了其存在性受限于状态方程的几何属性，并通过数值实验验证了理论的正确性，揭示了PEP格式产生数值问题的原因。
AI.translation: 在这项工作中，我们为超临界流体提出了一个关于保持压力平衡（PEP）的数值通量函数的新存在定理。特别是，我们刻画了满足代数PEP属性的一致数值通量函数的存在性。我们的理论将PEP格式的存在性与描述流体热力学状态方程的几何属性联系起来。当这些几何属性在同一等压线上的某对状态失效时，所考虑形式的PEP格式在该包含这些状态的域上将不存在。在我们的分析中，状态方程本身可以是完全通用的，只需满足一些基本热力学原理。最近，人们推导出了适用于一般状态方程的PEP相容性条件[1]，这些条件依赖于某些热力学导数的存在性，而这些导数在基本热力学原理下并不保证有定义。我们理论中的几何条件不依赖于这些导数的存在性，并且在这些导数有定义的情况下恢复了近期的相容性条件。最后，通过数值实验，我们证明了对于两种超临界流体，我们的存在条件是具有限制性的，因此我们所考虑形式的PEP格式在我们指定的流体域上是不存在的。利用我们的几何视角，我们还阐明了PEP格式产生数值问题的机制，并通过数值实验进行了演示。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一项关于超临界流体压力平衡保持（PEP）数值通量的新存在性定理，将PEP格式的存在性与描述流体热力学状态方程的几何属性联系起来，克服了以往依赖导数的局限性，并通过理论与数值实验揭示了其限制性及数值问题的成因。
AI.keywords: 超临界流体, 压力平衡保持, 数值通量, 状态方程, 几何属性
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地从热力学状态方程的几何属性出发，研究了超临界流体中保持压力平衡（PEP）数值通量的存在性定理，克服了传统方法依赖未定义热力学导数的局限性。通过理论分析与数值实验，论文证明了PEP格式在特定流体域中的不存在性，并揭示了其数值问题的几何机制。对于计算流体力学和复杂流体模拟具有重要意义。

title: Limits of Transfer Learning
comments: Presented at the Sixth International Conference on Machine Learning, Optimization, and Data Science (LOD 2020), July 19-23, 2020
summary: Transfer learning involves taking information and insight from one problem domain and applying it to a new problem domain. Although widely used in practice, theory for transfer learning remains less well-developed. To address this, we prove several novel results related to transfer learning, showing the need to carefully select which sets of information to transfer and the need for dependence between transferred information and target problems. Furthermore, we prove how the degree of probabilistic change in an algorithm using transfer learning places an upper bound on the amount of improvement possible. These results build on the algorithmic search framework for machine learning, allowing the results to apply to a wide range of learning problems using transfer.
comment: Presented at the Sixth International Conference on Machine Learning, Optimization, and Data Science (LOD 2020), July 19-23, 2020

AI.title_translation: 迁移学习的局限性
AI.tldr: 该论文从理论上证明了迁移学习并非无条件有效，其性能提升受限于迁移信息的选择、相关性以及算法的概率变化。
AI.motivation: 尽管迁移学习在实践中被广泛应用，但其理论基础相对滞后，缺乏对迁移学习局限性和边界条件的深刻理解。
AI.method: 基于机器学习的算法搜索框架，通过数学证明推导迁移学习的理论结果，分析信息迁移的必要条件及性能提升的上限。
AI.result: 证明了必须仔细选择要迁移的信息，且被迁移的信息必须与目标问题存在相关性；同时证明算法中概率变化的程度构成了可能改进幅度的上限。
AI.conclusion: 迁移学习并非万能，其有效性受到信息相关性以及算法概率变化的严格限制，需要谨慎选择和使用。
AI.translation: 迁移学习涉及从一个问题领域获取信息和见解并将其应用到新的问题领域。尽管在实践中被广泛使用，但迁移学习的理论发展仍然相对滞后。为了解决这个问题，我们证明了几个与迁移学习相关的全新结果，表明需要仔细选择要迁移的信息集，以及被迁移信息与目标问题之间存在依赖关系的必要性。此外，我们证明了使用迁移学习的算法中概率变化的程度如何对可能实现的改进程度施加了上限。这些结果建立在机器学习的算法搜索框架之上，使得这些结果能够广泛应用于使用迁移的各种学习问题。
AI.summary: 该论文研究了迁移学习的理论局限性，证明了信息选择、相关性以及算法概率变化对迁移学习效果的限制作用，并通过算法搜索框架使这些结论适用于广泛的机器学习问题。
AI.keywords: 迁移学习, 理论分析, 算法搜索框架, 泛化能力, 局限性
AI.comments: 该论文从理论层面探讨了迁移学习的局限性，指出了信息选择和相关性的重要性，并利用算法搜索框架推导出了性能提升的理论上限，对理解迁移学习的本质具有重要意义。

title: Centralised multi link measurement compression with side information
summary: We prove new one shot achievability results for measurement compression of quantum instruments with side information at the receiver. Unlike previous one shot results for this problem, our one shot bounds are nearly optimal and do not need catalytic randomness. In fact, we state a more general problem called centralised multi link measurement compression with quantum side information and provide one shot achievability results for it. As a simple corollary, we obtain one shot measurement compression results for quantum instruments with side information that we mentioned earlier. All our one shot results lead to the standard results for this problem in the asymptotic iid setting. We prove our achievability bounds by first proving a novel sequential classical quantum multipartite covering lemma, which should be of independent interest.

title: Proof of the Clustered Hadwiger Conjecture
summary: Hadwiger's Conjecture asserts that every $K_h$-minor-free graph is properly $(h-1)$-colourable. We prove the following improper analogue of Hadwiger's Conjecture: for fixed $h$, every $K_h$-minor-free graph is $(h-1)$-colourable with monochromatic components of bounded size. The number of colours is best possible regardless of the size of monochromatic components. It solves an open problem of Edwards, Kang, Kim, Oum and Seymour [SIAM J. Disc. Math. 2015], and concludes a line of research initiated in 2007. Similarly, for fixed $t\geq s$, we show that every $K_{s,t}$-minor-free graph is $(s+1)$-colourable with monochromatic components of bounded size. The number of colours is best possible, solving an open problem of van de Heuvel and Wood [J. London Math. Soc. 2018]. We actually prove a single theorem from which both of the above results are immediate corollaries. For an excluded apex minor, we strengthen the result as follows: for fixed $t\geq s\geq 3$, and for any fixed apex graph $X$, every $K_{s,t}$-subgraph-free $X$-minor-free graph is $(s+1)$-colourable with monochromatic components of bounded size. The number of colours is again best possible.

AI.title_translation: 群集Hadwiger猜想的证明

AI.motivation: 旨在解决Edwards等人在2015年提出的关于Hadwiger猜想的不当着色模拟（群集Hadwiger猜想）的公开问题，以及van de Heuvel和Wood在2018年关于 $K_{s,t}$ minor-free图着色的公开问题。

AI.comments: 该论文解决了图论中关于Hadwiger猜想及其变体的长达多年的著名公开问题，具有高度的理论创新性和重要性。

title: Multi-Objective Hyperparameter Search via Damped Gauss--Newton Optimization
summary: We study hyperparameter optimization (HPO) from a numerical-optimization perspective and propose a multi-objective damped Newton--Gauss--Newton search method. Rather than perturbing each hyperparameter separately or treating model evaluations as independent trials, the method uses performance changes between successive full hyperparameter vectors to construct an iterative secant approximation of the local sensitivity matrix. Each iteration therefore requires only one new full-vector model evaluation while jointly updating all optimized hyperparameters. A Tikhonov-regularized Gauss--Newton system stabilizes the update when the number of hyperparameters exceeds the number of performance objectives. The search is initialized from readily available empirical/default settings of the underlying learner, without requiring a separate initialization search. We evaluate four-dimensional XGBoost HPO on three public classification datasets against exhaustive grid search, random search, and tree-structured Parzen estimator (TPE) optimization. On Breast Cancer Wisconsin, the proposed method matches the best validation accuracy of a 320-configuration grid search with slightly better log loss and ROC--AUC. Across three datasets and three seeds, predictive performance remains competitive with random search and TPE while using substantially fewer search iterations. A supplementary proprietary eight-dimensional threshold-optimization case study further demonstrates joint multi-parameter optimization under competing performance targets and reveals non-monotonic, oscillatory trajectories that motivate damping and best-iterate selection. Overall, the results establish iterative secant sensitivity as an evaluation-efficient local alternative to exhaustive HPO.

AI.title_translation: 基于阻尼高斯-牛顿优化的多目标超参数搜索
AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于阻尼高斯-牛顿优化的多目标超参数搜索方法，通过迭代割线近似大幅减少模型评估次数，同时保持了具有竞争力的预测性能。
AI.motivation: 传统的超参数优化方法（如网格搜索、随机搜索等）通常需要大量独立的模型评估，计算成本高。为了从数值优化角度提高评估效率，并实现多个竞争性能目标下的联合多参数优化，作者研究了基于阻尼高斯-牛顿优化的多目标超参数搜索方法。
AI.method: 提出了一种多目标阻尼高斯-牛顿搜索方法，使用连续完整超参数向量之间的性能变化来构建局部敏感度矩阵的迭代割线近似，并采用Tikhonov正则化的的高斯-牛顿系统来稳定超参数更新。
AI.result: 在Breast Cancer Wisconsin数据集上，该方法以更少的评估次数匹配了320种配置的网格搜索的最佳验证准确率，且对数损失和ROC-AUC表现略好；在三个数据集和三个种子的测试中，其预测性能与随机搜索和TPE具有竞争力，但使用的搜索迭代次数明显更少。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在显著减少搜索迭代次数的同时，能够取得与传统网格搜索、随机搜索和TPE相媲美甚至更好的预测性能，证明了迭代割线灵敏度作为一种评估高效的局部超参数优化替代方案的可行性。
AI.translation: 我们从数值优化的角度研究了超参数优化（HPO），并提出了一种多目标阻尼牛顿-高斯-牛顿搜索方法。该方法没有单独扰动每个超参数或将模型评估视为独立试验，而是利用连续完整超参数向量之间的性能变化来构建局部敏感度矩阵的迭代割线近似。因此，每次迭代仅需要一次新的全向量模型评估，同时联合更新所有优化的超参数。当超参数数量超过性能目标数量时，Tikhonov正则化的高斯-牛顿系统可稳定更新。该搜索从底层学习器的现成经验/默认设置初始化，不需要单独的初始化搜索。我们在三个公共分类数据集上对四维XGBoost HPO进行了评估，并与穷举网格搜索、随机搜索和树结构帕zen估计器（TPE）优化进行了对比。在威斯康星州乳腺癌数据集上，所提出的方法与320种配置的网格搜索的最佳验证准确率相匹配，且对数损失和ROC-AUC略好。在三个数据集和三个随机种子下，其预测性能与随机搜索和TPE保持竞争力，同时使用的搜索迭代次数大大减少。补充的专有八维阈值优化案例研究进一步证明了在竞争性能目标下的联合多参数优化，并揭示了促使阻尼和最佳迭代选择的非单调、振荡轨迹。总体而言，研究结果确立了迭代割线敏感度作为穷举HPO的一种评估高效的局部替代方案。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了一种基于阻尼高斯-牛顿优化的多目标超参数搜索方法，通过迭代割线近似局部敏感度矩阵并在每次迭代中仅需一次新的全向量模型评估，实现了高效的超参数联合更新。实验表明，该方法在大幅减少搜索迭代次数的同时，能保持与传统网格搜索、随机搜索及TPE相当或更好的预测性能。
AI.keywords: 超参数优化, 多目标优化, 阻尼高斯-牛顿法, 割线近似, 机器学习
AI.comments: 该论文从数值优化的角度切入超参数优化，提出了一种基于阻尼高斯-牛顿优化的多目标超参数搜索方法。相比传统的网格搜索、随机搜索或TPE，该方法利用连续超参数向量之间的性能变化来构建局部敏感度矩阵的迭代割线近似，显著减少了模型评估次数，展现出高效的局部搜索能力。其创新点在于将数值优化中的高斯-牛顿法与Tikhonov正则化引入多目标超参数调优中，为高效HPO提供了一种极具潜力的替代方案。

title: Local Test for Unitarily Invariant Properties of Bipartite Quantum States
comments: 56 pages. [v2]: extended testers with parameterized completeness and soundness, added new lower bounds for testing the bond dimension of matrix product states (MPS), and improved the lower bounds for testing Schmidt rank; [v3] and [v4]: minor revision
summary:
We study the power of local test for bipartite quantum states. Our central result is that, for properties of bipartite pure states, unitary invariance on one part implies an \textit{optimal} (over all global testers) local tester acting only on the other part. As an application, we demonstrate
  - Purified samples offer no advantage in property testing of mixed states.
  - A matching lower bound $Ω(r^2/\varepsilon^2)$ for testing the Schmidt rank of bipartite states with perfect completeness, settling an open question raised in the survey of Montanaro and de Wolf (ToC 2016).
  - A lower bound $Ω((\sqrt{n}+\sqrt{r})\cdot\sqrt{r}/\varepsilon^2)$ for testing whether an $n$-partite state is a matrix product state of bond dimension $r$ or $\varepsilon$-far, improving the prior lower bounds $Ω(\sqrt{n}/\varepsilon^2)$ by Soleimanifar and Wright (SODA 2022) and $Ω(\sqrt{r})$ by Aaronson et al. (ITCS 2024).
  - A matching lower bound $Ω(d/\varepsilon^2)$ for testing whether a $d$-dimensional bipartite state is maximally entangled or $\varepsilon$-far, showing that the algorithm of O'Donnell and Wright (STOC 2015) is optimal for this task.
  - A query lower bound $\widetildeΩ(\sqrt{d/Δ})$ for the $d$-dimensional entanglement entropy problem with gap $Δ$, improving the prior lower bounds $Ω(\sqrt[4]{d})$ by She and Yuen (ITCS 2023) and $\widetildeΩ(1/\sqrtΔ)$ by Wang and Zhang (SICOMP 2025) and Weggemans (Quantum 2025).
  Moreover, we extend our central result to a robust version where the tested states are subject to noise and are not guaranteed to be pure: in this case, one-way LOCC is sufficient to realize the optimal tester.

title: Physics-Informed Sylvester Normalizing Flows for Bayesian Inference in Magnetic Resonance Spectroscopy
authors: Dennis M. J. van de Sande
summary: Magnetic resonance spectroscopy (MRS) is a non-invasive technique to measure the metabolic composition of tissues, offering valuable insights into neurological disorders, tumor detection, and other metabolic dysfunctions. However, accurate metabolite quantification is hindered by challenges such as spectral overlap, low signal-to-noise ratio, and various artifacts. Traditional methods like linear-combination modeling are susceptible to ambiguities and commonly only provide a theoretical lower bound on estimation accuracy in the form of the Cramér-Rao bound. This work introduces a Bayesian inference framework using Sylvester normalizing flows (SNFs) to approximate posterior distributions over metabolite concentrations, enhancing quantification reliability. A physics-based decoder incorporates prior knowledge of MRS signal formation, ensuring realistic distribution representations. We validate the method on simulated 7T proton MRS data, demonstrating accurate metabolite quantification, well-calibrated uncertainties, and insights into parameter correlations and multi-modal distributions.

title: Diff-SPORT: Diffusion-based Sensor Placement Optimization and Reconstruction of Turbulent flows in urban environments
summary: Rapid urbanization demands efficient monitoring of turbulent wind and pollutant dispersion, yet existing reconstruction and sensor placement strategies fail under realistic sparsity constraints. Here, we introduce Diff--SPORT, a diffusion-based framework that combines a generative diffusion prior with maximum a posteriori inference and Shapley-value attribution for high-fidelity flow reconstruction and optimal sensor placement. By training a diffusion prior model once over a domain, Diff--SPORT enables non-linear optimal sensor placement and near-real-time flow reconstruction from sparse measurements orders of magnitude faster than RANS or LES simulations, consistently outperforming state-of-the-art methods. The framework also extends, without algorithmic modification, to experimental passive scalar concentration dataset, a direct proxy for pollutant dispersion, measured in a 1:2400 scale water-flume model of the Beijing Haidian neighbourhood under realistic urban flow conditions. Shapley-guided sensor placement achieves up to 57\% lower reconstruction error than randomly placed sensors at extreme sparsity, identifying compact and physically interpretable configurations. These results establish Diff--SPORT as a modular foundation offering a zero-shot alternative to retraining-intensive downstream strategies, supporting scalable urban flow monitoring for air quality management and resilient city design.

title: Consensus-based optimization for closed-box adversarial attacks and a connection to evolution strategies
summary: Consensus-based optimization (CBO) has established itself as an efficient gradient-free optimization scheme, with attractive mathematical properties, such as mean-field convergence results for non-convex loss functions. In this work, we study CBO in the context of closed-box adversarial attacks, which are imperceptible input perturbations that aim to fool a classifier, without accessing its gradient. Our contribution is to establish a connection between the so-called consensus hopping as introduced by Riedl et al. and natural evolution strategies (NES) commonly applied in the context of adversarial attacks and to rigorously relate both methods to gradient-based optimization schemes. Beyond that, we provide a comprehensive experimental study that shows that despite the conceptual similarities, CBO can outperform NES and other evolutionary strategies in certain scenarios.

title: Constrained PSLQ Search for Machin-like Identities Achieving Record-Low Lehmer Measures
comments: 26 pages, 2 tables. v2: corrects the previously best known 5, 6 and 9 term relations (Section 1.2, Table 1) and attributes the floor-function iteration to Abrarov et al. (Section 3.3). Results unchanged
summary: Machin-like arctangent relations are classical tools for computing $π$, with efficiency quantified by the Lehmer measure ($λ$). We present a framework for discovering low-measure relations by coupling the PSLQ integer-relation algorithm with number-theoretic filters derived from the algebraic structure of Gaussian integers, making large scale search tractable. Our search yields new 5 and 6 term relations with record-low Lehmer measures ($λ=1.4572, λ=1.3291$). We also demonstrate how discovered relations can serve as a basis for generating new, longer formulae through algorithmic extensions. This combined approach of a constrained PSLQ search and algorithmic extension provides a robust method for future explorations.

title: When Does Selfishness Align with Team Goals? A Structural Analysis of Equilibrium and Optimality
summary: This paper investigates the relationship between the team-optimal solution and the Nash equilibrium (NE) to assess the impact of self-interested decisions on team performance. In classical team decision problems, team members typically act cooperatively towards a common objective to achieve a team-optimal solution. However, in practice, members may behave selfishly by prioritizing their goals, resulting in an NE under a non-cooperative game. To study this misalignment, we develop a parameterized model for team and game problems, where game parameters represent each individual's deviation from the team objective. The study begins by exploring the consistency and deviation between the NE and the team-optimal solution under fixed game parameters. We provide a necessary and sufficient condition for any NE to be a team optimum, along with establishing an upper bound to measure their difference when this consistency fails. We then study how to steer the NE toward the team-optimal solution by adjusting game parameters in an incomplete-information leader--follower setting, where the leader observes only equilibrium responses rather than the exact lower-level game structure. To address this challenge, we develop a two-stage learned-response intervention framework: the leader first learns a behaviorally consistent lower-level model from observed equilibria and then computes the intervention over the learned response map using bilevel hypergradient optimization, followed by convergence analysis and simulation validation.

title: A State-Space Representation of Coupled Linear Multivariate PDEs and Stability Analysis using SDP
summary: Recently, it has been shown that stability analysis and control of coupled Partial Differential Equations (PDEs) in a single spatial variable can be more conveniently performed using the Partial Integral Equation (PIE) representation. This PIE offers an equivalent, state-space representation of the PDE on the Hilbert space $L_{2}$, and is parameterized by an algebra of Partial Integral (PI) operators, allowing e.g. stability to be analyzed by solving a linear operator inequality on PI operator variables. In this paper, we show how this PIE framework for univariate PDEs can be extended inductively to multivariate PDEs on a hyper-rectangle. Specifically, assuming the boundary conditions defining the domain of the PDE to be decoupled along distinct spatial directions, we propose a readily verifiable condition for existence of a bijection between the PDE domain and $L_{2}$. We derive an explicit expression for the map defining this bijection, and use this map to construct an equivalent PIE representation for a broad class of linear multivariate PDEs. Next, we embed the parameters defining this PIE representation in a class of multivariate PI operators, and prove that this class forms a $*$-algebra---allowing PI operator inequalities for stability analysis, estimation, and control of univariate PDEs to be similarly formulated for multivariate PDEs. Finally, we show how such an operator inequality for stability analysis of multivariate PDEs can be solved with semidefinite programming, using a positive matrix parameterization of positive semidefinite multivariate PI operators. This framework for representation and stability analysis of multivariate PDEs is incorporated in the PIETOOLS software, and applied to analyze stability of 2D heat, wave, and plate equations, obtaining accurate bounds on the rate of decay.

AI.motivation: 现有的偏积分方程（PIE）状态空间表示法主要局限于单变量PDE的稳定性分析与控制，为了将这一便利的框架扩展到更广泛、更复杂的空间多维情形（多变量PDE），需要建立相应的多变量PIE理论与计算方法。
AI.method: 通过归纳法将PIE框架推广到超矩形域上的多变量PDE，构造PDE域与 $L_2$ 之间的双射，构建多元PIE表示；证明多元PIPI算子构成 $*$-代数，并利用半定规划（SDP）求解算子不等式以进行稳定性分析。
AI.result: 提出了一种验证双射存在的条件并给出了显式映射表达式；推导出了多变量线性PDE的等价PIE表示；证明了参数形成 $*$-代数；通过SDP成功求解了2D热传导方程、波动方程和板方程的稳定性，并获得了准确的衰减率界限。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功将PIE框架推广至多变量线性PDE，建立了一套基于 $*$-代数和SDP的稳定性分析方法，并通过软件验证了其有效性。
AI.translation: 最近的研究表明，使用部分积分方程（PIE）表示可以更方便地进行单空间变量耦合偏微分方程（PDE）的稳定性分析和控制。该PIE在Hilbert空间 $L_2$ 上提供了PDE的等价状态空间表示，并由部分积分（PI）算子代数参数化，从而允许通过求解PI算子变量上的线性算子不等式来分析稳定性。在本文中，我们展示了如何将这种用于单变量PDE的PIE框架归纳推广到超矩形上的多元PDE。具体而言，假设定义PDE域的边界条件在不同空间方向上是解耦的，我们提出了一个易于验证的条件，用于判断PDE域与 $L_2$ 之间双射的存在性。我们推导了定义该双射的映射的显式表达式，并利用该映射为广泛的一类线性多元PDE构建了等价的PIE表示。接下来，我们将定义该PIE表示的参数嵌入到一类多元PI算子中，并证明该类算子形成了一个 $*$-代数——这使得原本用于单变量PDE的稳定性分析、估计和控制的PI算子不等式可以类似地构用于多元线性PDE。最后，我们展示了如何利用半定规划（SDP），通过正半定多元PI算子的正矩阵参数化，来求解用于多元PDE稳定性分析的算子不等式。这种用于多元PDE表示和稳定性分析的框架已被并入PIETOOLS软件中，并应用于分析二维热传导方程、波动方程和板方程的稳定性，从而获得了准确的衰减率界限。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种将耦合线性多元偏微分方程（PDE）转化为状态空间部分积分方程（PIE）的框架。通过构造映射并在Hilbert空间上建立等价表示，结合 $*$-代数与半定规划（SDP），实现了对多变量PDE稳定性的有效分析，并通过PIETOOLS软件在2D热方程、波动方程和板方程中得到了验证。
AI.keywords: Partial Differential Equations, State-Space Representation, Semidefinite Programming, Stability Analysis, Partial Integral Operators
AI.comments: 本文将偏微分方程（PDE）的状态空间表示方法从单变量推广到多变量，并通过算子代数和半定规划（SDP）解决了多变量PDE的稳定性分析问题。这一工作具有重要的理论意义和工程应用价值（已集成至PIETOOLS软件中），极大地扩展了偏微方程数值分析和控制的工具箱。

title: Learning Magnetic Order Classification from Large-Scale Materials Databases
comments: Main Text: 20 pages, 10 Figures & 8 Tables. Supplementary Tables are uploaded on Zenodo
summary: The reliable identification of magnetic ground states remains a major challenge in high-throughput materials databases, where density functional theory (DFT) workflows often converge to ferromagnetic (FM) solutions. Here, we partially address this challenge by developing machine-learning classifiers trained on experimentally validated MAGNDATA magnetic materials, leveraging a limited number of simple compositional, structural, and electronic descriptors sourced from the Materials Project Database. Our propagation-vector classifiers achieve accuracies above 92%, outperforming a recent equivariant-neural-network study on a differently constructed dataset in reliably distinguishing between zero and nonzero propagation-vector structures, and exposing a systematic ferromagnetic bias inherent to the Materials Project database for more than 6840 candidate materials. In parallel, LightGBM and XGBoost models trained directly on the Materials Project labels achieve accuracies of 82% and 85%, respectively (with macro-F1 average scores of 66% and 63%), proving useful for large-scale screening for magnetic classes, when refined by MAGNDATA-trained classifiers. These results underscore the role of machine-learning techniques as corrective and exploratory tools, enabling more trustworthy databases and accelerating progress toward the identification of materials with various properties.

title: A Gradient Flow Approach to Solving Inverse Problems with Latent Diffusion Models
comments: Accepted at the 2nd Workshop on Frontiers in Probabilistic Inference: Sampling Meets Learning, 39th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2025). Revision (v2): fixed likelihood objective $\mathcal{F}[μ]$ and its derivation; the algorithm and reported results are unchanged
summary: Solving ill-posed inverse problems requires powerful and flexible priors. We propose leveraging pretrained latent diffusion models for this task through a new training-free approach, termed Diffusion-regularized Wasserstein Gradient Flow (DWGF). Specifically, we formulate the posterior sampling problem as a Wasserstein gradient flow in the latent space of an expected negative log posterior objective, regularized by a Kullback-Leibler divergence to the diffusion prior. We demonstrate the performance of our method on standard benchmarks using StableDiffusion (Rombach et al., 2022) as the prior.

title: Effective bases and notions of effective second countability in computable analysis
comments: 29 pages. Extended version of "Effective Second Countability in Computable Analysis", CiE 2025
summary: We investigate different notions of "computable topological base" for represented spaces. We show that several non-equivalent notions of bases become equivalent when we consider computably enumerable bases. This indicates the existence of a robust notion of computably second countable represented space. These spaces are precisely those introduced by Grubba and Weihrauch under the name "computable topological spaces". The present work thus clarifies the articulation between Schröder's approach to computable topology based on the Sierpinski representation and other approaches based on notions of computable bases. These other approaches turn out to be compatible with the Sierpinski representation approach, but also strictly less general. We revisit Schröder's Effective Metrization Theorem, by showing that it characterizes those represented spaces that embed into computable metric spaces: those are the computably second countable strongly computably regular represented spaces. Finally, we study different forms of open choice problems. We show that having a computable open choice is equivalent to being computably separable, but that the "non-total open choice problem", i.e., open choice restricted to open sets that have non-empty complement, interacts with effective second countability in a satisfying way.

title: Overlapping Schwarz Scheme for Linear-Quadratic Programs in Continuous Time
summary: We present an optimize-then-discretize framework for solving linear-quadratic optimal control problems (OCP) governed by time-inhomogeneous ordinary differential equations (ODEs). Our method employs a modified overlapping Schwarz decomposition based on the Pontryagin Minimum Principle, partitioning the temporal domain into overlapping intervals and independently solving Hamiltonian systems in continuous time. We demonstrate that the convergence is ensured by appropriately updating the boundary conditions of the individual Hamiltonian dynamics. The cornerstone of our analysis is to prove that the exponential decay of sensitivity (EDS) exhibited in discrete-time OCPs carries over to the continuous-time setting. Unlike the discretize-then-optimize approach, our method can flexibly incorporate different numerical integration methods for solving the resulting Hamiltonian two-point boundary-value subproblems, including adaptive-time integrators. A numerical experiment on a linear-quadratic OCP illustrates the practicality of our approach in broad scientific applications.
